text.body: tattvaṭīkā śrīmate rāmānujāya namaḥ | śrīmannigamāntamahādeśikaviracitā śribhāṣyavyākhyā tattvaṭīkā | śrīmānveṅkaṭanāthāryaḥ kavitārkikakesarī | vedāntācāryavaryo me saṃnidhattāṃ sadā hṛdi || sa jayati yatihājamuniḥ karuṇājaladhiḥ kṣamāpariṣkāraḥ | kariśailakṛṣṇameghaḥ kāṅikṣatarṣī yadapritaistoyaiḥ || 1 || svataḥ siddhaṃ śuddhasphaṭikamaṇibhūbhṛtpratibhaṭaṃ sudhāsadhrīcībhirdyutibhiravadātatribhuvanam | anantaisrayyantairanuvihitaheṣāhalahalaṃ hatāśeṣāvadyaṃ hayavadanamīḍīmahi mahaḥ || 2 || praṇamya varadācāryavādihaṃsāmbudāvapi | trayyantasūtrabhāṣyārthatattvaṭīkā vidhīyate || 3 || asāvanatisaṃkṣepādativistaravarjanāt | sarvanyāyānukūlatvādgṛhyatāṃ sāravedibhiḥ || 4 || śātitaḥ śatadūṣaṇyāṃ śaṃkarādimudhāgrahaḥ | śārīrakaśarīraṃ tu vyaktamatra pradarśyate || 5 || viśvāmitrakulīnena vedāntācāryasūriṇā | śaśvadvidhīyate viśvavaitaṇḍikavidhūnanam || 6 || nikhilanigamaśreṇīcūḍāpariṣkṛtirūpiṇī nipuṇamanasāmāśāsaudhasthalīṣu nibadhyate | yatipatibhuvo bhāṣyasyāsau yathāśrutacintitapravacanavidhāvaṣṭāviṃśe jayadhvajapaṭṭikā || 7 || tatra tāvat -- akhiletyādibhāṣyasya daśārthānabhidadhmahe | viṣayāditrikasyoktiḥ prathamaṃ pratipādyate || 8 || tasyārthasya ca sautratvāttadvistārātmakaṃ punaḥ | anavadyamidaṃ padyaṃ bhāṣyalakṣaṇalakṣitam || 9 || yadyapi athoto brahmajijñāsā iti sūtraṃ brahma jijñāsostadvicārasya kartavyatve pravṛttam, tathāpi śārīrakaviṣayādiṣvapyarthato vartate; yathā dharmajijñāsāsūtram | āsūśca -- athoto dharmajijñāsāsūtramādyamidaṃ kṛtam | dharmākhyaṃ viṣayaṃ vaktuṃ mīmāṃsāyāḥ prayojanam || iti | evamatrāpi -- brahmeti tāvadviṣayaṃ prāpyatvena prayojanam | jijñāsākarmabhāvena saṃbandhamapi cābravīt || 10 || niratiśayabṛhattvaṃ hi brahmaśabdārthaḥ; bṛhatidhātoḥ bṛheram ca iti maninpratyaye amāgame ca brahmeti vyutpatteḥ brahmaparibṛḍhaṃ sarvataḥ iti yāskokteśca | yattu ātharvaṇikī nirūktiḥ bṛṃhaṇatvamapyāha -- bṛhati bṛṃhayati tasmāducyate paraṃ brahma iti, paurāṇikī ca prasiddhiḥ, bṛhaṇatvasya bṛhaṇatvāñca tadbrahmetyabhidhīyate iti; tadgobalīvardanyāyāditi na virodhaḥ; bṛṃhaṇatvasya bṛhattvaviśeṣatvāñca | tadayamarthaḥ -- svato bṛhat bṛṃhaṇatvenāpi bṛhaditi prayuktapadāntarapaunaruktyaparihārāya sāmānyaśabdasaṅkoco gobalīvardanyāya iti lakṣaṇānusāreṇa bṛhacchabdo bṛṃhaṇatvātmakabṛhattvādanyatra vartate; yathā viṣṇunāmā sa vedeṣu vedānteṣu ca gīyate iti | tenānavadhikātiśayabṛhattvameva brahmaśabdārtha ityeke | apare tu bṛhattvavat bṛṃhaṇatvamapyanavadhikatiśayaṃ brahraśabdārthaḥ, bṛhati bṛṃhayati bṛhattvādbṛṃhaṇatvāñca iti pṛthagabhidhānasvārasyāt samuñcayopādānasvārasyoñcetyācakṣete | vayaṃ tu brūmaḥ -- ubhayatrāpi virodhābhāvādubhayathāpyācakṣmaha iti | ayamatra saṃgrahaḥ -- bṛhattvaṃ brahmaśabdārtho bṛṃhaṇatvaṃ tu tadbhidā | yadvārtho brahmaśabdasya bṛṃhaṇatvaṃ bṛhattvavat || 11 || athavā bṛhattvabṛṃhaṇatvasamuñcayo vā | etatsarvamabhipretyoktaṃ janmādyadhikaraṇabhāṣye upalakṣyaṃ hyanavadhikātiśayabṛhat bṛṃhaṇaṃ ca, bṛhaterdhātostadarthatvāt iti | anayośca sarvātiśāyitvamaparicchedāt yāskaniruktisāmarthyāñca sidhyati | anupādhikanirdeśe hyasaṅkoco manīṣibhiḥ | siddhe śabdārthasaṃbandha iti nyāyena kathyate || 12 || īdṛśaṃ brahma asya śāsrasya pradhānaviṣayaḥ; prāpyatayā paramaṃ ca prayojanam; niruktidvayārthasya dvikābhyāṃ vivaraṇāt | prāpyatvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sidhyedbṛṃhaṇatvasya kīrtanāt | svaprāpteḥ sādhanatvaṃ hi bṛṃhaṇatvamihocyate || 13 || na ca bṛhatidhātau bṛṃhayatītyabhidhānasya virodha iti vācyam, bṛha bṛhi vṛddhau iti dhātudvayasiddhatvānniruktidvayavākyasya | arthamātre ca tātparyādanyadhātośca segrahaḥ | tasya dhātoridittvāñca numāgamasamanvayaḥ || 14 || prayojanaṃ cātrāvaśyaṃ vaktavyam | tadapyāhuḥ -- sarvasyaiva hi śāsrasya karmaṇo vāpi kasyacit | yāvatprayojanaṃ noktaṃ tāvattatkena gṛhyate || iti | mīmāṃsākhyā tu vidyeyaṃ bahuvidyāntarāśrayā | na śuśrūṣayituṃ śakyā prāganuktavā prayojanam || iti ca | saṃbandhastu viṣayabhūtena brahmaṇā nirṇāyakatvādiḥ, prayojanabhūtena prāpakatvādiḥ, jījñāsāpadavivakṣitavicārasādhyavitīptitanmūlavinatitatsādhyarakṣārūpaistu prayojanaiḥ yathārhaṃ sākṣātparamparayā vā hetutvabodhakatve | śāsrārambheṣu sarvatra saṃbandhaḥ kathyate budhaiḥ | asaṃbaddhapralāpatve na pravarteta buddhimān || 15 || tadevaṃ sautrameva viṣayāditrikaṃ śrotṛbuddhisamādhānārthamupāditsārthaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ khyāpayan prāripsitaprabandhasyāvighnena paripūrtyarthaṃ pracayārthaṃ ca śaṅkitapratyūhaśāntyai śiṣṭācārādisiddhamiṣṭadevabhaktyāśīrūpaṃ maṅgalaṃ svātmanānuṣṭhitamapi śiṣyaśikṣārthaṃ svakṛtānukīrtanena teṣāṃ mahiṣṭhamaṅgalārthaṃ cādau nibadhnāti bhagavān bhāṣyakāraḥ -- akhileti | gurorācāramāśritya vartante maṅgalārthinaḥ | yānyasmākamiti śrutyā tadetadabhidhīyate || 16 || namaskriyāvastunirdeśāvapyarthasiddhau, sarvottuṅgamaṅgalatamatattvokteḥ | uktaṃ ca nīcoñcayoḥ svabhāvo'yaṃ nantṛnantavyatātmakaḥ iti | atra saptamyantaiḥ siddhaviṣayaprayojanoktiḥ | śrutiśirasi iti avāntaraviṣayasaṃgrahaḥ | yathā hi vedavākyasya viṣayo brahma kathyate | tathaiva sūtravākyasya trayyantaḥ parikīrtyate || 17 || vidīptivinatarakṣāśabdaiḥ sādhyaprayojanatrayakīrtanam | viśiṣṭā atra dīptiḥ vidīptiḥ; virṇayaḥ | sa tu vicārataḥ | yathāhuḥ -- dharme pramīyamāṇe tu vedena karaṇātmanā | itikartavyatābhāgaṃ mīmāṃsā pūrayiṣyati || iti | uktaṃ ca nyāyasudarśane -- jñāyamāne tu vedāntaiḥ karaṇaiḥ paramātmani | imāmuttaramīmāṃsāmitikartavyatāṃ viduḥ || iti | vedasya nirapekṣatvalakṣaṇaprāmāṇye satyapi pratipattṛmatimāndyaparādhanimittasaṃśayaviparyayāpalodanamanayā kriyate iti ca | prayojanoktirāptatvaniścaye niścayaṃ diśet | tatsandehe'pyupāditsāṃ siddhāṃ saṃdhukṣayedasau || 18 || tatra sāmānyataḥ prayojanavattvaniścaye'pi svāpekṣitaprayojanakathanamavaśyakartavyameva | tadiha saṃbandho'pi sūcita eva, saṃbandhāśrayabhūtaśāsraprayojanādīnāmupādānanāntarīyakatvātsaṃbandhāvagamasya | vicāratvaṃ vicāryatvaṃ nirdhāryatvaṃ tathetarat | prāpyatvaṃ prāpakatvaṃ ca saṃbandha iti kathyate || 19 || tatra tattvatrayamarthapañcakamityādikamadhyātmavidbhiratyādareṇa parigṛhītamarthajātaṃ svayameva sūribhiḥ saṃpratyāyyamiti na vivicya likhyate | viṣayādipradhānatvamādyapadye samīritam | adhunā maṅgalācāraprādhānyamanuvarṇyate || 20 || sa ca maṅgalācāraḥ keṣucit grantheṣvadṛṣṭo'pi nimittaphalābhyāmunneyaḥ| āhuśca -- prāripsitaṃ nimittaṃ syādavighnena samāpanam | pracayaśca phalaṃ tasmānmaṅgalācāra iṣyate || iti | avighnasamāptyādisaṃvalitasya prabandhārambhasya tatrādhikāriviśeṣaṇatvamityarthaḥ | uktaṃ ca vivaraṇakāraiḥ -- saṃvalitamatra viśeṣaṇam, jāteṣṭivat; yathā jāteṣṭau putrajanmano nimitta tve'pyārthavādikānāṃ putragatapūtatvādīnāṃ phalatvakalpanam | na ca gauravam, phalasya viśeṣaṇatve pravṛttisaukaryāt | phalamātre tu garhānupapattiḥ | na hi kāmyākaraṇe garhā iti | athavā śabaraśaṃkaragranthayoranīścarapratipādakatvāt īśvaranamaskārādimaṅgalaṃ na kṛtamiti vyācakṣate | na ca pakṣilādayaḥ paramāstikā nimitte satyapi maṅgalaṃ nācarantīti vyākurvate | kecitu īśvaravācakasya pramāṇaśabdasya prathamopādānāt kṛtamaṅgalācāra eva pakṣilamuniriti vyācakhyuḥ | ananuṣṭhitamaṅgalatve vā kathaṃ phalasiddhiḥ ? anuṣṭhitamaṅgalānāṃ tu phalavyabhicāraḥ karmakartṛsādhanavaiguṇyamavalambate | nanvārabdhasamāptikāmo maṅgalamācarediti vidhyabhāvādakartavyatvaṃ maṅgalācārasya | ayaṃ khalvanadhigatavedānāmaśrutamīmāṃsānāmālāpaḥ, avigītaśiṣṭācārasyaiva mūlapramāṇakalpakatvāt | tata eva codanālakṣaṇatvasiddhiḥ | na ca maṅgalācārābhāve'pi phalaṃ dṛṣṭamiti vācyam, saṃsārasyānidaṃprathamatayā tasyāpi bhavāntarīyasukṛtaviśeṣanibandhanatvāt | na ca kimanena maṅgalācāreṇa ? tadeva phalaṃ pradadātīti vācyam; tatsadbhāve niścayābhāvāt nimittānubandhino naimittikasya śiṣṭāṭacāraprāptatvenāvaśyakatvāñca | kiṃcidārabhamāṇasya buddhisthaṃ pūraṇādikam | tyaktvānyaphalaklṛptistu nītimadbhyo na rocate || 21 || bhaktirāśāsyamānāpi pūraṇapracayāciha | noparudhya pravarteta sā ca tau ca tadāśiṣā || 22 || bhaktirhi maṅgalatamā dadbodhādeśca kāraṇam | tasmātsarvapradhānatvādbhakterāśāsanaṃ varam || 13 || athavā bhaktibhedatvānnamaskārārcanādikam | sarvameva hi maṅgalyamāśāsyamiha manmahe || 14 || syādetat | astu tāvanmaṅgalācāraḥ; maṅgalanibandhastu tattadbhāṣyeṣvadarśanādayukta iti cenna, upayogāt aniṣedhāt | śiṣyāṇāṃ śikṣaṇaṃ tāvatteṣāṃ svakṛtakīrtanāt | mahiṣṭhamaṅgalāvāptistatphalaṃ prāgudīritam || 15 || dramiḍabhāṣyādiṣu namaḥ pravaraguṇaikāspadāya sthiratrasakulabījakumbhabhūtāya bhuvanakośasya goptre brahraṇe, namo jaiminaye vedarahasyasaṃpuṭanigūḍhaviṣphārayitre nyāyaprajvalitacetase, namo'stvācāryebhyaḥ ityādibhyastaddṛṣṭeścāvaśyakartavya evāyamācāraḥ | īśvarāpahnetṝṇāmācāro nāstheya iti prāgevoktam | smṛtyācāravirodhe tu smṛtireva balīyasī iti nyāyāñca siddhametat | smaryate ca tatra maṅgalācāraḥ -- maṅgalācārayuktānāṃ nityaṃ ca prayatātmanām | japatāṃ juhnatāṃ caiva vinipāto na vidyate || ityādibhiḥ || karaṇatrayasārūpyātkathyate maṅgalakriyā | tasmādgranthaniveśo'pi maṅgalasya pramāṇavān || 26 || pūrve pulastyamukhyāśca kriyāsamabhihārataḥ | kāryarambheṣu sarveṣu maṅgalāśāsanaṃ viduḥ || 27 || maṅgalācāraḥ purāṇāsambhe dṛṣṭaśca praṇipatyābhivādya ca iti gurupraṇipātādirūpaḥ | ata eva yuṣmadasmat ityādau kugranthatvamāśaṅkya pratyaktattvānusaṃdhānena maṅgalatvamācakhyurvyākhyātāraḥ | tañca mandam, yuṣmadarthānusaṃdhānasyaiva tatrāpi prathamyāt, madhyalaghutvena vahnidevatyasya ragaṇasya niveśāñca | śannomitrādayo mantrāḥ śataṃ te sūribhiḥ smṛtāḥ | karmānuṣṭhānakāleṣu paṭhitavyā manīṣibhiḥ || 28 || evamiha padyanibandhanacodyamapaṣṭhu | dṛṣṭaṃ ca keṣucit praṇamya hetumīśvaram ityādi | akāropakramaścāsminmaṅgalatvābhisaṃdhitaḥ | niḥśeṣatvaṃ tu sugamaṃ nikhiletyapi bhāṣite || 29 || anyārtho'pyatra varṇo'yaṃ viṣṇunāmasvabhāvataḥ | yadṛcchāśaṅkhaśabdādinyāyādbhavati maṅgalam || 30 || ādau ca pāṇinīyādestathānyainuvarṇitaḥ | sūtre cāthādiranyārthastadartho'pyanvamanyata || 31 || naño'pyatra śubhatvaṃ syādvaikalyapratiṣedhataḥ | niṣedhyabhedato hyasya śubhāśubhavikalpanā || 32 || apahantavyaduḥkhoktimapyārambhe śuphāṃ viduḥ | apauṣkalyaniṣedhe'sminnataḥ kaimutyamakṣatam || 33 || ādāvakhilaśabde'sminnagaṇatvaniveśanam | āyuḥpūrtinidānatvādavighnāyaiva kalpate || 34 || sarvasyāpi gamasyātra nagaṇo hi viśiṣyate | tatrādimacatuṣpadyāmaṣṭārthānaparān viduḥ || 35 || viśiṣṭamaṅgalācāraprakriyānāntarīyakān | vyākhyānamādyasūtrasya brahmalakṣaṇasaṃgrahaḥ || 36 || caturadhyāyyanukrāntirdhyeyasaṃśodhanaṃ dvidhā | parapakṣapratikṣepaḥ parārambhanivāraṇam || 37 || sveṣṭārambhaviruddhānāṃ niḥśeṣoddhāra ityapi | prakṛtānuguṇānekavivakṣā hyāśritā budhaiḥ || 38 || prāhuḥ kila vārttikakārāḥ loke ityādibhāṣyārthavivaraṇe -- loka ityādibhāṣyasya ṣaḍarthān saṃpracakṣate | sarvavyākhyāmupālambhaṃ pratyākhyānaṃ tathā pare || parisaṃkhyāstutī kecidathaśabdasya dūṣaṇam | iti | loke yeṣvartheṣu prasiddhāni padāni tāni sati saṃbhave tadarthānyeva sūtreṣvavagantavyāni; nādhyāhārādibhireṣāṃ parikalpanīyo'rthaḥ paribhāṣitavyo vā iti bhāṣyam | āpādacūḍaṃ samyagvyānaprakriyāyāḥ saṃgraheṇopavarṇanāt sarvavyākhyā; bhavadāsādivyākhyāyāmuktaprakāravaiparītyakhyāpanādupālambhaḥ | sūtrasya svarasārthapratipādanasvābhāvyena vyākhyānānapekṣatvakathanena sūtraṃ na vyākhyāyate, sūtraiḥ śrutireva vyākhyāyati iti sūtravyākhyānapratikṣepātpratyākhyānam | śrutisūtravisaṃvāde sūtrasya svārasikārthaprahāṇenādhyāhārādibhiḥ kathaṃcinneyatvena yathā śrutaparigrahasyāpāstatvātparisaṃkhyā | jaiminisūtrāṇāṃ svarasārthapratipādakatvasvābhāvyenopavarṇanātsūtrakārastutiḥ | ataśabdasya prasiddhārthapratipādakatvāvaśyaṃbhāvitve'pi vṛttādarśanādibhirānantaryārthatvaṃ na vidyata iti pūrvapakṣiṇākṣipyata ityathaśabdadūṣaṇam | iti bhāṣyārthavibhāgaḥ | ekasminneva bhāṣye taiḥ ṣaḍarthā yadvadīritāḥ | tadvadeva daśāpyarthānatrāpyācakṣmahe vayam || 39 || sarvavyākhyādikaṃ tāvadarthaṣaṭkaṃ nidarśanam | tathā pakṣilabhāṣyādau tattadarthāḥ pradarśitāḥ || 40 || saṃjighṛkṣitanānārthaiḥ sūtrakārādibhistathā | tantrāvṛttyanuniṣpādyāḥ kalpitāstadvadeva naḥ || 41 || dṛśyate hi darśanasparśanābhyāmekārthagrahaṇāt ityekasminneva sūtre pratyabhijñāprāmāṇyamātmanityatvamindriyanānātvaṃ viṣayasthairyaṃ guṇaguṇibheda ityādyarthajātam | tadiha sūtrārthoktau brahmaśabdena vyākhyeyasaṃgrahaḥ | tanniruktī pādābhyāṃ darśite|śrīnisatvaṃ tadupapādakaṃ liṅgam | athetyuktamānantaryaṃ śrutiśirasīti vyākhyeyakramānmukhyakramataḥ sthāpyate | ataḥśabdokto viśiṣṭārambhaheturvidīpta ityanenodgṛhītaḥ | mametyarthasiddhajijñāsādhikāryudāhṛtiḥ | śiṣṭena sarvotkṛṣṭavastugocaratayā svayaṃ ca svādutayā āśīrviṣayopāyaviśeṣektyā tadviṣayabrahmavicārasya sanpratyayasūcitarāgaprāptyuttambhanādardhādanārabhyatvabhramāpohaḥ | sūtrārthayordvayorārthaḥ phalataḥ pratipāditaḥ | atra śābdastu sūtrārthastasmānna punaruktatā || 42 || dvitīyasūtrabhāvasthakṛtsnalakṣaṇasaṃgrahe | brahmeti lakṣyaṃ śiṣṭaistu tallakṣamasamāhṛtiḥ || 43 || noddeśamātrātpramitiḥ parīkṣā lakṣaṇāśrayā | pradhānyāllakṣaṇasyātra pratipattirhi yujyate || 44 || atra hi sarvakāryasraṣṭṛtvādīni mumukṣūpāsyatvamokṣapradatvatrayyantapradhānavedyatvaśrīnivāsasatvaparamaprāpyatvāni ca gṛhyante, yairyogāyogābhyāmapavargaparipanthyabhaktyunmūlanapārāvaryavivekaḥ | asādhāraṇadharmo hi lakṣaṇatvena lakṣyate | bahutvaṃ tasya dharmasya buddherunmeṣakāraṇam || 45 || na lakṣaṇānāṃ bhinnatve lakṣyabhedaḥ prasajyate | viruddhalakṣaṇānāṃ hi bhedakatvaṃ vidurbudhāḥ || 46 || caturadhyāyyarthasaṃgrahastu -- parasmin brahmaṇi iti kāṇḍāntaravedyavyāvṛttapradhānārthoktiḥ | pādābhyāṃ siddhaviṣayarūpaḥ sādhyaviṣayarūpaśca dvikadvayārthaḥ saṃgṛhyate | śrutiśirasi vidīpte ityanena pramāṇaviśeṣāyogatadanyayogavyavacchedenopoddhātarūpacatuḥsūtryarthodgrahaḥ, śrutiśirasyeva vidīpta iti sāvadhāraṇanirdeśasya vivakṣitatvāt | ayogaḥ śrutibhiryogo'pyanyamānena vāryate | sūtraiścaturbhiḥ kiṃ no'tra vaktavyamavadhāraṇam || 47 || ekadeśinastu ādyasūtrārthoktiriti vyācakhyuḥ | nanu kathamanyapramāṇavyavacchedaḥ ? smṛtyādibhirapi tatsiddheḥ; maivam -- teṣāṃ tanmūlatayaiva prāmāṇyasya nyāyasiddhatvāt | etena smṛtivirodhāt śrutibādhaśaṅkā nirastā | śruteḥ smṛtidvāratvamapi sādhanavadbādhane'pi samānam | tatra śrutimūlatve vā smṛtireva śaraṇam | taduktam -- virodhe tvanapekṣaṃ syādasati hyanumānam; vakṣyati ca smṛtyanavakāśadoṣaprasaṅga iti cenna, anyasmṛtyanavakāśadoṣaprasaṅgāt iti | śrīnivāsabhaktirūpapadābhyāṃ prāpyaprāpakayāthārthyaniṣkarṣaḥ | paratvaṃ coktaprakāreṇa cadurdhā caturlakṣaṇīvedyam | mama ityupāyādhikāryudāhṛtiriti | atra bhuvanamātroktau sakaleti viśeṣaṇopādāne'pi vā prāyikatvaṃ śaṅkyeta | ato'tra akhileti niḥśeṣatvokteścaturmukhādibhyo vyāvṛttiriti | vyatirekamukheṇoktāvarthadārḍhyaṃ pratīyate | tasmādiṣṭarthasiddhiḥ syādaniṣṭavinivāraṇam || 48 || na hi caturmukhādīnāmakhilakāraṇatvam | na hi te sveṣāṃ svapūrvottareṣāmaṇḍāntarasthānāṃ śuddhasṛṣṭyādervā hetavaḥ; vyaṣṭisṛṣṭyādau ca niyatādhikārāḥ paraprayojyāśca | kāryasamudāyaviśeṣarūḍho'pyatra bhuvanaśabda upalakṣamāt bhavatīti vā kāryamātraparaḥ, prakaraṇānukrāntayogasya rūḍhito balīyastvāt | janmādiṣu bahubrīhiḥ tadguṇasaṃvijñānaḥ, sarvodīni sarvanāmāni itivat | dravyasya nityasiddhasya yathādṛṣṭyavadhāraṇe | janmasthityādyavasthāḥ syuḥ sāmagrībhedaśaktitaḥ || 49 || ākāśatvādidharmāṇāmāgantutvavivakṣayā | tattaddravyasya nityatve.pyutpattyādirapi śrutaḥ || 50 || yathā pākena rūpādyāḥ pareṣāṃ nityavastuṣu | tathā nasriguṇadravye parasaṃkalpato daśāḥ || 51 || janmādyavasthāśca nityanaimittikādibhedāt bahudhoktāḥ | pragasiddhasyātmalābha utpattiḥ janma | utpattilabdhākṛterarthasyāpraṇāśasāmagryāḥ sthitiḥ sthemā | nanu kathaṃ sthemaśabdaḥ ? kathaṃ ca sthityarthaḥ ? na hyasau sthānādivattiṣṭhaterniṣpannaḥ; na ca pṛthvādibhya imanijvā ityasya viṣayaḥ | yadyapi priyasthira ityādinā sthiraśabdasya sthādeśaḥ, tatra ca turiṣṭhemeyassu iti pratyayatrayaṃ prakṛtam; tathāpyatra priyorugurubahuladīrghāṇāmevādeśeṣvimanic bhavati, nānyeṣām, pṛthvādiṣvapāṭhāt . na cāsau ākṛtigaṇaḥ | ataḥ kathamayaṃ prayogaḥ ? atra brūmaḥ -- prayogataḥ sthitiḥ sthemā pratyayādyūhaśāsanāt | akhaṇḍito vā śabdo'yamadhātūdbhavapakṣataḥ || 52 || asti hi nyāyatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ tatprayogaḥ -- sthemā ca bhāvānāmupapādayiṣyate ityādi | tātparyapariśuddhau ca saṃśayaparīkṣāyāṃ bauddhāderniśritakṣaṇikatvāderapi jhaṭiti vighaṭitasādhanasya prativādisādhanāt parito nirastavibhramāśaṅkāt saṃśayaṃ vinaiva sthemādinirṇacotpattaḥ iti | nissthemāno daśānanakīrtayaḥ ityādayaśca mahākaviprayogāḥ | tadatra prasiddhabahuvidvatprayogabhūyastayā sādhutvaṃ siddham | śakyā ca vyutpattiḥ; yathāktam -- nāma ca dhātujamāha nirukte vyākaraṇe śakaṭasya ca tokam | yanna padārthaviśeṣasamutthaṃ pratyayataḥ prakṛteśca tadūhyam || mā bhūdvā prakṛtyādivibhāgaḥ, matabhedena akhaṇḍitaprātipadikabhāṣaṇāt | nāma ca ityādinā tatsūcyate | īdṛśānāṃ prayogāṇāmabahiṣkārasiddhaye | bahudhā bahulādīnāmaṣṭādhyāyyāmupakramaḥ || 53 || nānāvyākaraṇābhijñabahuvidvatparigrahe | śabdāsādhutvamāhurye śābdikāṃstānna manmahe || 54 || viśiṣṭoktyanusāreṇa vyutpattiḥ smaryate budhaiḥ | avigītaprayogeṣu vigānaṃ naiva sāṃpratam || 55 || bhaṅgaśabdo nātyantikalayagrāhī, rakṣāśabdena tadukteḥ, prayojanasyāpi viṣyavatpṛthagvaktavyatvāñca | ataḥ jagajjanmasthitidhvaṃsamahānandaikahetave ityādiṣviva brāhmaṇaparivrāṇnītyātra pṛthaguktiḥ | vinatetyādau indrādiśarīrakatayā vandharūpakāmyaphalapradatvamātraṃ vadatāmapi sthemaśabde ca saṃkocaḥ syādeva | ata eva atrādiśabdasamānādhikaraṇajanmādyanyapadārthaviśeṣatayāpi na mokṣasaṃgraha ucita ityāhurācāryāḥ, viśeṣasphauṭyābhāvāt | atraiva purāṇārthoktau jagadutpattisthitisaṃhārāntaḥpraveśaniyamanīdilīlam iti svokte sati paroktasya viprakṛṣṭasvoktasya svaprabandhāntaroktasya vānurodhāyogāt janmāditrayopayuktatamatatsahārmātānupraveśādīnāmapi taiḥ saṃgrahaṇocityāt teṣāmārthatvādati śābdatvasya paratvāñca | asvādhīnasaha kārinairapekṣyaṃ conena bhagavataḥ sidhyati | svakāryasthasya janmādeḥ svalīlātvoktisaktitaḥ | syāmityādyuktarītyaivopādānatvaṃ ca sūcitam || 56 || nṛtyantaṃ paśyatāṃ nṛttaṃ na līlā kiṃtu daddṛśiḥ | dehadvārātra tanniṣṭhaṃ līlā janmādikaṃ bhavet || 57 || avasthāntarayogitvamupādānatvamūcire | āgantukāpṛthaksiddhadharmo'vastheti kīrtyate || 58 || acijjīvasvadhīdvārā svarūpeṇa ca sarvage | avasthāḥ santyadoṣāste nirvikāroktiranyataḥ || 59 || etadarthaṃ cātrāntaḥpraveśādyuktiḥ | tato'nyasya taccharīratvanyakteḥ pradhānādhikṣetrajñaśarīrakaḥ sa eva janmādilīla ityuktaṃ bhavati | sargādikaṃ tato'syaiva bhūtasthamupakārakam | iti caitadabhiprāyamāhusrayyantapāragāḥ || 60 || na cātra vivakṣitaniṣkarṣabhuvanaśabdavṛttivirodhaḥ, svatantrabhūtaceṣṭālīlaḥ ityādivadupapatteḥ | bhuvanāni viṣṇuḥ ityādivadaniṣkarṣeṇa viśeṣyaparyantatve'pyavirodhaḥ | tathā ca vivaraṇam -- bhuvanaśabdaḥ sajīvātmakācidabhiprāyaḥ, kāraṇavākyeṣu tathaiva kāraṇatvapratīteḥ | brahma tu pṛthaṅ nirdiśyate | yadvā viśiṣṭaṃ brahmaśabdārthastata eva iti | ye cānye'pyarthāḥ tātparyatūlikoktāḥ -- kāryatvājjanmādiṣu līlāśabdopacāraḥ | janmādikāryatvājjanmādibhūtā līlā yasyeti vā, bhuvanajanmādiṣu līlā yasyeti vyadhikaraṇabahuvrīhirvā | janmasthemaṅgānāmādibhūtā līlā yasyeti tatpuruṣagarbhabahuvrīhirvā iti, te tu pradhānārthe prokte'pyaviruddhatayā vaibhavāduktāḥ | evaṃ janmādiśabdena taddheturulakṣyate | yadvā janmādikā līlā yasyetyarthadvayaṃ matam || 31 || kiṃcidiṣṭamanuddiśya na pravarteta cetanaḥ | tañcāptārthasya netyetallīloktyātra nivāryate || 32 || yadyadiṣṭaṃ tadā tasya siddhirasyāptakāmatā | nātaḥ kṣepyo yathālokaṃ sādhyalīlānvitaḥ śrutaḥ : || 33 || yatpūrṇamada ityādi tadapyuktaṃ na bādhate | pratyutānuguṇaṃ tasya svato'nyena ca pūrititaḥ || 34 || asyāpi prayojanāntaranirapekṣasvacchandavyāpāravyaktyai bālaḥ krīḍanakairiva iti dṛṣṭāntaḥ | tadabhiprāyaṃ sūtram -- lokavattu līlā ityādi | hetutvoktyāpi samanvayalakṣaṇārthaḥ sidhyet | līlāśabdastu sthālīpulākanyāyādavirodhalakṣaṇārthopalakṣaṇaḥ | anena svabuddhipūrvakasvaprītyarthavyāpāravācinā kartṛtvaṃ copādānatvāviruddhaṃ vyañjitam | sūkṣmaprakṛtiviśiṣṭatayopādānaṃ saṃkalpataḥ kartā ca syāt . evaṃ sahakārikalāpāntaryāmitayā sahakāritvamapīti nirvāhyam | vikārāśrayatvavyatiriktākāreṇa kāryopayuktaṃ hi nimittam; na tūpādānādanyadeva | ubhayābhiprāyeṇa hi kāraṇavākyeṣvekādvitīyaśabdau | so'bhidhyāya ityādibhiścaitadupabṛṃhitam | vinadādi vrātāntaṃ sādhanalakṣaṇārthaparam | tato'tra natirmānasī yathāvidhi prahvatā guṇopasaṃhārapādoktatattadvidyārūpā | viśabdastu nānārthaḥ | tadvanto vinatāḥ | pūrvapādadvayasiddhavairāgyādivaiśiṣṭyaparo vā viśabdaḥ | vinatānāṃ vaividhyaṃ vidyāṅgapādoktāśramādibhedāt | taduparyapi ityādyuktadevādibhedo'pyatra draṣṭavyaḥ | bhūtaśabdastāpatrahateḥ tannivṛttyupāyapāṭavasya ca hetunā dehaviśeṣeṇa yogamabhiprayannarthitvādikaṃ vyanakti | dhātvaṃśaśca santamenaṃ tato viduḥ ityādyuktāṃ śuddhadhīvaiśiṣṭyarūpāṃ sattāmācaṣṭe; atra brahma samaśnute ityadhītāṃ brahmanirveśātmikāṃ vā | bhūtasaṃbandhī vrāto'tra tāni tadīyāni ca, ṣaṣṭhyā saṃbandhasāmānyokte;; anyathā vrātaśabdanairapekṣyāt; na hyatra satravatsaṃhatānāmeva pravṛttiḥ phalāvāptirvā | sāketanivāsivatphalalābhastu na sārvatrikaḥ | tadatra nāsyāvarapuruṣāḥ kṣīyante nāsyābrahmavitkule bhavati paśurmanuṣyaḥ pakṣī vā ityādi viravyāpyam | rājapariṣadityādau hi rājā cānye ca vivakṣyante | vividhaśabdena paśuputrānnādyasvargasvārājyāditattatphalakāmakartṛvaividhyaṃ, vrātoktyā tattadupāyaniṣṭhavyaktibhūyastvaṃ vivakṣitamiti kecite | ayaṃ ca vaibhavavāda ityanumanyāmahe | āhuśca -- sarvavyākhyāvikalpānāṃ dvayamiṣṭaṃ prayojanam | pūrvatrāparitoṣo vā viṣayavyāptireva vā || iti | phalādhyāyakrameṇātra paraprāptivirodhinām | śamanaṃ nigrahādīnāṃ rakṣāśabdena gṛhyate || 65 || pratyūhātyantabhaṅge tu svataḥ prāptaṃ sukhādikam | yāvatsvarūpaṃ tatprāptaṃ tatsaṃsiddhirihārthataḥ || 66 || yadvābhīṣṭārthadānaṃ ca rakṣeti parigṛhyate | tadalābhanimittāddhi viṣādātttrāyate yataḥ || 67 || prayāsānatirekeṇa phalādhikṛtinītitaḥ | caturvidhānāṃ bhaktānāṃ rakṣoktiśca na duṣyati || 68 || ānandayitṛtvaśrutisūtre cātra bhāvye | ekaśabda iha pradhānārthaḥ; apyahaṃ jīvitaṃ jahyām ityādiṣu tadvirodhe tadviparītābhīṣṭatamakṛtsnatyāgokteḥ | ananyeṣu pramādyatsvapi nirayādiprāpakanigrahanivṛttyartho vā, teṣāṃ yamaviṣayagamanidiṣedhāt; dṛśyate hi -- na khalu bhāgavatā yamaviṣayaṃ gacchanti iti; ihaivaiṣāṃ kecidupaplavā bhavanti iti śikṣāmātrāmnānāñca | dīkṣā dṛḍhasaṃkalpaḥ; na tyajetam etadvrataṃ mama ityādyukteḥ | dīkṣoktyā svārthatvaṃ sūcitam; rājārthaṃ khalu rathaturagagajādisaṃrakṣaṇam | rakṣāyāmekā dīkṣā yasyeti vyadhikaraṇabahurvīhiḥ; rakṣāyāṃ vā dīkṣākāryatvāttadupacāraḥ; rakṣāyāmekadīkṣa iti vā yojyam | dṛṣṭamanyaparādhe hi daṇḍanaṃ khaṇḍanādikam | rājaputrāparadhe hi daṇḍanaṃ laghu dṛśyate || 69 || phalasādhanatayā coditasyāpyārthaṃ phalapradaprādhāyinām | rājānaḥ phaladā rājaparicaryāvidhāyinām | phalapradasya prādhānyaṃ phalāttadavagamyate || 70 || vinatarakṣoktyā tatsahagītaduṣkṛnnigrahavyañjanānnivartyo bandhahetuḥ karmādiḥ ravyāpitaḥ; ata eva vaiṣamyanairghṛṇyaparihāraśca | śrutiśabdo nirapekṣasaṃpratipattinyāyānnityaṃ śrūyamāṇe vede rūḍhaḥ; siddhe śabdārthasaṃbandhe ityādau caivaṃ prāhurityuktam | tena vaktṛdoṣābhāvasiddhiḥ | sādhitaṃ ca sarvādyapāde vedānāṃ prāmāṇyaṃ kāraṇadoṣabādhakapratyayayorabhāvena; kartṛśca teṣāmanumātumaśakyatvāt, kalpādiṣvapi yathāpūrvaṃ prāduṣkaraṇāt| kāṭhakādisamākhyānāṃ kartṛviśeṣopasthāpakatvābhāvāñca | śiraḥ brahmapradhānatayottamo bhāgaḥ | dīptiḥ sphūrtiḥ; sā punarādyādhikaraṇoktasiddhārthavyutpatteḥ | viśabdoktaṃ vaisiṣṭyaṃ tvanyadevatoktirāhityam | tadevāgniḥ ityādināgnyādiśabdānāṃ śarīriṇi paryavasānam, janmādisamanvayasūtroktakāraṇatvasvataḥpuruṣārthatvābhyāṃ vyāvṛttiścātra vivakṣyate | mānaviśeṣoktyā śeṣaniṣedhanyāyena tṛtīyasūtrārthaḥ sidhyati | evamiha nyāyasudarśanaṃ saṃgrahaḥ -- vyutpattyabhāvaḥ pratipattidausthyamanyena siddhatvamathāphalatvam | etāni vai sūtracatuṣṭayenānārambhamūlāni nirākṛtāni || iti | nyāyasaṃgrahe ca tathaiva senaśvarācāryāḥ -- vyutpattyabhāvātpratipattidausthyādanyena siddheraphalatvataśca | amātvamāśaṅkya nirācakāra nyāyaiścaturbhiḥ pratipādya tattat || iti | etena ko dharmaḥ ityādivat kiṃ brahma ityādivicāraparyantaphalarūpapramitivaiśiṣṭyamuktam | nanu yadi brahmaśabdo'tra samānyavācī tadā śrīnivāsaśabdena viśeṣyeta | naivamasau, tasmādanyatra aupacārikaḥ ityatraiva sthāpanāt; janmādisūtre niratiśayabṛhadbṛṃhaṇaṃ ca brahma iti nirvacanokteḥ ;kāraṇatvādhikaraṇe ca -- brahmaśabdasya paramātmāsādhāraṇatve'pi pratyagātmanyapi kadācidupacaritaprayogadarśanāt ityādi; viyadadhikaraṇe ca sūtram -- syāñcaikasya brahmaśabdavat iti; tatra ca bhāṣyam -- yathā brahmaśabdaḥ tasmādetadbrahma nāma rūpamannaṃ ca jāyate ityatra pradhāne gauṇatayā prayuktastasminneva prakaraṇe tapasā cīyate brahma tato'nnamabhijāyate ityatra caivaṃ bhāṣyam -- brahmaśabdasya parasminneva brahmaṇi mukhyatvāt iti . nāpi paraśabdavadaupacārikaprayogavyavacchedārtho'tra viśeṣakaḥ śrīnivāsaśabdaḥ, parasminnityanenaiva paryāpteḥ . nāpyekatra rūḍhatve'pyaprasiddhatayā paryāyeṇa bodhanam, tadayogāt; na hyatra kokilaḥ pikaḥ itivadanvayaḥ, asāmarthyāt vākyabhedāñca; na ca tadyuktam, saṃbhavatyekavākyatve vākyabhedastu neṣyate iti nyāyāt | śrīnivāsa iti nāma, anyastu tyaktarūḍhiryogato viśeṣaka iti cāyuktam; aletyādinā gatārthatvāt | atha ca sāmānyavācī brahmaśabdaḥ kvacidbhāti -- samanvayasūtre tāvatsadbrahmādiśabdānāmuttarottaraviśeṣakatvābhiprāyeṇa samabhivyāhāraḥ | ākāśādhikaraṇe'pi -- sadādiśabdāḥ sādhāraṇākārāḥ ityuktam | ārambhaṇādhikaraṇe'pi -- sadbrahmādiśabdāstulyaprakaraṇasthāstattulyaprakaraṇastena nārāyaṇaśabdena viśeṣitāstameva gamayanti iti | pāśupatādhikaraṇe'pi -- sṛṣṭivākyoditaṃ sraṣṭāraṃ nārāyaṇameva samānaprakaraṇasthāḥ sadeva somyedamagra āsīt ityādisadbrahmādiśabdāḥ pratipādayanti iti | ataḥ kathametat ? ittham -- pratyayitagranthasthe parasparavirodhe tātparyatastāvadvirodho nivāryaḥ | yā brahmaśabdasya paramātmanyeva rūḍhirādāveva sthāpitā saiva sarvatreṣṭā | sādhāra ṇyānūktistu bahuśrutyādiprayogadṛṣṭyā kudṛṣṭivādivipratipattyā cātmādiśabdavajjātiśabdatvaṃ yogamātranekarūḍhiṃ vā paśyatāmābhimānikaṃ sādhāraṇyamanvāruhya tadiṣṭānyārthatvaśaṅkānirāsāya syāt | tathāca -- brahmaṇi iti sāmānyaśabdaḥ śrinivāse iti viśeṣaśabdaḥ iti vyākhyāneṣvapyevaṃ gatiḥ | tathātra sādhāraṇyānvāroheṇa śrīnivāsa iti viśeṣaniṣkarṣaḥ syāt | yadvā -- brahmaśabdasyaikarūḍhimanurudhyaiva tadeva śrīnivāsaśabdena viśeṣyate; yā sarvairāśrīyate sā ca tadāśrayeti | ata evātra chāgapaśunyāyo'bhipretaḥ | anyathā caturmukhāditvamapyāśaṅkyeta | ata eva hnīśca te lakṣmīśca patnyau iti paratattvāsādhāraṇapuruṣaśabdārtho'pi śriyaḥ patitvena viśeṣyate | tena kāraṇatvādibhiriva parasmin brahmaśabdarūḍhiḥ sthāpitā syāt | prasiddhatamanāmāntaravācyatvalakṣānvayaḥ śrīnivā saśabdārthe brahmaṇi iti | śrīnivāsasya vā paratvasiddhyai prakṛtākārabṛhattvanimittabrahmaśabdavācyatvaṃ viśeṣaṇīkāryamiti | satyatvādisvarūpanirūpakadharmapañcakanirūpitamapi paraṃ brahma śrīnivāsatvena viśeṣitameva brahmavidyāvedyamityuktaṃ bhavati | śrīsaṃśrayaṇaṃ nityaṃ svarūpavanmūrtyā'pi śrīvatsavakṣā nityaśrīḥ ityabhidhānāt | atra śāntānanta ityādikamanusaṃdheyam | etena paryaṅgavidyādiprasiddhavibhūtyantaravattvaṃ ca bhavatvityāśiṣā prāpyāntarebhyaḥ svādutamo'yamupāya iti vyajyate | tathoktam -- kva nākapṛṣṭhagamanaṃ punarāvṛttilakṣaṇam | kva japo vāsudeveti muktibījamanuttamam || iti | mama; so'haṃ bhagavaḥ śocāmi ityādyuktāvasthasyeti bhāvaḥ | parasmin; sarvaniyantṛtvanirupādhikānandayitṛtvābhyāṃ sā kāṣṭhā sā parā gatiḥ ityāmnātavaśī kāryatvaprāpyatvakāṣṭhābhūte | prāpyatvoktyā rasūm̐hyevāyam ityādisiddhamuktāvasthāśodhanaṃ ca | sṛṣṭyādyupayuktasārvajñyādikṛtsnotkarṣaparamasīmatvaṃ vā paratvam | evaṃ paratvasaulabhyābhyāmabhigamyaṃ siddhaprāpyādirūpaṃ bhajanīyaṃ viśodhitam | paratvaṃ mulabhatvena rahitaṃ nopakārakam | sulabhatvaṃ tathā tena rahitaṃ nopakārakam || 71 || sādhyopāyaśodhane tu, bhakteḥ pūjādimātratvaṃ dhiyaścintādirūpatām | vyavacchettumiha nyastaṃ śemuṣyādi padadvayam || 72 || vedanādiśabdānāṃ paśvādinītyā vakṣyamāṇāyā viśeṣaviśrānteḥ saṃgraho'yam -- śaimu ṣītiḥ; śamādyaṅgikāṃ budiṃdha darśayati | mahanīyaviṣayaprītirbhaktiḥ | prītiśca dhīviśeṣaḥ yādṛśyā dhiyā sā sādhyā pareṣṭā, tādṛśyā eva tattvaṃ yuktam; taduktaṃ bhaktimevādhikṛtya vedārthasaṃgrahe -- yena ca viṣayaviśeṣeṇa viśeṣitaṃ jñānaṃ sukhasya janakamityabhimataṃ tadviṣayaṃ jñānameva sukham; tadatireki padārthāntaraṃ nopalabhyate; tenaiva sukhitvavyavahāropapatteśca iti | snehapūrvamanudhyānaṃ bhaktirityabhidhīyate iti ca | āpādacūḍaṃ śāstrārtha itthamatrānuvarṇitaḥ | prasiddhiravadhitsāyā yathāsthānaṃ bhaviṣyati || 73 || evaṃ śāstrārtho'nukrāntaḥ | viśeṣataśvobhayaliṅgapādagatyā dhyeyaṃ śodhyate -- pūrvadvikasiddhe'pi brahmatattve punastatprabhāvaviśeṣasthāpanātiśayātpādo vidyānānātvokteśca; tadihākhiletyādinā svāpnaprapañcāderapi janmādihetutvena paratvādiśayoktyā saṃdhyādyadhikaraṇacatuṣṭayābhipretaṃ kṣetriṇāṃ svapnasuṣuptyādeḥ kāraṇaṃ parasyākuṇṭhitavicitraśaktitvaṃ vyañjitam | vidīpte śrīnivāse iti padābhyāṃ mitho'nupamardivyāvṛttividhirūpaviśeṣaṇavargopalakṣaṇāt na sthānato'pi parasya ityuktaparaśabdaupādānāñcobhayaliṅgadhikriyārthaṃ udāhṛtaḥ | cidacidanupravesādisaṃgrahāt līlaśabdasāmarthyāñcāṃśato'pi svasya svayamevājñatvāpādanaśaṅkāpratikṣepādahikuṇḍalādhikaraṇoktaṃ smāritam | parisminniti kāraṇasyaivātra paratvoktyā paramataḥ ityadhikaraṇārtho'pi ravyāpitaḥ | vinatetyādinā phalamataḥ ityuktaṃ darśitam | śeṣeṣārthasiddhopāsisiṣāsūcanamiti | prakārāntareṇāpi dhyeyamiha śodhyate -- pūrvaṃ dviliṅagapādasya prakriyā pariśodhitā | nārāyaṇānuvākādinirṇītārthastvihocyate || 74 || atra hyakhiletyādinā sarvakāraṇatvaṃ, vinatetyādinā mokṣārthasarvavidyāvedyatvaṃ, śrutiśirasi vidīpta ityanena sarvopaniṣadekapratipādyatvaṃ ca parasya brahmaṇa uktvā tasya śrīnivāsatvaṃ ca vadato'yaṃ bhāvaḥ -- kāraṇaṃ tu dhyeyaḥ ityādiṣu sarvakāraṇameva mumukṣordhyeyaṃ śrutam | tadeva sadvabrahmādiśabdairuktam | te ca na bhinnaviṣayāḥ, sarvatra jagatkāraṇasyaikatvottayā vikatpasamuñcayāyogāt, kṛtsnavedaprāmāṇye viścite sarveṣāmanyamasya tyāgāyogāñca; anyathā vivadhaghaṭanyāyenetaraprahāyogāñca | ata ekhaviṣayatve siddhe brahmeśānādiniṣedhayuktabhūyiṣṭhābādhitārthasāttvikabahūpabṛṃhaṇānuguṇamahopaniṣatpaṭhitānanyasādhāraṇarūḍhyāspadanārāyaṇa śabdoktaḥ śrīpatireva sadādiśabdārthaḥ | kāraṇaviṣayaparavidyopāsyanirdhāraṇaṃ ca nārāyaṇānuvākaviṣayaliṅgabhūyastvādhikaraṇasiddham | sarveṣāṃ ca kāraṇavākyānāṃ sarvavedapaṭhitapuṃsūktaikārthyaṃ yuktam | tatpratipādyañca śrīpatirityuttarānuvākasiddham | kāraṇaviṣayahiraṇyagarbhaśabdasya adbhyaḥ saṃbhūto hiraṇyagarbha hatyaṣṭau iti śrutyaiva śrīpativiṣayatvaṃ darśitam | evaṃ pusūktaśabdārthapratyabhijñayā śvetāśvataropaniṣadādayo'pi vyākhyātāḥ | ataḥ sarve vedā yatraikaṃ bhavanti vedaiśca sarvairahameva vaidyaḥ ityādisiddhamiha sthāpitam | ata eva puruṣanārāyaṇottaranārāyaṇānuvākānāmaikakaṇṭhyena śrīnivāse brahmaṇi iti śranivāsa eva brahmaśabdārthaḥ | parapakṣanirāsaśca kṛtaḥ śāsraikadeśataḥ | vyajyate'sminpadaistaistaiḥ padye śāsrārthasaṃgrahe || 75 || vyanaktyakhilaśabdo'tra cidacidbhedasatyatām | ekasminnapi tadvyaktirbhāgabhedavyapekṣayā || 76 || arthendriyagataistadvadubhayānubhayāśritaiḥ | vinā doṣairihādhyakṣaṃ bādhyamicchansvadhīhaḥ || 77 || bhedasatyatvapakṣasya bhedamithyātvapakṣataḥ | vibhāgo yidi mithyā syādvyāhatiḥ sarvatomukhī || 78 || ananyaparavākyoktavibhūtiguṇavigrahāni | abādhitvaina netavyā neti netyādayaḥ prabhau || 79 || śrutistu nityanirdoṣā svataḥprāmāṇyaśālinī | alaukike'rthe na kṣepyā sveṣṭadūrādbhutoktivat || 80 || mithoṃ'śānāṃ saśeṣaiśca śeṣasyaikyaṃ nigṛhṇatī | akhiloktiranekāntavādānapi vilumpati || 81 || viśvametadanekāntaṃ vadato vihatityajaḥ | na sādhyadūṣyasiddhāntarāgadveṣādisaṃbhavaḥ || 82 || nañprayogaśca sārtho'sau yathāvyutpatti bodhakaḥ | abhāvasyānupākhyatvaṃ hanti nirbādhabodhataḥ || 83 || bhānāntaramabhāvo'sau padārthāntarameva vā | dvidhāpi niḥsvabhāvatvaṃ tatsvabhāve kathaṃ bhavet || 84 || caturvidhāṇumanasāmākāśādeśca nityatām | asyatyakhilajanmoktyā nityamanyuttu śāsrataḥ || 85 || sajjāyeteti kaṇṭhoktakāryasattvāpalāpinaḥ | sattārthadhātuniṣpannabhuvaloktyā nirākṛtāḥ || 86 || sadasaktoṭinirmuktakalpanā hi nirarthikā | sadasadrūpapakṣoktavirodhasyāviśeṣataḥ || 87 || bhāvābhāvavikalpe tu koṭhyantaramasaṃbhavi | vyaktyadhyāsavisṛṣṭyādi vikāreṣu vivakṣatām || 88 || janmavyāharaṇādbādhaḥ kṛtaḥ śrutyādidarśitāt | abhivyakteranāditve kārakāṇāmanarthatā || 89 || tadāgantukatāmicchan kiṃ nānyatraivamicchati | visṛṣṭiḥ kvacidiṣṭaiva vikāso'pi daśāntaram || 90 || vikāsatadvatoraikye vyāghātaḥ sāṃkhyapakṣavat | eka eva nimittaṃ copādānaṃ ceti sūcanāt || 91 || yogavaiśeṣikādyuktaṃ yukyābhāsamabhāṣata | kartā svaparasaṃyoge samavāyī ca viśvakṛt || 92 || na ca kampreṣu saṃyogaṃ nityaṃ bhauteṣu bhāvayet | janayansvasukhādīni dṛṣṭo jīvo'pi tatra ca || 93 || kartṛtvasamavāyitve kāṇādairapi dustyaje | bahu syāmiti mantuśca vikāraḥ parikalpitaḥ | śarīradvārataḥ sṛṣṭeḥ sūcanātpratyaruthyata || 94 || kramājjanmādi sarveṣāmekatastaditīraṇāt | kṣaṇabhaṅga pravāheśapakṣaścātra parākṛtaḥ || 95 || sthirāpekṣā hyanumitiḥ sthirābhāvaṃ na sādhayet | na ca pratyakṣamakṣobhyapratyakṣāntarabādhataḥ || 96 || sargapralayavādānāmānyaparyānmṛṣārthatā | ardhalokāyatārūḍhairuktāpyatra bahiṣkṛtā || 97 || anupraveśādi vadannirācakre yathāśruti | sāmānādhikaraṇyasya bādhaikyādiprayuktatām || 98 || viśiṣṭaviṣayānekasāmānādhikaraṇyataḥ | virbhedaikārthatāṃ tasya vadanta iha vāritāḥ || 99 || cārvākādimataṃ cātra hetvādyuktyā nivartitam | nirānandoktipakṣaśca salīlatvena khaṇḍitaḥ || 100 || bahuśrutyādisiddhatvādbādhaleśavimuktyā | līloktyaivaikyapakṣeṣu sraṣṭṛtvāyoga ucyate || 101 || saṃpalpādhyasanaṃ tāpanna vikalpaṃ sahediha | acetanatayā nityamavidyāvṛttimātrayoḥ || 102 || saṃkalpādhyasanaṃ tāvanna vikalpaṃ sahediha | acetanatayā nityamavidyāvṛttimātrayoḥ || 103 || tryaṃśasadbrahmavāde ca suṣuptasyeśitustadā | acijjīvasamānasya na līlodyamasaṃbhavaḥ || 104 || nityasarvajñatāśrutyā suṣuptiścāsya bādhitā | kālādhīnaprabodhāderanaiśvasyaṃ ca dustyajam || 105 || suṣuptiśca prabodhaśca prāksaṃkalpāditi tvasat | anantānubhavānandajihāsāmupapattitaḥ || 106 || nācitsaṃkalpayennāpi jīvo'siddhendriyādikaḥ | īśvaraḥ śāntanirdo'pi kuryānnānarthamātmanaḥ || 107 || nityaprabuddha īśāṃśo'pyato nedṛgvihāravān | bhoktṝṇāṃ svātmatādātmyaṃ na vetti na hi sarvavit || 108 || vinatādipadaisatra jīvānāmitaretaram | iśitrā ca svarūpaikyaṃ tattanmānaiḥ parāsyate || 109 || asarvajño'hamityātmā yenādhyakṣeṇa gṛhyate | sarvajñaikyamatistasya na tacchaktyāpi saṃbhavet || 110 || nānātmano vyavasthāta ityanyairapi sūtritam | viruddhadharmasaṃsargaṃ vyanakti vividhoktitaḥ || 111 || varṇādyairnantuvaividhyādalepakamataṃ hatam | yāvajjīvaṃ mumukṣośca taddharmo niścalīkṛtaḥ || 112 || atyāśramibhya ityetatpraśastāśramayogataḥ | alepaśca śrutaḥ pāpaiḥ pramādāttairiti sthitiḥ || 113 || taduparyādisūtroktā sarvadevaikasevyatā | vyañjitā vividhoktyaiva tattatpāramyamuttaye || 114 || vrātaśabdaina jīvānāmānantyamapi sūcayan | itaḥ prāksarvamuktiḥ syāditi codyamavārayat || 115 || ātmānantyādamuktānāṃ muktānāmapyanantatā | ānantyatāratamyena saddravyādinayādbhavet || 116 || eko jīva itaḥ pūrvamamukto hetvanāgamāt | iti paśyannanekeṣu tathātvaṃ kiṃ na paśyati || 117 || mukternatibhavatvoktyā nityamuktirnirākṛtā | svarūpasya na muktitvaṃ siddhasādhyavirodhataḥ || 118 || kriyātacchaktyapūrvādyaiḥ svargādīti paroditam | nantṛrakṣaṇadīkṣoktyā nirastaṃ nigamāptayā || 119 || vidhyapekṣe tu vaidhārthadvāre śrutyaiva darśite | śrutahānādiranyāyyo rātrisatrādinītitaḥ || 120 || natirakṣādijīveśavyāpārapratipādanāt | sākṣimātratvamanayostattaduktamapāsyata || 121 || vedānityatvavādaśca vedojjhitapathastathā | anumeyesapakṣaśca śrutyādyuktyā nirāritaḥ || 122 || īśituḥ saguṇatvena bhaṅguratvādi sādhayan | dharmigrāhakavedāntavidīptidhvastadṛṣiṭikaḥ || 123 || avedyatvamavācyatvamapi proktaṃ kudṛṣṭibhiḥ | nigamāntavidīptatvanirdeśena nivartitam || 124 || upāsanādyanarhaṃ yattadbrahma śrutamityuśan | parasya vidyupāsyādiviṣayatvoktito hataḥ || 125 || na vibhvastīti vadatāṃ tattanmānaiḥ praṇuttaye | bṛhattvamaparicchedyaṃ brahmaśabdena darśitam || 126 || bhāgabhedādyayogena vibhutattvasya nihnave | aṇuṣvapi sa durvāraḥ sarvāsattve svavāgghatiḥ || 127 || vyatirekagrahāyogādvibhu kāraṇamuñjhataḥ | abādhyaśrutisiddhyaiva tatsidiṃdha samadarśayat || 128 || kāraṇatvādidharmāṇāṃ pratiyogimatāmapi | akālpanikatāṃ prāha tathā tanmānabodhanāt || 129 || sveṣṭasvaparanirvāhanyāyātsaṃbandha āśritaḥ | nānavasthitaye nātiprasaktyai ceti bhāvyatām || 130 || śrīnivāsapadenātra nirviśaṅkārthavācinā | trimūrtisāmyatādātmyavyaktyantarajuṣaḥ kṣatāḥ || 132 || anyoktiḥ paravidyāsu niruktyādeḥ parāśrayā | talliṅgānanyathāsiddhau tadviśiṣṭāvalambinī || 132 || bāhyaiḥ kudṛṣṭibhiścoktāstrimūrtyuttīrṇaklṛptayaḥ | brahmaṇaḥ śrīnivāsasya paratvoktyā parāhatāḥ || 133 || āpnoti paramityetatsūcayan paraśabdataḥ | svātmaprāptyādimātrasya nirācakre'parargatām || 134 || parānubhūternābhāvo na ca hrāso niraṃhasaḥ | aniḥśeṣitakarmā tu mukta ityupacaryatām || 135 || paratvamanavacchinnaṃ muktādibhyo'pi hi śrutam | tataḥ sarvaguṇātyantasāmyavādo'pyapoditaḥ || 136 || ekībhāvaśrutiścatra prakāraikyavivakṣayā | śuddhāśuddhāmbuyoge hi tādṛktvaṃ śrutidarśitam || 137 || trayyantadīptatāmuktvā bhakterāśāsanātpunaḥ | śabdato'dhyakṣasaṃvitterasaṃbhava udāhṛtaḥ || 138 || ātmano'nahamarthatvaṃ vadatāmapanuttaye | mametīritamātmānamahamarthaṃ nyadarśayat || 139 || śemuṣyādipadābhyāṃ tu karmadhītadvikalpayoḥ | vākyārthaikyamateścātrānupāyatvaṃ pradarśitam || 140 || boddhṛbuddhibhidāmatra mamakāreṇa darśayan | viṣayagrāhiṇī buddhirātmeti matamacchinat || 141 || mama svarūpamitivadbhedoktirupacārataḥ | ityasad bdhavirahādanyathātiprasaṅgataḥ || 142 || bādhaḥ svārasiko nāsti saṃvidāṃ boddhṛbodhyayoḥ | kutarkairyadi śemuṣyā pratibandīmasūcayat || 143 || viṣayeṇāśrayeṇāpi svadharmeṇāpi śemuṣīm | viśiṃṣaṃstannirākatarṝnnirāsthaditi manmahe || 144 || evaṃ tu jīvaparayoḥ svarūpaikyābhimāninām | atra śārīrakārambhastrayāṇāmuparudhyate || 145 || mithyābhūtasya bandhasya tattvabuddhyaiva bādhanāt | tatpradhānamidaṃ śāstramārabhyamiti durbhaṇam || 146 || pramitasyāsya satyasya parabhaktyā vināśanam | pratipādayatānena parārambho nivāritaḥ || 147 || na jījñāseta dhīratra jñātṛtvādiprahāṇataḥ | jñātṛbhūto'hamarthaścennārabheta svanāśanam || 148 || svaduḥkhaśāntaye kaścitsvanāśaṃ mūḍha icchati | na tathātra gatakleśasvātmasthitisamarthanāt || 149 || itthaṃ brahmapraticchandajīvapakṣe'pi dūṣaṇam | īśvaro'pi na jijñāsuḥ sārvajñyādhyāsasaṃmateḥ || 150 || bhāvābhāvātmakāśeṣaviśeṣojjhitavarṣmaṇaḥ | jijñāsākarmatāpyatra viśiṣṭoktyaiva bādhitā || 151 || viṣayatvaprahāṇāñca jijñāsyatvaṃ vihanyate | na hyatropahite cintā na ca sā bhrāntiśāntikṛt || 152 || avedye hi na jijñāsā sā cetkathamavedyatā | na ca koṭidvayonmuktaṃ kiṃcitsyādvyāhatatvataḥ || 153 || jñeyatve cātmatā na syāddhaṭādivaditi tvasat | saha dṛṣṭerdvayorvahnervastutvoṣṇatvayoriva || 154 || karmakartṛvirodhaśca svadṛṣṭau bhaṅgagumbhitaḥ | na hi dṛṣṭe viruddhatvaṃ ca dṛṣṭiḥ śakyanihna vā || 155 || avedyamiti vedyatve vedyatvaṃ svīkṛtaṃ bhavet | avedyamityavedyatve vedyatvamanapoditam || 156 || avedyamityavācyatve vācyatve'pi ca vastunaḥ | vācyataiva bhavettasya vācyāvācyavaco'nvayāt || 157 || provācāvacanetyādyā uktyāśca parātmanaḥ | aparicchedyatārthāḥ syurna cetsvoktyādibhiḥ kṣatiḥ || 158 || jñānatvājjñeyatā nāsti jñātṛtāpyātmanastviti | dṛṣṭaśrutivinirghūtaṃ jñānatvaṃ tu svabhāsanāt || 159 || kiṃca śrutiśirasyeva vidīptiṃ vadatā vibhoḥ | pareṣāṃ vyajyate'rtheṣu trayyantanirapekṣatā || 160 || svaprakāśā matirdhītvāddṛśyatvādvimataṃ mṛṣā | ityādyaireva siddhe'rthe kṛtaṃ trayyantacintayā || 161 || saguṇopāsanādīnāṃ siddhyai tañcintanaṃ yadi | tañcedadvaitadhīsiddhyai taddṛthā tadvirodhataḥ || 162 || phalāntarārthaṃ tañcintā yadīṣyate tathā sati | mokṣapradhānaśāstratvaṃ gataṃ śārīrakasya te || 163 || śrutivākyaprasūtā dhīrbādhikā nānumānikī | iti vaktuṃ na te śakyamadṛṣṭasyānapekṣaṇāt || 164 || anumānāñca vākyāñca rajjusarpādivibhrame | aviśeṣeṇa bādho hi dṛṣṭastadvadihāstu te || 165 || pratyakṣaṃ śabdajanyaṃ ca duḥsādhaṃ niṣphalaṃ ca te | parokṣādapi śabdārthāt kvacid bādhasya saṃmateḥ || 166 || na cānumānāśaktasya vākyamityapi yujyate | sarvamānāntarānarhe śāstramānatvasādhanāt || 167 || anekaniyamopetavākyacintāvidhervaram | lokadṛṣṭyanusāreṇa śrutādeśca kṣamānumā || 168 || jñātedṛśānumānānāṃ bhrāntirna bhraśyatīti cet | jñātatādṛśavākyānāṃ samaṃ tatsaṃbhramādṛte || 169 || dvaitādvaitamate'pyevamārambho'nupapattimān | na hi sarvavidaścintyaṃ jīvasya na tadaikyataḥ || 170 || upādhitaḥ svato vātra bhede satyapi kiṃ bhavet | rāmādibhedādvaiṣamyaṃ sarvajñaikyasamatvataḥ || 171 || sarveṣu cāvatāreṣu nityaṃ sarvārthavedinaḥ | suṣuptibhramaduḥkhādyaṃ prāhuḥ śailūṣanītitaḥ || 172 || icchayā saṃsṛtiścāpi na śakyamiti bhāṣitum | parecchā tava jīvecchā tanmūlaśca bhavo yataḥ || 173 || jñātasvajīvatādātmyaḥ śaktaścetprasahedbhavam | aśakto yadi mokṣārthaṃ jijñāseta kathaṃ param || 174 || ato jīveśayorbhedamabhedasparśavarjitam | babhāṣe nantṛnantavyarakṣyarakṣakatādibhiḥ || 175 || itthaṃ nivārito bhedābhedavādavidhāyinoḥ | dvayorapi ca śāstrasya prārambhaḥ prātikūlyataḥ || 176 || svamate tu svarakṣārthaviśiṣṭaviṣayotthiteḥ | niḥśeṣamiha nirdhūtāḥ śāstrānīrambhahetavaḥ || 177 || jñātamajñātamapi vā na jijñāsyamiti tvasat | viditāviditākārabhedenaivopavarṇanāt || 178 || siddhaṃ dharmiṇamuddiśya sādhyadharmavidhānataḥ | itthamevānumāne'pi vādino'pyanumenire || 179 || vyutpattidvārasiddhe'pi tadviśeṣe'pi śāstrataḥ | alaukike'rthe samabhivyāhārātsā hi saṃmatā || 180 || nedaṃ śāstraṃ nirviṣayam, śrotavyo mantavyaḥ iti śrutyunūditaviṣayokteḥ | nāpyasau bhrāntyā mānāntareṇa vā siddhaḥ, virbādhe śrutiśirasyeva vidīptatvāt | na ca nirūpitaḥ, pūrvakāṇḍayorānyaparyāt; śāstrāntare tu prasaṅgābhāvādviruddhokteśca | na ca dhvāṅkṣadantasaṃkhyāvadanirūpyaḥ, svagṛhavinikṣiptabṛhannidhisāmyāt tadadhīnabṛṃhaṇatvarūparakṣokteśca | na ca muktiḥ siddhā, pratyakṣādivirodhāt | nāpyanyena sādhyā, dehādisṛṣṭyā bandhakasyaiva puruṣasya svanantṛmuktihetutvāt | nāpyanyena nirodhyā, etasya svāyattākhilasattākatayā niḥsamābhyadhikatvāt | na tato'pi sā duṣprāpā, tasya tadekadīkṣitatvāt | na svargādivatpunarāvṛttyādibhirdurantā, nigrahāderniḥśeṣanivṛttatvāt | na ca samavyatyayaphalā, sukhopāyena niravadhikasukhalabdheḥ | nāpyatrādhikāryabhāvaḥ, yathāśruti vinatavividhabhūta iti sāmānyataḥ mama iti viśeṣataśca vyañjanāditi | pratitantravihīnatvādanārabhyatvamityapi | asādhāraṇarūpeṇa bhāṣaṇena nirākṛtam || 181 || śrūyate hi sarvaśarīratvaṃ sarvāntyāmitvamityādyarthajātamatraiva | athavā, sarvāniṣṭamihānuktaṃ tāvatāpi kimāgatam | tasmātprāmāṇikaṃ cintyaṃ pareṣṭamathavānyathā || 182 || ābhimānikamānaiśca siddhāntāḥ sthāpitāḥ paraiḥ | sādhāraṇyaṃ kva vā na syādvaipulyāddeśakālayoḥ || 183 || pratipadamiha yukiṃta bhāṣyakārāśayasthāṃ kathayitumuta mantuṃ kaḥ prabhustāṃ prabhūtām | tadapi katicidasmaddarśitaṃ kiṃcidetacchataphalamavayantaḥ svādayiṣyanti santaḥ || 184 || atraivaṃ paragurustutyādiviśiṣṭamaṅgalāntarṇītaparamaviṣayādyuktyāsya śāstrasyānīrabhyatvamapyapāstam | pārāśaryavacassudhāmupaniṣaddugdhābdhimadhyoddhṛtāṃ saṃsāragnividīpanavyapagataprāṇātmasañjīvanīm | pūrvācāryasurakṣitāṃ bahumativyāghātadūrasthitā mānītāṃ tu nijākṣaraiḥ sumanaso bhaumāḥ pibantvanvaham || atha namaskṛtya hṛṣīkeśam namo bhagavate tasmai vyāsāya ityādyācārakrameṇāvaragurukīrtanādirūpamaṅgalagarbhāvāntaraviṣayādyuktyā vidhitsitasya svaprabandhasyānārayabhtāṃ nirasyati -- pārāśarya ityādinā vyākhyāsyante ityantena | kuhakoktaṃ bhramoktaṃ vā niṣphalaṃ niṣparigraham | spaṣṭaṃ durnirvahaṃ boddhṛhīnamanyojjvalaṃ na hi || 185 || yadyetacchāstraṃ lokāyatādivatpratārakaproktaṃ bhrāntimūlaṃ niṣprayojanamaparigṛhītaṃ spaṣṭārthaṃ vivakṣite netumaśakyamanadhikārikamanyataścaritārthaṃ vā syāt, na tarhi vyākhyeyamiti śaṅkātra kṣipyate | parān bāhyakudṛṣṭīn pramāṇatarkaśarairāśrṛṇātīti parāśaraḥ; tasyāpatyaṃ parāśaryaḥ; na tādṛśāpatyamatādṛksyāditi vyaktyai pārāśaryoktiḥ | śrutiśca -- sa hovāca vyāsaḥ pārāśaryaḥ iti | atra svaguṇaḥ pitṛguṇena ravyāpyate | nātra sūtrakṛdbādarāyaṇanāmānya iti mantavyam ; dvīpe badarikāmiśre bādarāyaṇamacyutam | parāśarātsatyavatī putraṃ lebhe paraṃtapam || ityādiprasiddheḥ | tasya ca brahmasūtrakṛttvaṃ ca skāndoktam -- avatīrṇo mahāyogī satyavatyāṃ parāśarāt | utsannānbhagavānvedānujjahāra hariḥ svayam || caturdhā vyabhajattāṃśca caturviṃśatidhā punaḥ | śatadhā caikadhā caiva tathaiva ca sahasradhā || kṛṣṇo dvādaśadhā caiva punastasyārthavittaye | cakāra brahmasūtrāṇi yeṇāṃ sūtratvamañjasā || iti | brahmasūtrapadaiścaiva iti bhāvidarśibhagavadvākyaṃ sūtrapaścādbhāvi vā svayameva bhārate nyabadhnāt | sūtraviṣayatayā ca tadvākyarūpā praktanī bhāvinī vā kṛtirudahniyata iti na paurvāparyavirothaḥ | atha vānādisiddhatvātsmṛtisūtrapravāhayoḥ | parasparagṛhītistu na virodhāya kalpate || 186 || āha ca parabhāṣyavyākhyātā -- brahmasūtrakṛte vedavyāsāyāparavedhase | jñānaśaktyavatārāya namo bhagavato hareḥ || iti | sudhāśabdenāsyārthasya bhogyatvaṃ darśayatīti vivaraṇam | atra ca -- vacasaḥ sudheti vigrahe sudhāśabdasya gauṇī vṛttiḥ | rūpakaprakaraṇānurūpyeṇa vā vacaḥśabdalakṣitastadarthaḥ sudhātvena rūpyate | yadvā -- sūtrameva vā sudheti rūpitam | upaniṣadvimarśotthanyāyarūpārthadvārā tūddhṛtatvādyuktiḥ | nanu śleṣopaskṛtanijākṣarānītatvādisāmānyaprayoge kathamiha upamitam ityādinā samāsaḥ ? ittham -- samāsasūcyaṃ svādutvasāmānyamihāprayuktam; tadanyasya prayoge'pi na doṣaḥ; bhāṣyābdhiḥ kvātigambhīraḥ ityādivat | vaidharmyarūpatvaṃ vā viśeṣaṇeṣviha sarveṣu yojyam | sudhā hi amṛtākṣaropacaritairanyasya chandaso'kṣarairānītā; iyaṃ tu svākṣairareva | sudhā kila kevaladugghābdhimadhyoddhṛtā, iyaṃ tu upanipaddugvābdhimadhyoddhṛtā | itthaṃ śeṣamapi yojyam | sādharmyātsvādutāsiddhistathā svādutamatvadhīḥ | vaidharmyāditi vaiṣamyaṃ bhāvyamatra manīṣibhiḥ || 187 || yad vivakṣitasāmānyaṃ tatprayogo niṣidhyate | uktistadanyasāmānyaviṣayā na virudhyate || 188 || vivakṣitaṃ tu sāmānyaṃ svādutvādikamiṣyate | tatpunarnocyate sākṣātsamāsastena sidhyati || 189 || avivakṣitasāmānyaprayogaḥ kāvyaśāstrayoḥ | dṛśyate bahuśastasmānna samāso'tra duṣyati || 190 || oṣadhībhyo cathāmṛtam itivacchiraḥśabdābhiprāyavyaktyartha upaniṣacchabdaḥ | upa niṣīdati avyavadhānena nityaṃ samanvetītyananyaparāṃśoktiḥ; tathā ca vākyam -- upaniṣaṇṇatvādvā upaniṣat iti | tatra dramiḍabhāṣyam -- gahane hīyaṃ vidyā saṃniviṣṭā iti | tasya ca vāmanaṭīkā -- gahane brahmaṇi upaniṣaṇṇā iti | bhāṣyasya sūtrāṇi, teṣāmupaniṣadaḥ, tāsāṃ brahyeti viṣayakramaḥ | prayojanāni ca yathārhāṇi | āraṇyakaṃ ca vedebhyaḥ iti śruti dhenusārabhūtasvādutamarasatayā ānantyagāmbhīryādibhiśca dugdhābdhitvoktiḥ | madhyasyāśeṣaparyantāsattisāmyāttadaktyā sarvaśrutyānuguṇyavyaktiḥ | uddhṛtatvoktyārthasyākalpitatvamāmūlaṃ grahaṇaṃ ca ravyāpyam | saṃsāretyādikamapekṣitatamāvāntaraprayojanakathanam, asti brahyeti cedveda ityādiśruteḥ; vākyārthanirdhāraṇe ca sūtrāṇāṃ viśramāt | acidbhirekīkṛtya janmādipravāhaprāptuḥ sasāraḥ | yadvā saṃsaratyaneneti saṃsāraḥ karma; sa tu svargāderapi tāpatrayamayatvādagnitayoktaḥ | dīpanaṃ kleśakarmādijvālodgatiḥ; sā cāpavargapratikūlatayā svasaṃsṛṣṭanāśakāvasthā | tadvaividhyamavidyādibhedātpcadhā tridhā dvidhetyādi tatra tatra kathyate | atra śārīrādivividhaduḥkhāvahatayā ca vaiśiṣṭyaṃ viśabdārthaḥ | atra prāṇaḥ prāṇināṃ prāṇanahetuḥ paramātmā, na prāṇena nāpānena martyo jīvati kaścana | itareṇa tu jīvanti yasminnetāvupāśritau || prāṇasya prāṇam, prāṇamevābhisaṃviśanti ityādiśruteḥ | prāṇastu praṇave jīve jīvite paramātmani iti ca paṭhyate | apagataḥ atidūrasthaḥ śāsreṣu darśayatsvapi gūṭayuktyādibhiradya yāvat asadbrahma iti vedyatāṃ prāptaḥ | viśabdaḥ śravaṇādyanyatamenāpyanāghrātatvaparaḥ | viśeṣato vāpagataḥ, svayamavatīrya svātmānaṃ darśayatyapi vyāvṛttatayā durdarśaḥ | atra prāṇo jñānam iti nyāyasudarśanam | ātmanāṃ tadguṇasāratayā tadaṃśoktiḥ | tadā vyapagatiratisaṃkocaḥ | vyapagataprāṇānāṃ saṃjīvanaṃ nāma bāhyakudṛṣṭyanapahāryaprāṇasthāpanam; tanmukhena rakṣoktisaṃkṣiptaparamaprayojanavivaraṇaṃ vaitat | tadā tūpasargeṇa svātmaprāpaṇādimātravyudāsaḥ | pūrvācāryāḥ bauddhajainagandhibhyo'nye | aupadeśikī rakṣā tadaiva tatraiva; grānthikī tu kālantarādyanucchedāt surakṣoktā | rakṣitatvaṃ tu rāmāryaistrayyantārthe hi sūcitam | ātmasiddhyādibhiḥ proktaṃ yāmunāryanibandhanaiḥ || 191 || sudhāsurakṣitaśabdobhyāṃ vaktṛstutirārthī | sudhā tu suragurucakrayantrādibhirdṛḍhaguptā | surakṣitatve'pi tyaktasaṃpradāyaiḥ kudṛgbhiḥ kṣobhitatvamāha -- bahu iti | bahvyaḥ mitho viruddhāḥ bahūnāṃ vā matayaḥ, tābhirvyāghātaḥ vividhā abhivyāptā pīḍā; svārasikadhīvirodha ityarthaḥ | tena dūrasthitāṃ boddhṝṇāṃ rajastamastāratamyādabodhāsamagrabodhānyathābodhārhāmityarthaḥ | abodhaścāyathābodhastattvabodhavirodhinau | aniśyitāvabodhe'pi tathābodhakatā sthitā || 192 || sadbhiryadi vigīyeta na saṃgṛhye paścimaiḥ | na tanmatānusāraśca satyaḥ syādvyājihīrṣataḥ || 193 || kudṛṣṭibhiśca bāhyaiśca yadi vābhyupagamyate | kaḥ svapakṣatayā rakṣyaḥ parapakṣaśca ko bhavet || 194 || tadatra caturadhyāyyāṃ sādhanākṣepabhāgayoḥ | nidānamabhisaṃdhāya nirdiṣṭaṃ bhedato dvayam || 195 || sudhā tu viruddhamatidaityādivyāghātabhayāt dūrasthitā | yadvā kadrūvijitāyāḥ suparṇyāstathā bahumativyāghātadaśāyāmātmaniṣkrayaṇārthamāhartavyatayā dūre tṛtīyasyāṃ divi sthitā | svavyākhyānasyāpyanyairvyāghātādasāsarthyaparihāra ityatrāha -- ānītām buddhyāsanne svārthe sthāpitām | etena vyākhyātadvatoḥ saṃbandhaḥ śodhitaḥ | pareṣṭavyāvahārikasādhakavyāvṛttyai tadvyanakti -- nijākṣarairiti | vacaḥprastāvāttadakṣarāṇi nijākṣarāṇi, sūtrākṣarāṇīti vakṣyamāṇatvāt | yathā vivaraṇam -- sūtrākṣarāṇi yamarthaṃ svarasato bodhayanti sa eva sāṃpradāyikaḥ; vaktuḥ svasamīhitārthavācakaśabdaprayogavyutpatteḥ svarasataḥ parapratyāyanārthatvācchabdaprayogasya iti | bahūnāṃ vyākhyānānāṃ mitho vyāghāte vyākhyeyasvārasyaṃ saṃpradāyavyavasthāpakamiti bhāvaḥ | sudhā tu sosākhyā sauparṇākhyānaprasiddhairgāyatryavayavairamṛtākṣaraiḥ sahānīti | maduktibhiriti vārthaḥ | tantrataḥ sudhāsamādhisiddhyai tathānuktiḥ | sudhāyāḥ sumanaso devā bhoktāraḥ | yadvā gāyatttryabhimānisuparṇānītāyāḥ somalatārūpeṇa pariṇatāyā ekāhādyupayuktāyā bhaumāḥ sumanasaḥ pratisamayaṃ bhoktāraḥ | vacorūpāyāstu brāhmaṇā vividiṣanti itivat codanānarhavyāvṛttāḥ sārāsāravivekajñāḥ ityādinā svenaivānyatroktāḥ | etena brahmavidyāsaṃpradānamapi śikṣyate | śrutaṃ hyetacchāndogye -- idaṃ vāva tajjyeṣṭhāya putrāya pitā brahma prabrūyātpraṇāyyāya vāntevāsine nānyasmai kasmaicana yadyapyasmā imāmadbhiḥ parigṛhītāṃ dhanasya pūrṇo dadyādetadeva tato bhūyaḥ iti | praṇāyyaḥ praśritatvānasūyutvaṛjutvādibhiryogyaḥ | na hi bhaumāḥ sumanasa iti bhūsuramātroktiryuktā, adhītavedavarṇatrayārhatvānmīmāṃsāyāḥ | svato viduṣāṃ svargādibhuvāṃ prāyo na sūtravyākhyānāpekṣā; satyamapi tasyāṃ viśāladhīyogyairvṛttyadibhiste caritārthāḥ; ato na vṛthātra bhaumatvoktiḥ | pibantu; ayatnaṃ sukhamanubhavantu | yatno hi sudhāyā manthanatastadānayanataśca | anvaham; atigambhīratvādatyantahṛdyatvāñca | sudheyaṃ sūtrakāreṇa hariṇeva samuddhṛtā | ānītā bhāṣyakāreṇa dvijendreṇeti cāśayaḥ || 196 || bhāvadbodhāyanakṛtāṃ vistīrṇāṃ brahmasūtravṛtiṃta pūrvācāryāḥ saṃcikṣipuḥ; tanmatānusāreṇa sūtrākṣarāṇi vyākhyāsyante | tathāpi kimahardīpavadanupakārakṛtakaranirmāṇagauraveṇa, anucchinnāḥ śuddhāḥ prājīnavyākhyāḥ pravartyantāṃ tatrāha -- bhagavad iti | utpatiṃ pralayaṃ caiva ityādyuktādhyātmabodhātiśayaparo'tra bhāvacchabdaḥ; tena śabaraśaṅkarādivyāvṛttiḥ | vistīrṇatvoktiradyatanaiḥ dustaratvamabhipraiti | atra pūrvācāryā brahmanandyādayaḥ | tannibandhanānāmatisaṃkṣepādgahanatvaṃ sūcayati -- saṃcikṣipuḥ iti | sūtrasthāpitārthaparaiḥ granthairityāśayaḥ | parokteranāptasaṃpradāyatvaṃ vyañjayitumāha -- tanmatānusāreṇa iti | alpākṣaramanalpārtham, laghūni sūcitārthāni svalpākṣarapadāni ca | iti sūtrāṇāṃ bahvarthasūcakālpākṣaratayā vyākhyāpekṣatvāyāha -- sūtrākṣarāṇī ti | prakṛtipratyayorakleśamabhipretyākṣaraśabdaḥ | tena sūtrāṇi yathāsaṃbhavaṃ draṣṭvyānīti paroktiranāstheyā | uktaṃ ca bhāskaraiḥ -- sūtrābhiprāyasaṃvṛtyā svābhiprāyaniveśanāt | vyākhyātaṃ yairidaṃ sūtraṃ vyākhyeyaṃ tannivṛttaye || iti | akṣarārthamātraṃ brūmaḥ, sūcyaṃ tu viśśeṣadurvacam | akṣaraśakhtyatiriktaḥ sphoṭo na kalpyaḥ ityapi vyaṅgyam | vyākhyāsyanta ityatropasargābhyāṃ dhātunā cādyatanabuddhyanuguṇamanatisaṃkocavistaratvaṃ spaṣṭoktiśca vyajyate | yadvā vaiśiṣṭyaṃ prābalyaṃ ca nipātadvayārthaḥ | padacchedaḥ padārthoktiḥ ityādi ca bhāvyam | akhiletyāderetadantasya sūtrārtho varṇyate yatra ityādyuktaṃ bhāṣyalakṣaṇaṃ tadarthasaṃgrahāttādarthyāñca siddham | athāto brahmajijñāsā | atrāyamathaśabda ānantarye bhavati | ataśśabdo vṛttasya hetubhāve | vyākhyāpekṣatvavyaktyai sūtramudgṛhṇāti -- atha iti | nanvatra athātaḥ iti piṇḍitaṃ rūpamatyutpatteḥ pṛthagarthasaṃbhavādaṃśāntaranairarthakyāñca na yuktam / kliṣṭagatistu na gatisadbhāve | athaśabdasyānantarye prasiddhiḥ prakṛṣṭāpi sopayogāsādhāraṇavṛttaviśeṣādṛṣṭyāpoditā | ata eva na prakṛtādarthāntaparatvaṃ, kalpadvayādṛṣṭeśca | praśnastvanarthako'nuttaraśca | kārtsnyamanapekṣitavacanam; ekadeśacintā hi na śaṅkārūḍhā | tasmādārambhārthakatvaṃ syāt | ārabhate hyatra sūtrakāraḥ | maṅgalārthakatvaṃ vā smaryate hi -- oṃkāraścāthaśabdaśca dvāvetau brahmaṇaḥ purā | kaṇṭhaṃ bhittvā viniryātau tasmānprāṅgalikāvapabhau || iti | tatrāha -- atra iti | bhavatinā athaśabdasya svārasyānūktiḥ | atrāyaṃpadābhyāmapavādāpohaḥ | atra vedottarāṃśavicāryatvārthe sūtre | tena yataḥ kutaścidvā bhāgāntarasādhāraṇādvā kutaścidānantaryokterānarthakyāt karmavicārarūpaṃ vṛttaṃ vivinakti | ayam -- athāto dharmajijñāsā athātaḥ kratvarthapuruṣārthajijñāsā ityādiṣvivātaśśabdopetaḥ | etacchabdo hi prastute svarasaḥ; vibhaktiścāsau hetutve | evaṃ sāmānyataḥ ata ityabhihite brahmajijñāsayā viśeṣata ākṣipte vṛtte satyānantaryasvārasyaṃ nāpodyate | athātaḥ iti samuditaprayoganirapekṣasāmarthyavyaktyarthaḥ atrāyaṃśabda iti kecit | atretyādinaivārthāntarāṇāmihānanvayaḥ sūcyate | tathāhi -- maṅgalārthatvaṃ tāvatpratikṣipāmaḥ | tat kimasyāvivakṣitārthasya sannidhimātreṇa, tadvācakatayā vā ? nādyaḥ -- abodhakasya vākye nibandhāyogāt śrutiprayojanamātrasya maṅgalasya padāntarārthe'nanvayāśca, vivakṣitārthāntarasyāpi sannidhyupajīvanopapatteśca | na dvitīyaḥ -- dyotakamātratvāt atha śabdānuśāsanam ityādāvarthaṃ vadadbhirapyadhikṛtamityādipadamadhyāhāreṇoktam; na tvathaśabdavācyatvamabhisandhāya; vācyatva'pyatra maṅgalasya vaktavyā saṅgatiḥ | maṅgalākteḥ prakṛtaupayikamaṅgalatve'pyanuniṣpattyaiva tatsiddhiryuktam | mṛdaṅgadhvaninītiṃ tu vakti māṅgalikasmṛtiḥ | prayoktuśśroturapyetau maṅgalaprāpakāviti || 197 || anyathā brahmaśabdenānyaparatvaṃ, bhinnatvaṃ vākyasya, bhavatvityadhyāhāraśca syuḥ | akṛtakasarvottuṅgamaṅgalatamatattvavācakatvādbrahmaśabdasya | na cātra hetossādhyasya vā maṅgalatvamanūdyate, vidhīyate vā, nairarthakyāt; na hyatra tadviruddhatvāśaṅkā, aniṣedhāt | nyāyasūtrāṇi saṃśayanirāsārthāni | nanu maṅgalatvaṃ vicārasya khyāpyatām, ata eva tadvidhiriti tatmārthatā | tadāpi mandam, ata iti hetunaiva nairākāṅkṣyāt, adhikokteranupayogāñca | ārambhārthatvamapyayuktam, nīrabhyata iti śaṅkānutthānāt sādhyatayā buddhasyārambhasya kathanānarthakyāñca; na ca jijñāsāyā ārambhayogyatvamathaśabdo vakti, dyotayati vā, avyutpatteḥ ārabdhumiti kriyāntarārthakriyānupasthānāt | anyathā samuñcayādidyotakeṣvapi samuccetumityādivivakṣayā yogyapadānvayaprasaṅgāt | ārabdhavyetyeva ca padamadhyāhāryam; tadā kiṃ tadarthenāthaśabdena ? na cātrādhyāhārārthadyotanam, sākṅkṣtayaiva tatsiddheḥ prasiddhaprahāṇena kliṣṭagrahaṇāyogāñca | yogaśabdānuśāsanayorānantaryamagatyā tyaktam | atra tu na śāstrarambhārthatāpi | anyo hi vicāraḥ, anyadanuśāsanam | na ca tasyātropādānam | nanu jñāpyatayā brahmādhikriyatām; maivam -- upasarjanaśravaṇavilambāt vyākhyānānuśāsanaśabdābhāvādeva jijñāsāśabdasya mīmāṃsāparyāyatvābhāvena jñāpyatānupasthāpanāñca | ata eva vicāraḥ kartavyatvena bodhyatayādhikriyata ityapi na vācyam, vicārārambhaṇīyatvasthāpanenaiva siddhe padāntaravaiyarthyāt apekṣite satyanapekṣitāyogāt ubhayoktyā gauravāñca | tasmātsvārasikamanapoditamānantaryamevātra sthāpitam | ataśśabdasya prakṛtirdhīsthe vartiṣyamāṇe'pi syāt; pratyayaśca sārvavibhaktikaḥ | ato'tha maunam ityādiṣvanyārthaḥ | pañcamyartho'pyanekaḥ | ato nārthaviśeṣasiddhirityāha -- ataśśabda iti | ihāpyatrāyaṃbhavatīnāmanuṣaṅgaḥ, svārasyāt, uttarapadasamabhivyāhāraśca prāgvat | vicāritakarmaṇāṃ brahmavicārahetutayā vakṣyamāṇaheturanupalambhanirastaḥ | brahmavicārāpekṣayā vartiṣyamāṇasya tu na taddhetutvam | prayojanamapi na svarūpeṇa hetuḥ, mithassaṃśrayāt | tadicchā tu vṛttaiva | pratyayasya ca vibhaktyantarārthakatvamapādānatvādi ca prakṛtānupayuktam | ayamiti padasya svarūpamātramanuṣajyate | tenāthaśabdayuktatvamiha vivakṣitam | na caivaṃ mithassaṃśrayaḥ; śabdasvārasyayoḥ svatassiddhatayā svarūpasiddho mitho'napekṣaṇāt, sahakāritvamātrasyaiva mitho'pekṣyatvāñca | ayamiti padaṃ vā nāmuṣañjanīyam | nanvathātaḥpadayoranyatareṇālam; sūtraṃ hyetat; maivam -- prayojanādhikyāt; karmavicāravyavadhāyakaśāstrāntaranairapekṣyadyotanārthatvādathaśabdasya | brahmavicāryatvahetorananyalabhyaprayojanavattvenāpātadhīsthasya viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyāṃśāsiddhivyudāsārthatvādataśśabdasya | brahmavicāryatvahetorananyalabhyaprayojanavattvenāpādadhīsthasya viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyāṃśāsiddhivyudāsārthatvādataśśabdasya | ānantarye'pyahetutvaṃ hetutve'pi vilambanam | dṛṣṭimiṣṭaṃ ca tatsārthaṃ dvayaṃ kāṇḍāntare yathā || 198 || ekaṃ jihāsatastvatra dvitīyaṃ heyamāpatet | svādhikāraṃ svahetuṃ ca vicāraḥ svayamākṣipet || 199 || tasmādārambhasūtre'smin dharmacintādisūtravat | prāyuṅkta prātilobhyena pratijñāditrikaṃ pṛthak || 200 || adhītasāṅgasaśiraskavedasya adhigatālpāsthiphalakevalakarmajñānatayā saṃjātamokṣābhilāṣasya anantasthiraphalabrahmajijñāsā hyanantarabhāvinī | atra kīdṛghvṛttam, yanniyamenāpekṣyam; kīdṛkca vartiṣyamāṇam, yena vṛttaviśeṣākṣepaḥ; tayośca paurvāparye'pi kathaṃ kāryakāraṇamāvaḥ, tatsiddhau ca tṛṇāraṇimaṇinyāyaḥ syāt | tayoralpāsthiraphalānantasthiraphalaśabdābhyāṃ saṃjātetyādinā ca hetuhetumadbhāvavyañjanam | sthitāsthiraśabdāviha nāśarāhityadvattvaparau | karmajñānamīha nirṇayarūpam | tasyādhigatiḥ prāptiḥ; parīkṣya lokānityādibhiralpāsthiraphalatayāvagamo vā | anuṣṭhānadvārā karmajñānasya phalasambandhaḥ | alpāsthiraphalatvaṃ karmaviśeṣaṇaṃ vā | mokṣaviśrāntavidyāṅgakarmavyāvṛttyai kevalaśabdaḥ | anantasthiraphalaśabdaḥ karmadhārayavṛttyā brahmaviśeṣaṇam | bahurvīhitayā vā paraṃparayā mokṣahetubhūtāṃ jijñāsāṃ viśinaṣṭi | samityupasargeṇa hetunirapekṣamānantaryaṃ ca sūcyate | sāṃkhyādiśīlanajanyā duḥkhadṛṣṭimātrajanyā vā mumukṣā hi samījīṃ brahmacintāṃ na sūte | karmamātre'nantaphaladurāśāyāṃ nirastāyāṃ nivṛttatatpratibandhatayā vyutpattibhūyastvopanipatitadhīvṛddhyā ca tītratame mokṣābhilāṣe sāmagrīdaśāpanne brahmavicāravilambo ca syādityāśayaḥ | vighnāntaravihīne tu syādānantaryamatra naḥ | ato nātiprasaktiḥ syāttathānyairapi sammateḥ || 201 || adhītetyādinā mumukṣottambhakamatāntaraśīlanānavasarajñāpanam | jijñāsotpādakaphalāpātadhīvṛddhyai vedamātraniyatavyutpattiviśeṣasiddhyai vā niṣkāraṇaḥ ṣaḍaṅgo vedo'dhyeyaḥ ityādisiddhasāṅgatvoktiḥ | aṅgagrahaṇaṃ vicāraprayojakasya prayojanālocanasya siddhyartham iti tūlikā | phalādhikyādviśeṣaṃ gṛhṇatā saśiraskaśabdenādhyayanavidhau svādhyāyaśabdasya niyatakramabhāgadvayaviṣayatm, tadvicārārthāyāstrikāṇḍyā aikaśāstryam, kramaśca sūcyate | na hyadhyayanavidhyanālīḍhaṃśiraḥ, yena na vicāryaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ | vedaśabda iha puruṣārthatadupāyādibodhanārhatvaṃ vyanakti | tata eva vicārecchājanakāpātadhīsiddhiḥ | ṣaṣṭyantapadābhyāmadhikariniṣkarṣaḥ | yaduktaṃ kaiścit karmasūtravyākhyārambhe -- |prasiddho'pyathaśabdādeḥ kiṃ padārtho'tra varṇitaḥ | pradarśanārthamityeke kecinnānārthavādinaḥ || samudāyādavacchidya bhavadāsena kalpitāt | śaktito'vayavasyaiva varṇayantyaṣṭamādivat iti | tadīha nātīva peśalam; prasiddhyapavādaśaṅkāyāṃ padadvayavyākhyānasyāvatāritatvāt || brahmaṇo jijñāsā brahmajijñāsā | brahmaṇa iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī, kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛtīti viśeṣavidhānāt | yadyapi saṃbandhasāmānyaparigrahe'pi jijñāsāyāḥ karmāpekṣatvena karmārthatvasiddhiḥ; tathāpyākṣepataḥ prāptādābhidhānikasyaiva grāhyatvātkarmaṇi ṣaṣṭhī gṛhyate || tṛtīyapade'pi vṛtteranekadhā sambhave viśeṣavyaktyai vigṛhṇāti -- brahmaṇo jijñāsā iti | atra hi vyāsastāvat na ghaṭate, jijñāsānanvayāt; ata eva na karmadhārayaḥ, sāmānādhikaraṇyārhatve'pi viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyavyatyāsā, vivakṣitānupayogāñca | dvitīyā tu kṛdyogāpoditā | brahmaṇassarvahetutayā tṛtīyāsamāsasaṃbhave'pi viṣayādyuktirvṛttaviśeṇākṣepaśca na syāt | tādarthye cadurthyāstviha samāsaḥ pratiṣiddhaḥ, tādarthyasamāse prakṛtivikṛtigrahaṇaṃ kartavyam iti kālyāyanokteḥ | āhuśca -- prakṛtyā vikṛtiryasmāñcaturthyantā samasyate | tadārthye yūpadārvādau tenāsminna samāsatā || iti | tathā na saṃpradānatvamapi, brahmaṇaḥ saṃpradānatvābhāvāt | saptamīsamāse'pi viṣayatvamātraṃ sidhyediti bhāvaḥ | tadiha samāsagrāhyabhāvataḥ | vibhaktyarthasya sānnidhyādvyākhyātumiha yujyate || iti | apādānādiḥ pañcamyartho vākyānanbitaḥ, adhyāhārasāpekṣaśca | prādhānyena kartṛtvānupapattiḥ tadvijijñāsasva ityādikamanusaratā brahmaṇa ityanenaiva sūcitā | na hi mukhyaṃ brahma svamanvadvā jijñāseta, svatassarvadarśitvāt | uktaṃ ca nyāyatattve -- yo vetti yugapat sarvaṃ pratyakṣeṇa sadā svataḥ | iti | kiṃciñjñastu kartā na vaktavyaḥ, adhītavedasya tadarthaṃ nirṇinīṣorāditaḥ prabhṛtyanuvṛtteḥ | karmatvoktāvīpsitatamatayā prādhānyena viṣayatvaṃ prayojanatvaṃ ca sidhyet | ataḥ sadapi svasvāmibhāvādi atra na vaktavyamiti bhāvaḥ | tathā'pyastu sāmānyataḥ prāptā śauṣikī ṣaṣṭhī; viśeṣastvaucityalabdheravācya ityatrāha -- kartṛkarmaṇoḥ iti | saṃbandhaviśeṣe'pi ṣaṣṭhīvidhau siddhe, sākāṅkṣasūtroktāt nirākāṅkṣāsūtroktaṃ yuktam | tatra viśeṣayorvidhisāmye'pi kartuḥ sakarmakākarmakasādhāraṇyāt, iha ca kartrarthatvāyogāt asādhāraṇākāṅkṣitatamakarmopasthāpanamucitamiti bhāvaḥ | nanu kim arthalabhye śabdavyāpāreṇa ? na caivaṃ pratipadānuśāsanavaiyarthyam, tasya karmādivivakṣāyāmapi dvitīyāniṣedhena ṣaṣṭhīsādhutve tātpasyāt | ato viśeṣavidhirna śaiṣikaṣaṣṭhīmapavadet, tadgrahe ca vyavahitasaṃbandhasyāpi tadantaḥsthiterbrahmānubandhināmupāyādīnāmapi jijñāsāsaṃbandhāt tatkarmatvasya cārthasiddheḥ kṛtsnaśārīrakārthavicāryatvasūcanamadhikaṃ prayojanamityatrāha -- yadyapī ti | parigrahaḥ -- parito grahaḥ, sānubandhagrahaṇam | uttaragranthe tu gṛhyate ityuktyā anubandhisaṃbandhasyāśābdatvamātramabhipretam | karmāpekṣatvena -- sakarmakatayā prathamaṃ karmākāṅkṣājananasvābhāvyāt | karmārthatvasiddhirnāma kartṛtvavyudāsena ṣaṣṭhyāḥ karmāravyaviśeṣe'rthataḥ paryavasānam | parapratyāyanārthe prayoge vilambitadhīheturna grāhya ityabhiprāyeṇāha -- tathāpīti | na hyatra arthalabhye śaktiklṛptiḥ, kiṃ tu ākṣepyādvaraṃ klṛptaśaktikaśabdoktamityucyate | nanu ākṣepataḥ -- ityuktamayuktam; ākṛtyadhikaraṇanītyā sāmānyaśakteḥ viśeṣaparyantatvasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt | maivam -- sā hi viśeṣamātramupādatte, na karmatvādikam; na hi gośabdaśaktirviśeṣataḥ khaṇḍatvādi gṛhṇati | na cātra ābhidhānikagrahe ('pi) anubandhityāga iti bhramitavyam; sāmānyato dhīsthānubandhiviṣayvāt sarvatra jijñāsāyāḥ | evamapi ākṣepaḥ svīkṛta iti cet, satyam -- anyatarakarbhatvasyāpi śābdatvamubhayakarmatvākṣepāt varam, kimuta pradhānāṃśakarmatvasyākṣepāt | evakāraḥ śīghradhīhetorbalīyastvaṃ vyanakti | kathaṃ brahmaṇaḥ karmatvaṃ śābdam, dhātoḥ karmaṇaḥ samānakartṛkādicchāyāṃ vā iti jñānasyaiva karmatvāt; maivam -- sannantatve'pi prakṛtyanusāreṇa sakarmakatvākarmakatvavibhāgaḥ | ata eva hi prakṛtyarthakarmāpekṣayā kartṛkarmaṇoḥ ityanuśiṣṭiḥ; dharmo jijñāsitavyaḥ ityādau ca dharmāderabhihitakarmatvam | nanu tathāpi nābhidhānikatvam, upapadavibhakterarthābhāvāt; prayogamātrāt tasyāḥ sārthatve gāvyādāvapi prasakteḥ | na ca tatra śaktirasti | na śabdaśaktirgāvyādau gopadaṃ smāryate tataḥ | buddhisthenaiva tenātha gojātiḥ pratibudhyate || 202 || āptaprayogastu anarthakatve'pi sādhutvāt syāt, anyatrāpi tathādṛṣṭeḥ, sammateśca | anuśiṣṭiśca tāvadviśeṣavyakatyarthā | tattadarthadhiyastvanyathā siddheḥ, anyalabhye śakterakalpyatvāt, gatyantarāñca bahuśaktikalpanāyogāt, na śaktiraupayikī; tanna -- yathā kartṛkaraṇayoḥ ityādivaśāt kārakavibhaktiḥ sārthā anekārthā ca, tathā kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti ityādibalāt | tathā'pi na śaktibhaṅgaḥ | padāntarasaṃnidhiratra śakiṃta vyanakti, na tvādhatte; yathā nānārthagavādiśabdeṣu | yadvā atra anābhidhānikatve'pi viśeṣānuśāsanānumatavṛttiviśeṣavadvibhaktisiddhasya śābdasamatvaṃ vyañjayitum ābhidhānikatvoktiḥ | karmatvasya sūtrābhidhānasiddhatvamābhidhānikaśabdena pratīyate; upapadasvarūpavimarśasya padabodhyavimarśāt avilambitatvāñca | nanu na vigrahavadiha samaste vibhaktirasti, yenābhidadhyāllakṣayedvā | na cāprayuktāpi smutābhidhattām, prayogasyāpi taddhīmātrārthatvāditi vācyam; samāsato'rthabuddhau vibhaktismaraṇaniyame mānābhāvāt, sarvatra ca lakṣaṇādyucchedaprasaṅgāt | ṣaṣṭhyā cābhidhānamiti tadbhidā | tadevamabhidhāyakābhāve karmatvasya kathamābhidhānikatvaṃ tatsamatvaṃ vā ? maivaṃ saṃbandhasāmānye karmatve vā samīhite | vibhaktilopātsoḍhavyā prakṛtyaiva hi lakṣaṇā || 203 || athāsuśāsanādhīsasirūḍhalakṣaṇāyā abhidhānasamatvācchābdatvamiti matam, karmārthatve'pi samam | evaṃ tu kecit -- vyāse samāse ca savibhaktikāvibhaktikaśabdayoḥ dadhidadhyśabdanyāyena saiva śaktiḥ; ato luptavibhaktikayāpi prakṛtyā saṃbandho na lakṣyaḥ, vācyasaṃbandhini vastvantare vṛttirhi lakṣaṇā, na ca saṃbandhassaṃbandhī | karmatvādiśca saṃbandharūpaḥ | evaṃ svaparanirvāhakatayā saṃbandhaphalasiddhāvapi tathā vivekarahitānāmapyatra prakṛtyā vibhaktyarthadhīrdṛṣṭā; sannapi cājānataḥ saṃbandho na lakṣaṇāhetuḥ, atiprasaṅgāt | ataḥ prayogasyānanyathāsiddheranyathāsiddhiśaṅkāyāścānuśāsanenoparodhādvibhaktyarthaḥ samāse'pyabhidheyaḥ | evaṃ vibhaktivyatiriktalopeṣvapi nītiḥ | nanu niṣādasthapatiśabde vibhaktyarthalakṣaṇādoṣāpanuttyai ṣaṣṭhīsamāsastyajyate; tatkathamābhidhānikatvam | tanmukhyatve tu klṛptakalpyavirodhe klṛptasyaiva grāhyatvānnānyatrādhikāraklṛptiḥ; maivam -- sāmānādhikaraṇyasya prāgvaiyadhikaraṇyataḥ | avilambitadhīyogāt prābalyaṃ pratipāditam || iti nyāyena śaighryācchābdavyavahāraḥ | athānuśāsanasvārasyādarthaḥ; tarhi yathānirṇaye tu nādaraḥ, arthāvirodhāditi | upapadavibhaktāvuktamidaṃ samāse'pi bhāvyam | so'yaṃ vaibhavavādo vā paramārthoktireva vā | ābhidhānikatoktistu yuktā dhīśaighryabodhanāt || 204 || na ca pratipadavidhānā ca ṣaṣṭhī na samasyate iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyāḥ samāsaniṣedhaḥ śaṅkanīyaḥ, kṛdayogā ca ṣaṣṭhī samasyate iti pratiprasavasadbhāvāt | evaṃ karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyāmanaucityaṃ nirastam | tatra samāsaniṣedhaśaṅkāmapi nirasyati -- na ca iti | karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhyā ityanena sādhāraṇaḥ pratipadavidhānīśabdassaṅkocārha iti sūcyate | jño'vidarthasya karaṇe ityanuśiṣṭāyāmeva samāsāpavādaḥ; avedanārthasya jānāteḥ jāgateḥ kṛdyegaḥ kvacitsannapi tatra karaṇaṣaṣṭhyā anapekṣyaḥ; sarpiṣo jānīte ityudāharaṇāt | niṣe dhasya saṅkocamāha -- kṛdyogā iti pratiprasavo'pavādanirāsaḥ, tasya sadbhāvāt | na kevalaṃ prayogadṛṣṭyeti bhāvaḥ | evamaikapadyahetussamāsaḥ prathamaṃ vyākhyātaḥ | brahmaśabdena ca svabhāvato nirastaniṣiladoṣo'navādhikātiśayāsaṃkhyeyakalyāṇaguṇagaṇaḥ puruṣottamo'bhidhīyate | tatrādyaprakṛtyaṃśasya yaugikārthanimittatvaśruteḥ anyatrāpi yathādṛṣṭi mukhyatvaśaṅkām, nirviśeṣacinmātrabhoktṛbhogyaniyantṛsamaṣṭitadaṃśisanmātrādipareṣṭārtham, sveṣṭe copacāravṛtiṃta kṣipan sarvataḥ paribṛḍhatvāya bṛhattvabṛṃhaṇatve cānavacchinne vivṛṇoti -- brahmaśabdena ca iti | castvarthaḥ śaṅkānirāse | svabhāvataḥ ityādinā parakalpitaiḥ sadoṣatvanirguṇatvāvācyatvāvaidyatvairajijñāsyatvaprasaṅgo'pāstaḥ | nirastaniṣiladoṣatvaṃ ca bṛṃhaṇatvopayukto bṛhattvaviśeṣaḥ | guṇādividhiniṣedhayorutsargāpavādādinītiviṣayatvaṃ viśeṣaṇadvayena vyañjitam | viśeṣavidhibādhena tadanyārthatvakalpanāt | sāmānyavṛttisaṅkocaṃ varaṃ nītivido viduḥ || 205 || parapakṣe tu mithyātvasatyatvavivāde'pi nirasyatvenābhimatānāṃ doṣāṇāmāropataḥ upādhyavacchedataḥ svābhāvikāṃśato vā parabrahmāśrayatvāt tata eva sārvajñyādibhaṅgāñca jijñāsyatvāyogaḥ śrutyādikopaśca syāditi bhāvaḥ | svarūpato nāmāntarabhajanārhāvasthāvanto'citpadārthāḥ; tadabhāve'pi kleśādimanto baddhāḥ; katipayakleśādirahitā mumukṣavaḥ; tadatyantocchedavanto muktāḥ; tadatyantābhāvavattve'pi parādhīnatathātvā nityāśca buddhyavatārakrameṇa nirastanikhiladoṣa ityādimukhena prathame viśeṣaṇe vyavacchedyāḥ | tatra svabhāvata iti padenānāditvavivakṣāyāṃ muktāḥ, ananyādhīnatvavivakṣāyāṃ nityāśca vyāvartyante | dvitīye'pi te sarve | anyāsaṃbhāvyaguṇavidheḥ nityā eva vā | teṣāṃ jñānāderbrahmasāmye'pi hi parādhīnatvaṃ siddham, śaktistu tato nyūnā | vakṣyati ca satyādivākye anantapadavyākhyāne -- sātiśayasvarūpaguṇā nityā vyāvṛttāḥ iti | na hi te viśvavyāpinaḥ; nāpi sarvaśarīriṇaḥ | atiśayaśabdena dhātūktā bṛddhiratiśāyanamiti vyañjitam | anavadhikaviśeṣaṇena śataguṇitottarakramapradarśitaniratiśayadaśāśiraskatvoktiḥ, īśvarasya jñānānandādiguṇayogaḥ kādācitkaḥ, tacchaktistu nityā iti pakṣaḥ svabhāvata iti padānuṣaṅgāt pratikṣiptaḥ | jñānādyekaikaguṇavitatirūpāvāntaraguṇavargakhyāpanāya gaṇaśabdaḥ | uktaṃ ca ṣāṅguṇyaviveke -- tavānantaguṇasyāpi ṣaḍeva prathame guṇāḥ | yaistvayeva jagatkukṣāvanye'pyantarniveśitāḥ || iti | anavadhikātiśayaśabdo'tra gaṇaṃ viśiṃṣan pratyekamatiśayaparaśrutyā viduṣī pariṣad iti nyāyāñcārthato guṇān viśinaṣṭi | anyathānyapadārthāsiddhiḥ | satyāṃ gatau vyadhikaraṇabahuvrīhyayogaḥ | śailajanmā ityādiṣu āgatyātatsvīkāraḥ | etatsūtrasaṃvādināyā parīkṣya ithyādiśrutyā brahmapuruṣaśabdoktajijñāsyaniṣkarṣam sarvopaniṣadāṃ puṃsūktaikārthyam, īśvarasyādhyastabrahmāṃśatvāsambhavam, īdṛśasya gītānirūktyā prakṛtyāderdevatāntarebhyo'pi viśeṣavyakiṃta cābhipretyāha -- puruṣottama iti | avadhāraṇamiha grāhyam | yadyapyatra samānādhikaraṇasamāse paurvāparyavyatyayaḥ; nirdhāraṇe tu ṣaṣṭhyā na samāsaḥ | tathāpi dvāvimau puruṣau ityārabhya uttamaḥ puruṣastvanyaḥ ityadhamapratiyogitvoktyā saṃbandhiśabdatayā samāsaḥ syāt | akṣarādapi cottamaḥ ityanena pañcamīsamāso vā sūcyate | yogavibhāgastu yathāprayogamiṣṭaḥ | ata eva saptamī nirdhāraṇe'pi samasyate | nakottamādiśabdāścaivaṃ śābdaiḥ nirvyūḍhāḥ | rūḍhyā tu kāmaṃ puruṣottamo'stu iti vadan śrutyādibādhyaḥ, ato'smi loke vede ca prathitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ iti sarvavidukteḥ | abhidhīyate -- mukhyavṛttyā viṣayīkriyate | etena tadekānāmno brahmaśabdasya tatraiva lakṣaṇāmicchanto nirastāḥ, rūḍhiviṣaye kvacillakṣaṇāṃ vadantaśca nirastāḥ | sarvatra bṛhattvaguṇayogena hi brahmaśabdaḥ | bṛhattvaṃ ca svarupeṇa guṇaiśca yatrānavadhikātiśayaṃ so'sya mukhyo'rthaḥ | sa ca sarveśvara eva | ato brahmaśabdastatraiva mukhyavṛttaḥ | tasmādanyatra tadguṇaleśayogādaupacārikaḥ, anekārthakalpanāyogāt bhāvacchabdavat | nanu gavādiśabdavajjātidvārā, pācakādivat kriyādvārā, ḍitthādivadyadṛcchayā vānyatrāpi mukhyatā syādityatrāha -- sarvatra iti | prakṛtyādiṣviva brahmaśabdasthaleṣvityarthaḥ | teṣu mitho viṣameṣu tadanyavyāvṛttā jātiḥ kriyā vā na dṛṣṭā | bṛṃhaṇatvaṃ tu bṛhattvāpekṣam; atastannimittatve gauravam | bṛhattvaṃ ca kiñcitatra tatra prakṛtaṃ vivakṣitaṃ ca | brahmaśabdavṛttidvārā tannirupādhikavṛddhirūpadhātvarthaprasiddhiśca nopekṣyā; atassambhavadgatyantare na yadṛcchāpīti bhāvaḥ | hiḥ prasiddhau hetau vā | tarhi bṛhacchabdavadasau bṛhattvamātranimittaḥ syāt, netyāha -- bṛhattvam iti | sarvataḥ bṛhattvamasaṅkocāt svarūpato guṇataścetyucyate | tena paricchinnasvarupāṇāṃ guṇabṛhattvarahitasya guṇādeśca vyavacchedaḥ | asyetyanena bṛhacchabdādvyāvṛttirdarśitā | na hyasau ita idaṃ brahma ityavadhinirdeśaṃ taraptamapprayogaṃ sahate | sarvaṃ khalvidaṃ brahma sarvaṃ proktaṃ trividhaṃ brahmametat | trayaṃ yadā vindate brahmametat ityādiṣvanyeṣāṃ taccharīratayā devo'hamityādivat sāmānādhikaraṇyam; na tu tattadvastuṣu brahmaśabdaprayogaḥ | traividhyoktiśca preritṛtvavaiśiṣṭyaṃ bhoktṛbhogyavaiśiṣṭyaṃ cāpekṣya | nārāyaṇa paraṃ brahmetyatra paramiti viśeṣaṇaṃ tvaupacārikavyāvṛttyartham; ato bṛhattvamātraṃ nāsya nimittamiti bhāvaḥ | prayoganiyatyā tatra tatra kāṣṭhāprāptabṛhattvaṃ syādityatrāha -- sa ca iti | aparicchinnabṛhatatvāśraya iti yāvat | sarveśvara iti samādhikadaridratvāditvyañajanī samākhyā, ajassarveśvara iti tannāmapāṭhāt | ekasyaiva sarvaniyamanādirūpaṃ niratiśayabṛhattvaṃ śāstroktam; tadanyeṣāṃ tu tādadhīnyāttattvaṃ tādaktvamapi nāstītyavadhāraṇābhiprāyaḥ | anyatra nimittāsambhavānnaimittikāsambhavasya phalitatvamāha -- ata ita | ataṃ tattadvācakatvābhāve sambandhaguṇayogayośca sarvatra sambhave kvacitprakṛtyādiṣu niyataprayoga ityāha -- tasmāt iti | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- na hyatra sambandhamātrāllakṣaṇā; na ca kiñcitsāmyādgauṇī vṛttiḥ; kiṃ tu tadguṇoniratiśayabṛhattvam, talleśo'pi lokottarabṛhattvam, tannibandhanopacāraniyamānnātiprasaṅgaḥ | prayuñjate ca yatheṣṭaṃ stutinindābhiprāyeṇa mukhyāsanne tadguṇaprakarṣayogini ca cacchabdaṃ nāmatayeti | nanu mukhye labhye nopacāraḥ | na cāvayaśaktitvādbrahmaśabdasyaikatrāpyanyā śaktirna kalpyā, kimutānekatreti vācyam; tādṛśasyāpi prayoganiyatyai rūḍheḥ kalpyatvāt | paṅkacādiṣu padmatvādivaccaikaṃ niyāmakaṃ na dṛṣṭam | ato yāvatprayogaṃ śaktirbhedyetyatrāha -- aneka iti | klṛptaśakteśśabdasya prayogavimarśe hi prathamaṃ mukhyānusāraḥ | śaktiparīkṣāyāṃ tvekaviṣaye śaktyā prayogāntarānyathāsiddhau na śaktyantaraṃ kalpyam, gauravāt | anyathopacāra eva lupyeta | asti cāsāviti gauṇamuṣyādhikaraṇe sthāpitam | kvacittu agatyā anekaśaktiklṛptirityāśayaḥ | naighaṇṭukaistvanādṛtya śabdaniṣkarṣaṇaṃ girām | prayogaprauḍhiśikṣārthaṃ paṭhyate'nekanāmatā || 203 || yadatra niyāmakatayoktaṃ lokottarabṛhattvaṃ, tenaivaitena nimittenānyeṣvapi mukhyatvaṃ syāt, anyathā viparivartaḥ kiṃ na syādityatra dattotaratvamabhiprayam, pratyakṣe'pi visaṃvādo yeṣāṃ kassvayamuttaram | tebhyo dadyāditi jñātvā vṛddhānāṃ matamabravīt | iti nyāyāt purāṇoktīḥ nidarśayati -- bhagavacchabdavat iti | tatra śuddhe mahāvibhūtyākhye ityādinā, anyatra hyupacārataḥ ityantena bhagavacchabdasya yaugikārthapauṣkalyavatyeva mukhyatvamuktam | purāṇāntare'pi -- bhagavāniti śabdo'yaṃ tathā puruṣa ityapi | nirupādhī ca vartete vāmudeve sanātane || iti || dārṣṭāntikamapi gāruḍe sthāpitam -- vede bhūriprayogācca guṇayogācca śāÐṅgaṇi | tasminneva brahmaśabdo mukhyavṛtto mahāmune ityārabhya, yasminprayujyamānaṃ tu guṇayogassupuṣkalaḥ | tatraiva mukhyavṛtto'yamanyatra hyupacārataḥ || iti || tāpatrayāturairamṛtatvāya sa eva jijñāsyaḥ | atassarveśvara eva jijñāsākarmabhūta brahma | jñātumicchā jijñāsā | icchāyā iṣyamāṇapradhānatvādiṣyamāṇaṃ jñānamiha vidhīyate | astvekatraivāsya śaktiḥ; asmin sūtre bhedakābhāvādamukhyatvaṃ kiṃ na syādityatra, nāsti bheṣajamanyatra nārāyaṇarasāyanāt, vāsudevaṃ parityajya yo'nyaṃ devamupāsate | tṛṣito jāhnavītīre kṛpaṃ ravanati durmatiḥ || ityādipramāṇagatyā pratyāha -- tāpa iti | na hyatra mukhyasya bādhaḥ, bhagavataḥ svatantrasvāmitvāt | asvatantrasyānyasya cāyam arthaḥ siddhaḥ, juṣṭaṃ yadā paśyatyanyamīśamityādibhissopaṃbṛhaṇaiḥ paropāstereva tāpatrayanivartakatvokteḥ | sa eva mantavyo'nveṣṭavya iti vicāryatvena śruta iti bhāvaḥ | anekārthatve'pi brahmaśabdasyāsmin prayoge asāvevārtha ityāha iti vivaraṇaṃ tvanvārohe'pi viśeṣadāḍharyaparam | jātiguṇādinimittatvabahurūḍhatvapakṣeṣvapi hi samabhivyāhṛtapadāntaroderarthaviśeṣassidhyet | yadvā mukhyāmukhyayostantreṇānekārthatvānūktiḥ | amṛtaśabdenaivakāreṇa ca tamevaṃ vidvānamṛta iti, tamevaṃ viditvā iti ca vākyadvayasūcanāt dvayoravirodhaḥ ravyāpitaḥ | nanu pratyagātmanyapi so'nveṣṭavya ityādidarśanāt, nātmā śruteḥ ityādau tasyāpi nirūpayiṣyamāṇatvācca sa evetyavadhāraṇamihāśakyam | tadidaṃ nigamanamukhena vyudasyati -- ata iti | śabdaśaktyā prastutārthasvābhāvyāñcetyarthaḥ || tadubhayaṃ sarveśvara ityādipadadvayā bhipretam | jijñāsākarmabhūtaṃ jijñāsayā prāptumiṣṭatamamityarthaḥ | pradhānatayā hyatra jijñāsyaḥ paraḥ | tadbhaktyārohāyāhaṃgrahopāstau viśeṣaṇatayā boddhuṃ ca svātmāpi cintyaḥ | prajāpativākyādiṣu ca pratyagātmajñānaṃ prakṛtaparavidyārthatayaivocyata iti vakṣyate | san ihānicchārthaḥ icchārtho vā ? nādyaḥ -- guptijikidbhyassan ityādāvapāṭhāt | na dvitīyaḥ -- vicāre vivakṣite tadicchābhidhānavirodhāt sūtralakṣaṇavirodhāt upacārāyogācca ityatrādyamanabhyupagatyāntyaṃ samarthayituṃ vigṛhṇati -- jñātumi ti | nanu pratyayārthapradhāne jijñāsāpade jñānasya nimagnatvānna vidheyatvam, icchā tu na puruṣatantrā, na ca sā svajñānajanyā, viṣayānukūlyadhīnighnatayā tadabhāve tadanupapatterapratīyamāṇatvāccetyatrāha -- icchāyā iti | svaviṣayasiddhyarthatayā icchārūpakrimāyāḥ prokṣaṇāderiva svakarmapradhānatvaṃ siddham | dhātoḥ karmaṇaḥ ityatra ca dhātvarthasya prādhānyamārthaṃ grāhyam | aprāptameva vidheyam | ata icchāvācinā tatsaṃbandhivivakṣātra na yukteti bhāvaḥ | tarhi jñānamātraṃ vācyam, kimajāgalastanakalpena pratyayenetyatra adhikamadhikamarthaṃ sūcayatīti nītyā pratyuktiḥ -- iṣyamāṇamiti | sandigdhasaprayojanaviṣayatayā rāgaprāptaṃ vicārarūpaṃ jñānaṃ nopāsanādivadvaidhamiti sūcanātsārthakaḥ san ityāśayaḥ | jñāna śabdaścātraucityāt uktaviśeṣaparaḥ | rāgaviṣayaphalarūpajñānamukhena vicārākṣepaklṛptistu na yuktā, dhīvilambāt, vivakṣitasya ca sākṣādvaktuṃ śakyatvāt | iha mīmāṃsākhyaśāstrottarabhāgārambhe | evameva hi athāto dharmajijñāsā ityādiṣvapīti bhāvaḥ | nanu rāgaprāpte vicāre kathaṃ vidhīyate ityuktiḥ, nāpyatra gurvabhigamanādiniyamāṃśāpekṣayā vidhyuktiḥ; nyāyāyupayogāt, tādṛśaniyamaniṣedhena pūrvapakṣānutthānāñca | maivam -- rāgaprāptasyāpyanārabhyatvabhrame tanniṣedhaparatvādatra vidhiśabdasya, jātāpi hi vicārecchā pūrvapakṣoktayuktitaḥ | sīdantyuttabhyate yuktyā siddhe vyutpattipūrvayā || 207 || gaḍḍhandya ghddhaḍḍhadhtdṛdvadma mīmāṃsāpūrvabhāgajñātasya karmaṇaḥ alpāsthiraphalatvāt, uparitanabhāgāvaseyasya brahmajñānasyānantākṣayaphalatvāñca pūrvavṛttātkarmajñānādanantaraṃ tata eva hetorbrahma jñātavya mityuktaṃ bhavati | tadāha vṛttikāraḥ -- vṛttāt karmādhigamādanantaraṃ brahmavividiṣā iti | vakṣyati ca karmabrahmamīmāṃsayo raikaśāstryam -- saṃhitametacchārīrakaṃ jaiminīyena ṣoḍaśalakṣaṇeneti śāstraikatvasiddhiḥ iti | atra tāpatraya ihi granthe yādavaprakāśoktaṃ pūrvavṛttāntaraṃ sāṅkhyādivicārasyānārabhyatāsthāpanaṃ ca vivakṣitamiva pratibhāti; tadvyudasyan vākyārthamāha -- mīmāṃsā iti | māṅ māne ityatra nātatvaṃ nipātya vā, mānapūjāyām ityatra vā mānbadha ityādinā anicchāsannanto'yaṃ śabdaḥ | mānerjijñāsāyām ihi vaiyākaraṇoktistvadūraviprakarṣāt; jijñāsāviśeṣotthāpye hi pūjitavicāre tadanubandhini praśastanyāye vā vṛddhaprayogādasya śaktiniṣkarṣaḥ | āhuśca -- mīmāṃsāsaṃjñitastarkassarvo vedasamudbhavaḥ ityādi | tādṛśanyāyanibandhātmani tu śāstre bhākto mīmāṃsā śabdaḥ | ataḥ pūrvāparabhāgavibhāgena jñātatvāvaseyatvoktiraviruddhā | atra pūrvavṛttādityādinā vākyayojanā | śiṣṭaṃ tatratyahetvaṃśasamarthanam | vicārakramanirdeśaḥ sautrastadvyaktaye tviha | śāstraikyatatkramau proktau sūtrakārābhisaṃhitau || 208 || pūrvabhāgoparitanabhāgaśabdābhyāṃ niyatakramavyākhyānarūpaprabandhaikyaṃ vyajyate | tannidānaṃ vyākhyeyasya vedasya kramavattvaṃ padayojanāyāṃ saśiraskaśabdena darśitam | padavākyanirvāhayostātparyabhedādapunaruktiḥ | jñātasya nirṇītasya | avaseyasya abādhitāpātadhīsthatayā nirṇetavyasya | brahmajñānasya brahmopāsanasya | brahmasvarūpamātravivakṣāyāmatra jñāna śabdādhikyāt, jñātasya karmaṇaḥ ityetatsamaśīrṣatayā sādhyaviśeṣagrahaṇaucityāt, vicārarūpasya nirṇayarūpasya vā jñānasya avaseyatvoktyayo gāt, nirdiśyamānaphalaṃ pratyacoditatvāñca | tadiha samanvayanītyā svayamanantākṣapa phalatvena pradhānatayā jñātavyamapi brahma svopāsanasyānantākṣayaphalasādhanatvena tadviṣayatayāpi jñātavyamiti tadupasarjanatayoktirapi susaṅgatā | brahma jñātavyamityanena tu tatprādhānyaṃ vyajyate | atra prayojanavattayāpātadhīsthatvaṃ vicāryatve hetuḥ | karmavicārāt paścādbhāvitasya tu pratibandhaśāntau tatsāpekṣatvamānantaryasya ca tādṛśāpekṣaṇīyāntarābhāvaḥ | ataḥ śrutyuktanirvedapūrtiparyantavicāraviśeṣābhiprāyeṇa tata eva ityuktam | avadhāraṇamiha hetuvaikalpyanivṛttyartham, sāvadhāraṇahetuniṣedhāyogāt | kecittu hetvantarādbrahmavicāre'nāvaśyakatvaśūdrādhikāratvayoḥ prasaṅgāt karmadhīvyatiriktahetvanādaropadeśo'yam ityāhuḥ | atra pradhānapratijñā taddhetuḥ pratijñāntarahetuśca noktaḥ syāditi bahvanaucityam | ākāṅkṣitahetupūrvakasādhyaviśeṣāyogavyavacchittyaivārthataḥ hetvantarādinirāsastu yuktaḥ | jñātavyam vicāryamityarthaḥ | vicāraḥ kartavyaḥ iti bhāṣiṣyate | atrārhārthe kṛtyapratyayaḥ | karmajñānādityatrāpi jñānaṃ vicāraḥ | brahma jñātavyamityuktaṃ bhavatītyanena svārasyaṃ yukiṃta ca sūcayatā brahmaiva jñātavyamiti vākyārthaṃ vadantaḥ pratyuktāḥ | idaṃ hi sūtramavicāryatvanirāsārtham | brahmaṇo jñātavyatvasya itaḥ pūrvamasiddhatayā tadeva jñātavyamiti niyamo nodeti | kathaṃ ca śabdānāṃ siddhaparatvasambhavamasādhayitvā siddhaviśeṣasya vicāryatvoktiḥ; samanvayasūtrāt tatsādhanam, sākāṅkṣayojanā ca na yuktā | atra codanāsūtravacchabdato'rthataścāyogānyayogavyavacchedau vākyabhedābhāvaścetyapyayuktam, anupayuktapratijñāmātrānupapatteḥ | brahmaśraddhāvardhakatā anyaniṣadhaḥ prastutopayogī iti ca mandam; tatpratijñāne'pi hetuścātrohyaḥ; tadūhe tu īkṣityadhikaraṇādyaistarkapādāntaissādhanaprāptaiḥ kṛta karatvaṃ ca syāt | kiṃ ca śārīrake'nuktāṃśasya sāṅkhyayogāvagamyatvaṃ vadadbhiḥ kathamiha tanniṣedhaḥ pratijñāyate ? vedaviruddhāṃśānādaraṇīyatvaṃ tu virodhādhikaraṇataḥ prāgeva svoktau padārthavākyārthau vṛttyāpi draḍhayan tanmatānusāre tatkṛtisaṃvādaṃ darśayati -- tadāha iti | ananyathāsiddhapūrvatvavivakṣayā karmavicārasya hetutvamapi vṛttyabhipretam| adhigamyate'neneti adhigamo'tra vicāraḥ | vividiṣoktiḥ jijñāsoktivanneyā | svoktasūtrārthasiddhyai sūcitaṃ śāstraikyamapi saṃvādayati -- vakṣyati iti | vyākhyāsyamānapradeśāntaraviṣayatayā bhaviṣyannirdeśaḥ |
