saṃpādayetyupadeṣṭavyam; tadā hyevaṃvidhabrahmadhīsadasadbhāvayostadupāyānuṣṭhānaṃ na syāt | asmatpakṣe tu bahvākāraviśiṣṭe brahmaṇyāvṛttinairantaryādiviśiṣṭakālāntarabhāvyatiśayitajñānārthapravṛttau yathālokaṃ na virodhaḥ | lokasiddhaprakriyānabhyupagame svapravṛttyādivirodhaḥ syāt | na ca nityapratyakṣanirviśeṣavastuvādinaḥ tava vākyato'nyato vā tadviṣayātiśayitadhīḥ śakyeti | nanu mokṣopāye vidhitsitatvoktirayuktā, vidhiśabdānāmiha puruṣārthabhūtavākyajanyajñānānuvādaniṣṭhatvāt dhyānādestu tadarthatayā codanāt | na cānyānupapattimātrāttadanyatsarvamupapadyate | vividhāni ca jñānāni smṛtidarśanādiśabdairvyapadiśyanta ityatrāha tathā ce ti | yathā vākyajanyajñānādanyo mokṣopāyaḥ draṣṭavya ityādibhirvidhatsitaḥ, sa ca dhyānādyanekaśabdopātto'pi ekatayā sidhyettathaivetyarthaḥ | caḥ pāriśeṣyeṇa saha samuccayārtho vā | atra vedanādiśabdānāṃ dhyānādiśabdoktaviśeṣaparatām, upasargabhedasanvidhipratyayasadasadbhāvairarthabhedābhāvaṃ ca vyaṅktumīdṛśabahuvākyopādānam | upāttavākyaprakāravaicitryapara iti śabdaḥ | teṣāṃ vidhiparatvasāmyārtha evaṃ śabdaḥ | anupātteṣvapi nyāyasaṃcārārtham ādyo ktiḥ | atra nididhyāsitavya ityādinaikārthyāt anuvidya vijānāti vijñāya prajñāṃ kurvītetyevamādibhirvākyārthajñānasya dhyānopakārakatvāt anuvidya, vijñāyetyanūdya prajñāṃ kurvīta, vijānāti iti dhyānaṃ vidhīyate | śrotavyaḥ iti cānuvādaḥ; svādhyāyasyārthaparatvenādhītavedaḥ puruṣaḥ prayojanavadarthāvabodhitvadarśanāt tannirṇayāya svayameva śravaṇe pravartata iti śravaṇasya prāptatvāt | śravaṇapratiṣṭhārthatvānmananasya mantavyaḥ iti cānuvādaḥ tasmāt dhyānameva vidhīyate | vakṣyati ca -- āvṛttirasakṛdupadeśāditi | prajñāṃ kurvīta, vijānātītyādau na vākyārthajñānādanyatvaṃ bhātītyatra chāgo vā mantravarṇāditi nyāyamabhipretyāha -- atre ti | śruteṣu teṣu vākyeṣvityarthaḥ; nirdhāraṇe saptamī | aikārthyamihaikaprayojanatvam, ekaviṣayatvaṃ vā | taccātra śākhāntaranayapuraskāreṇa sāmānyaviśeṣa nyāyasiddham | prathamena ādiśabdena dhyāyathetyādeḥ, dvitīyena vijijñāsitavya ityādeśca grahaṇam | anuvāde tātparyasiddhyarthamanuvādyasya vidheyānvayārthaṃ ca dhyānopakārakatvoktiḥ | tacca dhyeyopasthāpakatvam | nanvatra anuvidyetyādau dadhnetyādivadguṇavidhirastu; saguṇakarmaśravaṇe hi vākyaṃ guṇaparamiti nītividaḥ, viśiṣṭavidhau gauravāt karmamātravidhau guṇaśrutivaiyarthyāt; karmapadaṃ tu vidheyasya guṇasyāśrajhryārpaṇenaṭayaṇārpaṇe sārthakaṃ syāditi ;maivam -- homavadiha jñānārthasya prāptatve hyanūdya guṇo vidhīyeta; tarhyagatyā viśiṣṭavidhirastviti śaṅkānirāsārtham anūdye tyuktam | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- ktvāntasyākhyātāntasya caikārthye paurvāparyavirodhaḥ | kasya ca kena vaiśiṣṭyam ? sajātīyābhyāse tu jñānamabhyasyedityevālam | upasargabhedaśca viphalassyāt | bhinnārthatve vijānātītyāderaprāptaviṣayasya dhyānavatpaścātpaṭhitasya paścādbhāvini vidheye dhyāne viśrāntirnyāyyā | vākyārthadhīstu prāptatvānna vidheyo guṇaḥ | tata eva na tadarthaṃ śravaṇādi, tatpradhānadhyānavidhānasya yuktatamatvācca | na cānyatkimapi jñānamiha guṇatvena vidheyatayā śaṅkanīyam | yadi tu vijānātītyādervākyārthajñāne viśramaḥ, tadā anuvidyetyāderna vidheyamanuvādyaṃ vā jñānāntaraṃ dṛśyate | na ca dhyānaṃ tadguṇatayā vidheyam | parokṣaṃ pratyakṣaṃ vā vākyārthajñānaṃ prati tatsādhanatvāsaṃbhavasya darśitatvāditi | sthānaikyādvidhipratyayarahite'pi vidhiparatvavyaktyai buddhisthakrameṇa prajñāṃ kurvītetyasya pūrvaṃ pāṭhaḥ | dhyānasya nicāyyetyādyuktavaiśadyaviśiṣṭatvādupāsyuktaprakarṣaviśiṣṭatvāccopasargadvayasāphalyam | anuvādayorapyupasargadvayamanuvādyasyābhyāsaṃ spāṣṭyaṃ ca vyanakti | avijñātaṃ, vijñātamiti vijñānaśabdasya nididhyāsitavya ityasya sthāne pāṭhācchravaṇānantarabhāvimananaviṣayānveṣaṇaśabdānantarapāṭhācca vijijñāsitavyaḥ ityetannididhyāsanasthānāpannam | upāyaviṣayavijñānavedanādisāmānyaśabdānāṃ tavyapratyayāntoktaśravaṇarūpajñānaviśeṣe viśramaḥ kiṃ na syādityatrāha śrotavya iti | kathamatrāhetukastavyapratyayabādha ityatrāha -- svādhyāyasye ti | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- śruterarthaparatvābhāvādvā, vicārasya pravartakābhāvādvā, tadavasarābhāvādvā mīmāṃsānārabhyeti śaṅkā nirastā | śrotavya ityasya ca gurvabhigamanādau śabdaśaktirnāsti | ato nirṇayārthavyāpāraparatve prāptārthatvamiti | nanvasti vidheyamāraṃbhaṇasaṃśīlanarūpaṃ mananam | tacca mantavyaḥ iti vivakṣituṃ yuktam; tatra vedanādīnāṃ viśrāntissyādityatrāha -- śravaṇe ti | apratiṣṭhitasya śravaṇasya dhyānānupakāritvāttatpratiṣṭhāpakatayākāṅkṣitaṃ tadanantarapaṭhitaṃ yauktikaṃ mananam | atastadapi rāgādyanuvṛttyā prāptatvādanuvādyameveti bhāvaḥ | etena śravaṇāditrikaṃ darśanasādhanatayā vidhīyata iti kaiściduktasya yuktivirodhaḥ jhrsthāṭakhyāpitaḥ | nanu śrotavyo mantavyaḥ ityetābhyāmupadeśakagamyārthaśravaṇamātraṃ vidheyamastu; āhuśca kecit -- sāṃkhyayogopadeśaśravaṇādikamiti | atrāha -- tasmādi ti prāptāprāptavivekāttatsiddhādvā | pariśeṣādityarthaḥ | evakāraḥ śravaṇamananayoḥ jñānamātrasya sanpratyayavācyecchāyāśca vyavacchedārthaḥ | draṣṭavya ityasyāpi dhyānaviśeṣaṇavāditayā pṛthagvidhitātparyavyudāsārtho vā | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- śrotavyo mantavya ityanayoravaidhaprasiddhopakārakatvasaṃbhave tadviparītaklṛpterayuktatvāt śrotavyaḥ ityādeśśravaṇādicatuṣṭayavidhiparatve vākyabhedāpatteḥ, atra vikalpasyāṣṭadoṣaduṣṭatayā gurulaghuviṣayatayā cātyantāsaṃbhavātkramabhāvyupakārasya śravaṇādessamādhirūpāṅginā samuccayāsaṃbhavādviśiṣṭavidhergatyantarābhāvaniyatatvāt, dhyānasya darśanarūpatāyāśśrutyantarānusāreṇa sādhayiṣyamāṇatvāt, ata eva nipūrvasyāpi dhyāyateriha padāntarasphuṭopāttadarśanarūpāvaiśiṣṭyoktāvudāsīnatvāt, draṣṭavya ityasyānuvādasamabhivyāhāre'pi svarasāvagatavidhiparatvaprahāṇena phalānuvādaparatvakalpanānupapatteḥ, śrotavyaḥ śrutivākyebhya ityādiśloke'pi śravaṇāditrikasya kramāddarśanahetutvamātroktau sādhyasyāpi vidheyatve virodhābhāvācca rāgaprāptaśravaṇādipūrvakaṃ vidhipadāntaropāttadarśanākāraviśeṣitadhyānamevātra vidheyamiti | evaṃ vedanādiśabdānāṃ svoktaviśeṣavidhiviśramānabhyupagame sūtravirodhamapi sūcayati -- vakṣyati ce ti | cintanārtho hi dhyāyatirekaviṣayamasakṛdāvṛttaṃ jñānaṃ vakti | ato dhyānaviṣaye upadiṣṭaṃ vedanaṃ dhyānameveti prakṛtasiddhiḥ | tathopāstirapi tasminyadantastadupāsitavyamityā dibhirupāttaḥ | ato yajñādisāpekṣatvānuguṇam upadeśādi tyanenaiva saṃgṛhītam | tadidamapavargopāyatayā vidhitsitaṃ vedanamupāsanamityavagamyate, vidyupāsyorvyatikareṇopakramopasaṃhāradarśanāt -- mano brahmetyupāsītetyatra bhāti ca tapati ca kīrtyā yaśasā brahmavarcasena ya evaṃ veda | na sa veda, akṛtsno hyeṣa ātmetyevopāsīta | yastadveda yatsa veda sa mayaitaduktaḥ ityatra anu ma etāṃ bhagavo devatāṃ śādhi yāṃ devatāmupāssa iti | dhyānaṃ ca tailadhārāvadavicchinnasmṛtisantānarūpam, dhruvā smṛtiḥ | smṛtilambhe sarvagranthīnāṃ vipramokṣa iti dhruvāyāḥ smṛterapavargopāyatvaśravaṇāt | vedanādisāmānyaśabdānāṃ dhruvānusmṛtirūpopāsane viśrāntiḥ | prāk pratijñātamupāsanākhyaviśeṣe vedanādisāmānyaśabdānāṃ viśramamāha -- tadi ti | tat -- taduktāvanirdhāritaviśeṣam | idam -- gurutaradhyānādisādhyasādhanatayā vidhānādviśeṣa dṛṣṭau tadekatāpattyarham | taddhetuṃ vyanakti -- apavargopāyatayā vidhitsitami ti | upāsanamityavagamyata iti | tulyaprakaraṇasthopāsisamānaviṣayavedanādiśabdanirdiṣṭatvāditi bhāvaḥ | upadeśāditi sūtritamekaprakaraṇasthaviśeṣamanyamapi hetumāha -- vidyupāsyori ti | mana ityādāvupāsirādau, vidirante | yastadityatra tu tadviparītam; na sa vedetyatra tūbhayata upāstiḥ, atha yo'nyāṃ devatāmupāste sa yo'ta ekaikamupāsta ityupakramāt | evaṃ mithassthānākrāntiriha vyatikaraḥ | nanvatra mano brahmeti dṛṣṭividhiḥ; anyacca vākyadvayaṃ vidyāviśeṣastham | ekatra śabdavṛttiryā sthitā sā'nyatra saṃcaret | tattulye'pītyabhipretya darśanāditi bhāṣyate || 300 || ya evaṃ vedeti na śāstrārthavedanāmātroktiḥ; vihitasya ākāṅkṣitaṃ phalamanirdiśyāvihitānyānuvādena tatphalokterayukteḥ | nanu bhūmavidyopakrame sa yo mano brahmetyupāste yāvanmanaso gataṃ tatrāsya yathākāmacāro bhavatī ti phalaviśeṣa uktaḥ | tenaiva nairākāṅkṣyaṃ syāt; maivam -- tṛtīyaprapāṭhakasthasyāsya upāsanaprakaraṇabhedāt, punaśśrutivaiyarthyācca, vidheyāntaratve siddhe sannihitaphalenaiva samanvayopapatteḥ | ato'sminnarthavāde vidinopāsanamanūdya tatphalavidhiryuktaḥ | rātrisatranyāyaścātrābhipretaḥ | dānādijanyā prathā kīrtiḥ | parākramādijanyā tu yaśaḥ | kīrtyā yaśasā ca bhāti; brahmavarcasena tapatīti yojyam | madhyamavākye'tretyanuktirāsannatvāt | yastadityādau yastat brahma veda, yacca brahma sa veda sa veditā raikvaḥ tadvedyametat brahma ceti dvitayaṃ tavoktamityarthaḥ | gāmaśvaṃ puruṣaṃ jagadi tyādiṣviva cakārānuktiḥ | napuṃsakasamabhivyāhārāduktamiti vipariṇamanīyam | vedyaṃ prati sa veditṛtvenokta iti vā neyam | atha vā yat sa raikvo veda, tadevānyo yo veda, enaṃ sarvaṃ tadabhisameti yatkiṃcitprajāssādhu kurvantīti pūrvatrānvayaḥ | sa mayaitaduktaḥ ityatra etaditi kriyāviśeṣaṇam; sa mayaivamukta ityarthaḥ | asyāṃ vyākhyāyāṃ prakaraṇānuguṇyāt raikvaśiṣyeṇa bhavitavyamiti jānaśruteḥ sūcyate | anuśādhi -- vivicya jñāpayeti yāvat | evaṃ vedanasya prastutadhyānopāsanaśabdavācyatvamityuktam, na tu dhyānasyopāsanatvamihocyate; vedanamupāsanamityavagamyate vidyupāsyoḥ ityādibhāṣaṇāt vedanamupāsanaṃ syāt iti pradarśayiṣyamāṇavākyasaṃvādācca | dhyānopāsanaśabdayorekaviṣayatvaṃ dhyānasya pratikūladhyānādvyāvṛttiśceha arthādeva sidhyataḥ | yadi dhyānamihopāsanatvena śabdato viśeṣyate; tadā dhyānasya punarākārāntaroktau śrṛṅkhalā bhajyeta | nanu dhyānaśabdaḥ cintāmātravācī vyavahitasmṛtisantāne'pi syāt, smṛtimātre ca kvacitprayujyate; sūtre ca dhyānopāsanaśabdābhyāmasakṛdāvṛttimātramuktamityatra tadabhipretaṃ śrautaṃ nairantaryarūpaviśeṣamāha -- dhyānaṃ ce ti | yāvajjīvāgnihotranayādvā svarūpeṇa cirakālasthāyitayā vā dhruvatvaṃ syāditi śaṅkānirāsāya sadṛṣṭāntaḥ santānaśabdaḥ | evaṃ vicchinnāvicchinnavedanasādhāraṇasya dhyānasya viśeṣe viśrama uktaḥ; avicchinnāsādhāraṇyaṃ vā sthāpitam | svasthāne caitat sūtrayiṣyati -- dhyānācca, acalatvaṃ cāpekṣyeti | upāsanaśabdasyāvicchinnaviṣayatvavat dhyānaśabdasyāpyavicchinnaviṣayatvamiha sthāpyata iti tūlikā | uktaṃ śrutyopapādayati -- dhruveti | smṛterdhruvatvaṃ visadṛśabuddhivyavadhānarahitapravāhatvam, tadrūpapratyaye caikā santatiścānyanispṛhā ityādinā tathokteḥ | yadyapi nānā śabdādibhedādityatra phalasaṃyogaikyamātrānna vidyaikyamiti vakṣyate; dhyānatvopāsanatvadhruvatvādayaśca viśeṣā vidyāntarapaṭhitāḥ; tathā'pi sādhāraṇānāṃ vedanādiśabdānāṃ viśeṣaviṣayatvābhāve phale ca tāratamyarahite gurulaghūpāyabhedavidhidausthyam | gurulaghuvikalpāyogalakṣaṇaṃ ca vastusāmarthyaṃ prakaraṇādbalīyaḥ, atassmṛterdhruvatvam | idamekatra śrutamapi sarvāsu vidyāsu yojyamityabhiprāyeṇa apavargopāyatvaśravaṇādi tyuktam | smṛtilambhe -- āhāraśuddhyādikrameṇa prastutadhruvānusmṛtisiddhau ityarthaḥ | grathyata ebhiḥ kṣetrīti granthayaḥ -- dharmādharmarāgadveṣamohādayaḥ karmopanītāśca triguṇavikārabhedāḥ | te ca māyāpāśagranthitayā āptāgamoktāḥ | vipramokṣaḥ -- vibhajyātyantikamocanam | nanu bhrāntyā bandhaḥ sarveṣṭaḥ, tasya kathamapramā smṛtirbādhikā; bhrāntyadhīnakarmajanyasya svayaṃ bhrāntiviṣayatvāsiddheḥ | bhramotthasyāpi bhayaśaṅkāviṣajanyajvarāderiva bandhasya satyatayā yukto'yamīdṛśaḥ pratīkāravidhiḥ mithyātvapakṣe'pi prāyaścittādinyāyo dustyajaḥ | ato nivartyasya satyamithyātve, nivartakasya mānāmānatve anādṛtya coditatvāt svaphalasādhanatvaṃ grāhyam | bhedavāsanāyāśca dhyānarūpā smṛtirnāśinī tvayaivoktā | tadatra śuktirajatavanna bandhasya bādhaḥ nāśastu yathāvidhi smṛtyā pramityā vā syāt | na ceyaṃ smṛtirapramā'pyayathārthā, svahetupramityananyaviṣayatvāt | uktaṃ ca sāmānyataḥ śrīmadgītābhāṣye -- smṛtirnāma pūrvānubhūtaviṣayamanubhavasaṃskāramātrajaṃ jñānamiti | pūrvānubhūtaviṣayatvaṃ na lakṣaṇapraviṣṭam; kiṃ tu viṣayasatyatvāsatyatvayoḥ svahetudhīsāmānyajñaptyartham | nivṛttatadavasthasya tadavasthatayā smṛtau | yāthārthyaṃ na pratikṣepyaṃ bhūtabhāvipramākramāt || 301 || smṛtipramoṣe cārthasya tādavasthyaṃ na bhāsate | ayāthārthyaṃ kathaṃ tatra tattedantāvivarjite || 302 || ato mūlānusāreṇa yathādarśanamiṣyatām | yathārthā cāyathārthā ca smṛtirapyanubhūtivat || 303 || anyadṛṣṭistathā'nyatra kṣveladhvaṃsādikṛnmatā | paravidyāsvapi hyeṣā kvacidaṃśeṣu gṛhyate || 304 || ataḥ śrutismṛtiśataiścoditā smṛtirūpiṇī | bhāṣyate paravidyeyaṃ bhavāraṃbhasya niṣkṛtiḥ || 305 || sā ca smṛtirdarśanasamānākārā ; bhidyate hṛdayagranthiśchidyante sarvasaṃśayāḥ | kṣīyante cāsya karmāṇi tasmin dṛṣṭe parāvare || ityanenaikārthyāt | evaṃ ca sati ātmā vā are draṣṭavya ityanena nididhyāsanasya darśanasamānākāratā vidhīyate | bhavati ca smṛterbhāvanāprakarṣāt darśanarūpatā | smṛterdarśanasamānākāratvam | nanu dhyānamevetyādyayuktam; tadapi dhāraṇāvatsamādhyarthatayoktam | samādhireva tu darśanātmakaḥ ātmānaṃ paśyedi tyādibhirmuktiheturuktaḥ | na ca yogipratyakṣamanabhyupagatam, tasya bahuṣu pradeśeṣu bhāṣiṣyamāṇatvādityatrāha -- sā ce ti | dhruvatvaviśeṣitetyarthaḥ | ākārāntareṇāpi sūtrasūcitagatyā viśeṣyata iti vyaktyai cakāraḥ, evārtho vā | saiva hi smṛtirvaiśadyātiśayātsamādhyākhyā; na tu dhyānaphalamanyaddarśanaṃ paśyedi tyādiṣu ca vidheyamityarthaḥ | smṛterdarśanatvavyāghātaśamanāya samānatvoktiḥ; parokṣe'pyaparokṣatvopacāra iti bhāvaḥ | parokṣā cāparokṣā ca smṛtirdvedhā svamūlavat | kṛtsnā vā syātparokṣaiva dvidhā'pyatrāparokṣatā || 306 || vidhau ca paraśabdārtho gatyabhāve'numanyate | lakṣaṇeṣṭā hi darśādau gauṇī śyenādināmasu || 307 || ardhamantarbahirvedi minuyāditi ca śrutau | madhyadeśasya lakṣyatvaṃ sarvatraivaṃ yathāyatham || 308 || nanvatra svavākye dhravatvaṃ na darśanarūpatvaṃ viśeṣaṇatayopāttam; yataḥ samādheḥ pārthakyaṃ parihriyetetyatrāha -- bhidyata iti | atra granthi śabda upāttakarmādivyatiriktaviṣayaḥ ;hṛdayasya manasaḥ samyak pravṛttipratibandhakatayā granthayo rāgādyāḥ | yadvā hṛcchabdoktaṃ sthānamayatīti hṛdayo jīvaḥ; tātsthyādvā asau tacchabdena lakṣyate; tasya granthiḥ pūrvoktastriguṇavikāravargaḥ | hṛdayaṃ vā granthiḥ; upalakṣaṇamidam | yattu nirucyate chāndogye -- sa vā eṣa ātmā hṛdi tasyaitadeva niruktaṃ hṛdyayamiti tasmāddhṛdayamaharaharvā evaṃvitsvargaṃ lokame tīti; tadupāsyabrahmaparam | na ca tadevātra hṛdayaśabdavācyamiti bhramitavyam; granthisaṃśayādiviruddhadharmādhyāsāt | sarvaviṣayāssaṃśayāḥ, sarve vā saṃśayāḥ; saṃśayaśabdo'tra viparyayasyāpyupalakṣakaḥ | te chidyante hetūcchedānna saṃtanyantaḥ ityarthaḥ | karmāṇi -- bandhakasukṛtāni duṣkṛtāni ca | prāptivirodhikṣayasyātra vivakṣitatvānna vidyotpattikarmanivṛttyoranyonyāśrayaḥ | parāvare -- paratvaṃ sarvātiśāyitā; avaratvam -- saulabhyārthendrānujatvādyaiḥ | yadvā sadbrahma brahma dāśā ityādyuktaparāvarajantuśarīrake | aparāvare vā nimnonnataviśvavilakṣaṇe | atha vā parā evāvarā bhūtyā yasya sa parāvaraḥ | idamatrākūtam -- dṛṣṭa ityatra darśanaśabdo na tāvanmuktyavasthābhāvidarśanaparaḥ, dhruvasmṛtiśabdavat granthimokṣasādhanaviṣayatvāt | na ca sādhanaviṣayatve'pi smṛtidṛṣṭyorapavargaṃ prati samuccayaḥ, darśapūrṇamāsādivat dvandvasya cakārasya vā'nupalabdheḥ | na cātra samuccayaśśakyaḥ, prakrāntayogena brahmaṇassākṣātkartumaśakyatvāt, śakyatve'pi yaugapadyasyāsaṃbhavāt, kramasya ca vyavasthāpakābhāvāt | na ca prācīnaṃ dhruvasmaraṇaṃ paścimaṃ ca yogipratyakṣaṃ karaṇatayā samuccīyeta, dhāraṇāvattādarthyopapattau samuccayaklṛptyayogāt; anyathā'tiprasaṅgāt, dhruvasmṛtervyavahitasādhanatvaklṛptau śrutahānādiprasaṅgācca | pramāṇaphalaṃ ca darśanaṃ na svarūpeṇopādātuṃ śakyam; yena samuccitya vidhīyeta | nanu saṃskārodbodhaphale smaraṇe'pi samānametat; ata ājyāvekṣaṇanyāyāttadupāyabhūtaśakyavyāpārārtho darśanavidhirihāstviti cet, na, tathā satyekasminvākye draṣṭavyanididhyāsitavyapadayoḥ punaruktiprasaṅgāt, antato nididhyāsanārthacittapreraṇasyaiva puruṣatantrasya darśanopāyatayā vidhātavyatvāt, anyasya cādṛṣṭeḥ | nanveka eva darśanopāyassāmānyato viśeṣataśca padadvayokta ityapunaruktiḥ syāt, hantaivaṃ sati samuccayaṃ tyaktvā asmatpadavīmīsīdasi; draṣṭavyo nididhyāsitavya ityubhābhyāmekasyaiva vidheyatvāt | asmadukte tu dhyānaṃ vaiśadyato viśeṣyata iti vaiṣamyam | na ca darśanasamānākāradhyānāntareṇa dhruvasmṛtessamuccayaḥ; tādṛśasyānyasyādṛṣṭeḥ, tatklṛptau ca gauravāt, dhruvasmṛternirapekṣasādhanatvaśrutibhaṅgaprasaṅgācca | na ca mokṣe sādhye sākṣātkārasmṛtyoranekadoṣaduṣṭo vikalpassvīkāryaḥ | vikalpasya dvedhā aṣṭadoṣatvanirvacanam | vikalpabuddhyanuṣṭhānāpūrvatatphalabādhataḥ | koṭibhyāmaṣṭadoṣatvaṃ prayogadvitaye'bruvan || 309 || prāmāṇyatyāgato'nyasya svīkṛtestyaktasaṃgrahāt | svīkṛtatyāgataścānye prayogadvitaye viduḥ || 310 || gurulaghuvaiṣamyāccatra na tatsaṃbhavaḥ; anyathā'tiprasaṅgāt, viṣamaphaleṣveva taddhetutvadṛṣṭeḥ | na cātra dvāradvāritā, mānābhāvāt | na hi śravaṇamananayordhyānopakārakatvavat dhyānasya darśanopakārakatvaṃ dṛṣṭam | paroktaṃ bhāvanābalajapratyakṣaṃ tu śāstrayonyadhikaraṇe nirasiṣyate | na cātra śrutam, evaṃ kramādyanukteḥ | tatastu taṃ paśyate niṣkalaṃ dhyāyamānaḥ dhyānanirmathanābhyāsāddevaṃ paśyennigūḍhavadityādikamastīti cet, satyam, dhyānaphalaṃ hyetaddarśanamaṇimādivatsiddhyantaramastu, na sādhanam; tathā'nukteḥ | paravidyāprakaraṇe kvacittaduktistu tattatprabhāvapradarśānārthā tamakratuṃ paśyati vītaśokaḥ puriśayaṃ puruṣamīkṣata itivat dhyānasādhyatayoktaṃ darśanaṃ muktasyāstu; dhyānasādhyatayoktaṃ darśanaṃ mumukṣoścet viśadadhyānarūpaṃ syāt; tathā hi -- darśanaśabdasya śrāvaṇajñānādiṣvaprayujyamānasya cākṣuṣajñānameva hi mukhyam; tattu na cakṣuṣā gṛhyate nāpi vācā, manasā tu viśuddhe netyādibhiriha pratikṣiptam; ato manojanyajñānaviśeṣe darśanatvopacāra iti vācyam; tathāsati varaṃ mokṣasādhanatayā kaṇṭhoktasyaiva dhruvānusmaraṇasya tādṛśavaiśadyavivakṣayā tadupacāra iti | nanu darśanaśabdaḥ smṛtiṃ sākṣātkārarūpatvena viśinaṣṭu; maivam, tasya smṛtāvasaṃbhavāt, mūlabhedānusāreṇa saṃbhavābhimānināmapi parokṣānubhavasādhyasmṛtau tadasiddheḥ | manasā dhyānaniṣpādyaṃ samādhisso'bhidhīyata iti samādherdhyānaniṣpādyatvoktiśca viśadāviśadavaiṣamyāt | uktaṃ ca samādhāvavasthādvayaṃ tasyaiva yogāṅgatvamaṅgitvaṃ ca nirvahadbhiḥ | astvevamiha smṛtidarśanavākyayoraikārthyam; tathā'pi smṛtiśabdena darśanamupacaryatām; tanna -- mukhyārthabādhābādhābhyāṃ viparivartasyaiva sthāpitatvāt | kiṃ ca smṛtirhi vaiśadyoktyā stūyeta, dṛṣṭistu smṛtitvoktyā ninditā syāt | parokṣajñāne ca vaiśadyavivakṣayā tamasaḥ pāraṃ darśayatī tyucyate | loke ca pāradarśī, dūradarśī ityādi | nanvaparokṣasya saṃsārasya darśanasamānayā'pi parokṣayā smṛtyā kathaṃ bādhaḥ; na kathaṃcit, mithyātvāsiddheḥ | aparokṣasyāpi jvālaikyadehātmatvacandradvitvāderanumānādinā bādho dṛṣṭaḥ, sarvaiścābhyupagataḥ | ataḥ tasmin dṛṣṭa ityanenāpavargopāyaviṣayeṇa smṛtervaiśadyalābhāttādṛśī saiva samādhiriti nāṣṭamalopaprasaṅgaśceti | tathā'pi draṣṭavya ityādau dhyānasāmarthyākṣiptaśravaṇamananayoḥ dhyānārthatvavat agryaprāyanyāyena dhyānasyāpi darśanārthabuddhyantaratvopapatterna darśanaśabdastadviṣayaḥ syāditi śaṅkāyāṃ dhyānamevetyatrābhipretaṃ vivṛṇoti -- evaṃ ca satī ti | dhruvasmṛtitveneva darśanasāmyenāpi nididhyāsanasya viśeṣitatve śrutyantarasiddhe satītyarthaḥ | caḥ śaṅkānivṛttyai, svataḥ prāptavidhiparatvayuktyā saha sphuṭārthaśrutyantarānuguṇyasamuccayārtho vā | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- dhyānasyāpi śravaṇādivadavidheyatve yajñādibhirevādṛṣṭadvāreṇa darśanasiddhiḥ kalpyeta; tathā ca madhye dhyānaṃ viphalaṃ syāt, bhāvanābalajapratyakṣānupapattyā tādṛśadṛṣṭopakārakābhāvāt | vidheyatve tvekatra nirṇītaśśāstrārthaḥ sarvatra svataḥprāpta iti nyāyāt dhruvānusmṛtivākyavadihāpi nididhyāsanaṃ darśanasamānatayā viśeṣṭavyam | draṣṭavya ityatra parokte phalaparatve tu pratyayavaighaṭyam | pūrvāparavākyeṣu ca yenāhaṃ nāmṛtā syām, amṛtatvasya tu nāśāsti vittena etāvadeva khalvare amṛtatvami ti phalasyoktatvāttaduktiratrānapekṣitā; vaiśadyaṃ tvanyatroktamatrāpyākāṅkṣābalāyattam | ata upāyaparatayā tasmin dṛṣṭa itivadvidheyaviśeṣakatve saṃbhavati | vikalpasamuccayaśrutahānāderayogādekaphalasiddhyarthavi śiṣṭaikasādhanavidhitātparyasaṃbhave pṛthak phalavidhibhedasyāgrāhyatvāt dadhnetivadanūdya vidhāne viśiṣṭavidheyaikyasaṃbhavācca vaiśadyaviśeṣitadhyānavidhiparamidaṃ draṣṭavyaḥ ityādivākyamiti | ata evāsya yugapadekasya vidhyanuvādaśaṅkā'pyapāstā | svānandasākṣātkārarūpasyātmadarśanasya svayamevepsitasya kathaṃ vidheyatvamiti codyaṃ viśadasmṛtividhānoktyā pratyuktam | etena nicāyya taṃ mṛtyumukhātpramucyate, yadā paśyaḥ paśyate rukmavarṇam, tadvijñānena paripaśyanti dhīrā ānandarūpamamṛtaṃ yadvibhātī tyādyapi yathārhaṃ nirūḍham | nanvevaṃ yogipratyakṣameva lupyeta, tattadvākyeṣu darśanādiśabdānāṃ yogipratyakṣasadbhāvavacanānāmapi pratyakṣasamānākāraviṣayatayā netuṃ śakyatvāt | na ca dharmādayaḥ kasyacitpratyakṣāḥ prameyatvādityādibhistatsiddhiḥ, īśvarapratyakṣeṇārthāntarāpatteḥ | indriyagrāhyā iti sādhyaprayoge'pi śāstravedyasyāpi manoviṣayatvena siddhasādhanāt, indriyasākṣātkartavyā ityatrāpyatīndriyāṇāmapi anuvyavasāyavedyatvavādināmārthāntaratvena dattottaratvāt, sukhādivadāhatya sākṣātkāryatvavivakṣāyāṃ vipakṣe bādhakāsaṃbhavena pratibandhāsiddheḥ; anyathā bauddhavaddharmādīnāṃ cākṣuṣatvasyāpi sādhanaprasaṅgāt | śakyaṃ hi vigītaṃ kasyacit cākṣuṣaṃ prameyatvādityādi prayoktum | kiṃ ca yogīndriyaṃ na dharmādipratyakṣajanakam, indriyatvāt; asmadādīndriyavaditi pratiprayogassulabha iti; maivam muktyupāye hi kathitā darśanokteramukhyatā | anyatra bādhakābhāvādyathāśrutaparigrahaḥ || 311 || saṃyamināṃ hyatītānāgatātīndriyādijhavedanaṃ kaṇṭhoktam | na ca smaraṇametat, ananubhūtaviṣayatvāt | ata eva na tatra vaiśadyamātreṇa pratyakṣatvopacārasambhavaḥ | na ca tatrānumānādyavakāśaḥ, tatsarvaṃ dharmavīryeṇa yathāvatsaṃprapaśyatī tyādibhistatpratikṣepāt; pāṇāvāmalakaṃ yathe tyādi ca nirdiśyate; dharmopacayabhedairanadhītasūktakāṇḍamantra, sākṣātkāraśca kīrtyate; divyaṃ dadāpi te cakṣu rityādi ca prasiddham; ato nāsiddhiḥ; yogipratyakṣasya bāhyendriyāṇāṃ manasaśca sukṛtaviśeṣairyathārhaṃ lokottarātiśayādhānāt | na cātiprasaṅgaḥ; yathāśrutātilaṅghane hetvabhāvāt, anumānasya vipakṣe bādhakābhāvācca | na cānumānataḥ śrutabhaṅgaḥ, tasyāgamenaiva bādhāt; anyathā'tiprasaṅgāt | nanu śāstraṃ śakye śaktaṃ viniyuṅkte; smṛtestu darśanasāmyaṃ na puruṣatantram; na ca tadapi tasyāḥ saṃbhavi; darśanatvavadevāsaṃbhāvitaṃ ca na vidhirāghrātumarhati | na dṛṣṭādhikāro vidhirasaṃbhāvitadṛṣṭaphale sati bhavatītyatrāha -- bhavatī ti | bhāvanā -- anubhavajanyassaṃskāraścintaiva vā | sā ca sādaraṃ nirantaraṃ ca kartuṃ śakyā | tataḥ smṛtivaiśadyasiddhiḥ | darśanasya rūpamiva rūpaṃ yasyāssā ityupamānabahubrīhiratra grāhyaḥ | bhītakāmukādipratibhāśca atra nidarśayitavyāḥ | parairapyucyate -- dṛṣṭaṃ parokṣamapi dhyāyamānaṃ sākṣādbhāvamāpannaṃ kāmādyupaplava iti | vṛkṣe vṛkṣe ca paśyāmī tyādiṣu bhrāntimiśratvaṃ doṣāyattam; iha tu yathāśrutacintanānna dauṣabādhāviti bhāvaḥ | yadi syādbhāvanābhūmnā smṛterdarśanatulyatā | kimatra karmaṇā maivaṃ mānasiddhobhayagrahāt || 312 || vākyakāreṇaitatsarvaṃ prapañcitam -- vedanamupāsanaṃ syāttadviṣaye śravaṇāditi | sarvāsūpaniṣatsu mokṣasādhanatayā vihitaṃ vedanamupāsanamityuktam | sakṛtpratyayaṃ kuryācchabdārthasya kṛtatvātprayājādivaditi pūrvapakṣaṃ kṛtvā siddhaṃ tūpāsanaśabdāditi vedanamasakṛdāvṛttaṃ mokṣasādhanamiti nirṇītam | upāsanaṃ syāt dhruvānusmṛtirdarśanānnirvacanācceti tasyaiva vedanasyopāsanarūpasyāsakṛdāvṛttasya dhruvānusmṛtitvamupavarṇitam | seyaṃ smṛtirdarśanarūpā pratipāditā | darśanarūpatā ca pratyakṣatāpattiḥ | smṛterdarśanarūpatāyāṃ vākyakārānumatiḥ | uktasya nyāyavargasya dārḍhyāya sūtre śābdamārthaṃ ca sarvaṃ mukhyabhedena tadabhiprāyavidbhirvimṛśya nirdhāritamityāha -- vākyakāreṇe ti | tadviṣaye śravaṇāt; upāsanaśabdasthāne vedanaśabdasya ekatra anyatra ca prakaraṇe prayogādityarthaḥ | atroktasya prāyikatvaśaṅkāvyudāsāya vākyaṃ vyācaṣṭe -- sarvāsvi ti | mano brahmetyupāsī teti dṛṣṭividhāvuktamapi nyāyasāmyātparavidyāsvapi yojyam, kiṃ punastāsvevaikatra dṛṣṭamiti vyaktyai mokṣasādhanatayā vihitami tyuktam | etenāpātadhīśravaṇamanananirṇayādervyavacchedaḥ | vedanamupāsanamityuktasya uttaravākyāsattyā mandānāṃ pūrvapakṣatvaśaṅkāṃ spaṣṭoktyā nivartayitumāha -- sakṛdi ti | vidhirhi svataḥ pravṛttyunmukhaṃ puruṣaṃ prerayan svasiddhyai prayājādiśāstreṣvivātrāpi sakṛt pravartayet; viśeṣavacane sati khalu āvṛttibhārassoḍhavya ityabhiprāyeṇoktam -- śabdārthasya kṛtatvādi ti | vidhiviṣayasya ghātvarthasya tāvataiva pūrṇonuṣṭhitatvādityarthaḥ | uttaravākyasthena tuśabdena sūcitamāha -- pūrvapakṣaṃ kṛtve ti | tatpratikṣepokiṃta darśayati -- siddhami ti | nyāyata upāsanaṃ siddhamityarthaḥ | siddham -- siddhānta iti vā | upāsanaśabdāt | na hi sakṛdbuddhāvupāsanaśabdasya prakhyātiriti bhāvaḥ | etadvākyaṃ vyācaṣṭe -- vedanami tyādinā | upāsanaśabdādi tyanena vedanamupāsanami ti vākyasyāpi śabdapratyabhijñayā siddhāntaparatvaṃ darśitaṃ bhavati | dhyānasya dhruvatvaṃ sūtrānuktamapi nyāyasāmyātsūcitaṃ prāk svena vivṛtam | vākye tu dhyānādabhinnasya upāsanasyāpi taduktamupādatte -- upāsanami ti | darśanam -- svārasikī lokadṛṣṭiḥ | nirvacanam -- nirṇāyakatayā prāguktaṃ śrutivākyam | yadvā darśanam -- pratyakṣaśrutiḥ | nirvacanam -- niṣkṛṣya vacanamupabṛṃhaṇam | tasyaiva -- muktisādhanatayā vihitasyaiva, na tu pareṣṭasya muktisādhanahetorityarthaḥ | sakṛdāvṛttāvupāseḥ prayogābhāvāt upāsanarūpasyāsakṛdāvṛttasye ti vākyasthopāsanaśabdavivakṣitatvoktiḥ | nanu etatsarvaṃ prapañcitami ti pūrvoktam; tatra darśanarūpatvaṃ na dṛṣṭamityatra tasyānuktasyāpi taduktābhyāmāvṛttirūpatvadhruvatvābhyāṃ tulyanyāyatvavyaktyartham anyavidhānārthaṃ cānubhāṣate -- seyami ti | dhyānatvopāsanatvābhyāmasakṛdāvṛttā vākyāntareṇoktadhruvatvaviśiṣṭā cetyarthaḥ | pratipāditā -- darśanarūpatvamapi vākyakāreṇārthāduktamiti bhāvaḥ | yadvā -- nyāyasāmyādabhipretamidamasmābhiḥ prāguktamiti | nanu yadyapyanyasyānyatvaṃ na vidhātuṃ śakyam; smṛtidarśanayośca sāmagrīniyamāt viruddhajātīyayoranyatraikyamasaṃbhavi, tathā'pi saṃskāramātrajanye svapnajñāne adṛṣṭaviśeṣasahakārātsākṣātkārarūpatvamivātrāpi cakṣurjanyatvāsaṃbhave'pi tadavinābhūtapratyakṣatve'pi dhruvānusmṛterdhītvamātrasāmyāt darśanaśabdopacāraḥ kathaṃ na syādityatrāha -- darśanarūpate ti | pratyakṣatāpattiḥ; na tu sākṣātpratyakṣatvam, asaṃbhavāt | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- svapnadhīrapi na tāvanmukhyadarśanam, cakṣurvyāpārābhāvāt | kiṃ tu tatra bāhyakaraṇavṛttinirodhe sati ananyasaṃcāriṇā manasā saṃskārapaṭimnā prāganubhūteṣu viśadasmṛtirādhīyate, tadatiriktadhīkalpane ananyathāsiddhahetvabhāvāt | tatra cakṣurādyajanye'pi tajjanyatvadhīḥ asaṃsṛṣṭe saṃsṛṣṭadhīśca doṣavaśānmānasabhrāntiḥ | sandhyādhikaraṇānurodhe tu saṃskāramātrajanyatvābhāvādasaṅkīrṇaṃ darśanatvam, ato na svapnanidarśanena prastute pratyakṣatvaklṛptiśśakyā | dhītvamātreṇa darśanasāmyādupacāraśca vācyāsannatamastutyanuguṇaviśeṣasiddhau na yukta iti | evaṃ pratyakṣatāpannāmapavargasādhanabhūtāṃ smṛtiṃ viśinaṣṭi -- nāyamātmā pravacanena labhyo na medhayā na bahunā śrutena | yamevaiṣa vṛṇute tena labhyastasyaiṣa ātmā vivṛṇute tanūṃ svāmiti | anena kevalaśravaṇamanananididhyāsanānāmātmaprāptyanupāyatvamuktvā yamevaiṣa ātmā vṛṇute, tenaiva labhya ityuktam | priyatama eva hi varaṇīyo bhavati; yasyāyaṃ niratiśayapriyaḥ sa evāsya priyatamo bhavati; yathā'yaṃ priyatama ātmānaṃ prāpnoti, tathā svayameva bhagavān prayatata iti bhagavataivoktam -- teṣāṃ satatayuktānāṃ bhajatāṃ prītipūrvakam | dadāmi buddhiyogaṃ taṃ yena māmupayānti te || iti, priyo hi jñānino'tyarthamahaṃ sa ca mama priyaḥ iti ca | ataḥ sākṣātkārarūpā smṛtiḥ smaryamāṇātyarthapriyatvena svayamapyatyarthapriyā yasya, sa eva pareṇātmanā varaṇīyo bhavatīti tenaiva labhyate para ātmetyuktaṃ bhavati | dhruvānusmṛtirūpopāsanasyaiva bhaktirūpatvam | nanu nāyamātmetyā dau śravaṇāditrikaṃ pratiṣidhya aparyanuyojyasvatantravaraṇamātreṇa tallābha ityuktam | tasmāt daivameva varaṃ manye pauruṣaṃ tu nirarthaka miti nyāyāduktaṃ sarvaṃ vitathamityatra sūtravākyayordhruvatvādiviśeṣitāyāḥ smṛterupāsanaśabdārthatayā'bhipretaṃ bhaktirūpatvaviśeṣaṇameva tatra vivakṣitamityāha -- evami ti | sāmānyaśabdānāṃ sūtrādyuktena viśeṣaviśramaprakāreṇetyarthaḥ | pratyakṣatāpannāmi tyetat vakṣyamāṇasya bhaktyātmakatvasya nyāyasāmyasūcanārtham | ahetukavaraṇamayuktam, tasyādimattve nirhetukatvāyogāt | anāditve mukterapyanāditvāpātāt , muktyupāyavidheśca vaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt, jīvavyāpārarūpabhedaviśeṣaniṣedhaparasya vaiṣamyanairghṛṇyaniṣedhakasūtrādeḥ virodhāpatteścetyabhiprāyeṇa apavargasādhanabhūtā mityuktam | phalāntarārthopāstiparatvaśaṅkā cānena nirastā | paro hyātmā'tra labhya iṣyate | viśinaṣṭi -na tu pramāṇaprāptaṃ nivartayatītyarthaḥ | anyathā upāyāntaravidhānavaiyarthyam , matvā dhīro na śocati, prajñānenainamāpnuyādi ti pūrvāparavirodhaśca syāt | nāyamātme tyādau śrutaśabdena śravaṇamupāttam | medhāśabdaśca dhyānārthaḥ syāt; medhāmanīṣe mā viśatāṃ samīcī bhūtasya bhavyasyāvaruddhyai iti śrutyanusārāt | dhīrdhāraṇāvatī medheti ca nighaṇṭuḥ | pāriśeṣyātpravacanaśabdaḥ śravaṇadhyānasahoktamananaparaḥ; procyate'neneti karaṇavyutpatteḥ | śiṣyamananārthagurupravacanena vā mananalakṣaṇā; pravacanahetau vā tatkāryopacāraḥ | nanu svarūpaniṣedhakasya kathaṃ tadvidhāyakatvam; atra ca kvacidaṅgāṅgipratiṣedhādvaiyarthyam, kvacittu vihitapratiṣedhādvirodha iti śaṅkāyāṃ śravaṇādivaiyarthyaprasaṅgaṃ ca pariharanvākyasya dhruvānusmṛtiviśeṣakatvaṃ vyanakti -- anene ti | yathā na pṛthivyāmagniścetavyaḥ ityatra niṣedhasya hiraṇyavaikalyaparihārārthatayā hiraṇyopahitatvavidhau tātparyam, tathā'trāpi pṛthivyā iva śravaṇāderyathārhaṃ praṇāḍyā sākṣāccāvaśyaṃbhāvitvātprītivaikalyaniṣedhamukhena triṣvapi prītiviśeṣavidhau tātparyamityabhiprāyavān kevala śabdaḥ yadvā nāntarikṣe na divītya bhāgipratiṣedhena saha paṭhitaḥ na pṛthivyāmiti prāptapratiṣedhaḥ yathā kevalapṛthivyā antarikṣādivadadhikaraṇatvavyudāsena hiraṇyopadhānatvavaiśiṣṭyavidhau viśrāmyati; tathā'nupāyabhūtaśravaṇamananābhyāṃ sahopāyabhūtanididhyāsanasya pratiṣedhaḥ kevalanididhyāsanasya śravaṇādivadanupāyatvoktimukhena bhaktyātmakatvavidhau paryavasyatīti | aniyamena yatheṣṭaṃ svatantravaraṇaśaṅkāvyudāsāya yadvṛttānūktibalena niyataviṣayavaraṇavyaktyarthaṃ yameve tyupādānam; vaiṣamyādidoṣānāghrātasarvasuhṛdvaraṇasya niyataviṣayatvāyogāt | yadāgneyaḥ iti vākyasthabhavativat, vṛṇuta ityasya prayojakavyāpāravidhau tātparyaṃ lapsyamānavaraṇaprayojakavyāpāravatā bhavitavyamiti | nanu hiraṇyopadhānasya pṛthivīsthatvāvaśyaṃbhāvavadetadvākyasthayadvṛttavyaṅgyavaraṇīyatāhetuguṇaviśeṣasya dhruvānusmṛtisaṃbandhaniyamādṛṣṭerna tasyāstena vaiśiṣṭyalābha ityatrāha -- priyatama iti | phalāntarārthabhaktyābhāsavyavacchedārthaṃ tamapprayogaḥ hiḥ śāstrato lokataśca parāvarapuruṣasvabhāvaprasiddhau | nanvetāvatā'pi varaṇīyasya priyatamatvāpādakaḥ kaścidanyo vyāpārassidhyatu; dhruvānusmṛterviśeṣitatvaṃ tu na labdhamityatrāha -- yasye ti | sa eva -- na sukṛtāntaravān, na ca kevaladhruvānusmṛtimān, nāpi nirvyājapriyaḥ kaściditi bhāvaḥ | asya samo'haṃ sarvabhūteṣvityā dinā svenaivoktasvabhāvasyeti yāvat | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- anyeṣāṃ svaprītihetuvyāpārāṇāṃ svalābhārthavaraṇahetutvābhāvāt svaviṣayaniyatātyantikaprītimāneva parasya priyatamo bhavan svaprāpaṇāya varaṇīyassyāt | iyaṃ ca niratiśayaprītirūpā buddhyavasthā muktisamutpādane vikalpasamuccayavidveṣiṇī ananyagatikapramāṇavaśānmuktisādhanatayā sthāpitadhruvānusmṛtimāśrayantī tāṃ viśinaṣṭīti | nanu svaśeṣatayā nityopāttasya kimadya varaṇam; sarvavyāpitayā nityaprāptasya kiṃ vedānīṃ labhyatvam; priyatama evāsya varaṇīya iti ca kutastyamityatra tatsarvamupabṛṃhaṇena spaṣṭayati -- yathe ti | ayam -- bhagavati nirupādhikabhogyatāvirbhāvena niratiśayaprītimān | ata eva priyatama ātmānaṃ prāpnoti -- ramate svātmani | praseduṣastasyāpavargāvyavahitahetubhūtabuddhiyogādipradāne'nyeṣāmiva parasāpekṣatvaṃ nāstīti vyaktyai svayamevetyu ktam | upāsituracintyameva hitamācaratīti vā sūcyam | bhagavataiva -- yamevaiṣa vṛṇuta iti varaṇakartṛtayā śrutenaiva | etena svatassarvajñatayā paramāptatvamapi vyajyate | satatayuktānām -- satatayogamāśaṃsamānānām; āśaṃsāyāṃ bhūtavacceti ktaḥ | satatayuktānāṃ bhajatāmityanenaivopāsakabuddheḥ prītirūpatvasya siddhatvāt prītipūrvakaṃ dadāmityanvayaḥ | upacārāpacārābhyāṃ prītidveṣau parasya na | nimittaśaktyā tu phalaṃ tayoriti nayojjhitaḥ || 313 || varaṇaṃ conninīṣā cādhoninīṣā ca śāsituḥ | śrutatvādaniṣiddhāni tattatkarmaphalārpaṇāt || 314 || kasyacidvaraṇīyatānidāne priyatamatve śrutyabhipretaḥ satatayuktaśabdoktaśca hetustatraiva vivṛta ityāha -- priyo hī ti | atyartham -- atyabhidheyam; mayā'pi durvacamiti bhāvaḥ | atra varaṇaṃ māmayaṃ prāpnuyāditi amoghassaṅkalpaḥ | atra labhyatvaṃ cāsya vivṛṇute ityanenābhipretam; nivṛttapratibandhanirupādhikānubhavaviṣayatvamityarthāduktaṃ bhavati | atra sopabṛṃhaṇayā'pi śrutyā dhruvānusmṛteḥ prītyātmakatayā viśeṣitatvamanabhivyaktaṃ vyanakti -- ata iti | lokānusārāt, upāttaśrutismṛtitātparyavṛttyā cetyarthaḥ | atyarthapriyā -- atimātrānukūlyasvabhāvatayā svayameva bhāsamānā ayuktadaśāyāmapi yā prītiravivekānāmiti nyāyena prītirūpajñānāntareṇa viṣayīkṛtā | viṣayaviśeṣāyattaṃ hi sarvatra viṣayiṇo jñānasya prītirūpatvaṃ prītiviṣayatvaṃ cetyabhiprāyeṇa smaryamāṇātyarthapriyatvoktiḥ | varaṇavivaraṇayoḥ kartuḥ tatkarmaṇo varaṇīyāt ārthī prākaraṇikī vyāvṛttiḥ pareṇe ti darśitā | evaṃrūpā dhruvānusmṛtireva bhaktiśabdenābhidhīyate, upāsanaparyāyatvādbhaktiśabdasya | ata eva śrutismṛtibhirevamabhidhīyate -- tameva viditvāti mṛtyumeti tamevaṃ vidvānamṛta iha bhavati | nānyaḥ panthā ayanāya vidyate | nāhaṃ vedairna tapasā na dānena na cejyayā | śakya evaṃvidho draṣṭṭuṃ dṛṣṭavānasi māṃ yathā || bhaktyā tvananyayā śakyaḥ ahamevaṃvidho'rjuna ! | jñātu draṣṭuṃ ca tattvena praveṣṭuṃ ca paraṃtapa || puruṣaḥ sa paraḥ pārtha ! bhaktyā labhyastvananyayā | iti | nanu śemuṣī bhaktirūpeti purāṇādiprasiddhaṃ bhakterupāyatvaṃ prakrāntam | dhyānopāsanādiśabdavācyami tyatra ādiśabdena bhaktiśabdo'pi vivakṣitaḥ, upāttāsu śrutiṣu tu na taddhīrasti; ataḥ kathamavirodhastatrāha -- evaṃrūpe ti | uktaśṛṅkhalākrameṇa viśeṣitetyarthaḥ | pratijñāmātrametadityatrāha -- upāsane ti | dhruvānusmṛteḥ prītirūpatvena upāsanaśabdavācyatayā ca viśeṣaṇāt, snehapūrvamanudhyānaṃ bhaktirityabhidhīyata iti tallakṣaṇānurodhāt, sevā bhaktirupāstiriti paryāyapāṭhāt śabdabhede'pyaikārthyasiddhau vidheyabhedābhāvānna virodhaprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ | vedanādiśabdānāṃ bhaktiparyavasāyitvamupavṛṃhaṇopabṛṃhaṇīyayoḥ mithaḥ pratikṣepakatvaprasaṅgarūpayuktyantareṇa dṛḍhīkṛtamityāha -- ata iti | idaṃ phalarūpahetuparam; vedanopāsanādiśabdairbhakterevoktatvādityarthaḥ | anyathā śrutīnāmiva śrutismṛtyorapi mitho virodhassyādityabhiprāyavānevakāraḥ | evam -- śrutau vedanavyatiriktaḥ, smṛtau tu bhaktivyatiriktaścaramopāyo nāstītyuktaprakāreṇeti yāvat | śvetāśvataropaniṣadaḥ paramapuruṣaviṣayatvam | nanu tameva viditvāti mṛtyumetīti śvetāśvataravākyaṃ śivādiśabdasamabhivyāhārādrudraviṣayam; tamevaṃ vidvāniti tu mahāpuruṣaviṣayam; tatra cātra ca nānyaḥ panthā ayanāyetyā mnātam; ato mitho vyāghāta iti mandaśaṅkāpanuttyai tadubhayavākyopādānam | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- vedāhametaṃ puruṣaṃ mahāntami tyādyaiḥ pūrvavākyaiḥ mahān prabhurvai puruṣassattvasyaiṣa pravartakaḥ, sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ ityādyairuttaravākyaiśca sattvapravartakasyānanyaparapuruṣasūktoditasya mahāpuruṣasya śabdato'rthataśca pratyabhijñayā śivamaheśvarādiśabdānāṃ tatparatvāvaśyaṃbhāvena aindrīnyāyena rūḍhiparityāgasya nyāyyatvāt, sarvaśśarvaśśivaḥ sthāṇuriti bhagavannāmapāṭhāt, śivaśabdasya ca maṅgalyādau rūḍhatvāt, prasiddhiprakarṣasyātroktarītyā naiṣphalyāt, ananyathāsiddhanārāyaṇānuvākasaubālamahopaniṣadādiprābalyāt śāśvataṃ śivamacyutamitivanmahāpuruṣaviṣayatvāvaśyaṃbhāvāt, tasmātsarvagataśśivaḥ ityasyārambhe sarvānanaśirogrīvassarvabhūtaguhāśayaḥ iti sahasraśīrṣatvādipratyabhijñānāt, sarvavyāpī ca bhagavāniti bhagavacchabdasya mahāpuruṣarūḍhatvasthāpanāt, nigamanasya prastutaśeṣatayā tadavirodhena neyatvācca vigītaṃ puruṣasūktoktaviṣayameveti | atra nāhami tyādeḥ vedatapaḥprabhṛtīnāṃ sākṣādupāyatvābhāve tātparyamiti na tadvirodhaḥ | bhaktyā tvananyayā ityādeśca parvabhedavataiva bhaktirūpajñānena jñānāntarādeḥ sādhyatve tātparyānnatmāśrayādiprasaṅgaḥ | puruṣaḥ sa paraḥ ityādyupādānasya na pūrveṇa kṛtakaratvam; tadapratipannakhyāpanāt | ayaṃ khalvihābhiprāyaḥ tamevaṃ vidvāni tyatra ādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāditi yatpūrvavākye śrutaṃ tadeva aṇoraṇīyāṃsamanusmaredyaḥ ityārabhya acintyarūpatvādityavarṇatvoktyā pratyabhijñāpitam | dhātā purastādi tyuktaṃ ca sarvasya dhātāramiti darśitam | tatra śrutau vidinoktamihānusmaratinā vivṛtam | bhaktyā yukta iti cānantaraṃ viśeṣyate | ato bhaktirūpā dhruvānusmṛtiḥ śrutau vidinā vidhīyata iti gamyate | yadyapyatra yadvṛttāvṛttivaśāt puruṣārthāntarasādhanaviṣayatvameva yuktam; tathā'pi samānanyāyatayā mokṣārthaviderapi bhaktiviśramasiddhissvīkāryā | tatraiva ca puruṣassa paraḥ ityādinā mokṣārthaśrautaviderapi tadviśeṣaparatvaṃ vyañjayati | yamevaiṣa vṛṇute tena labhya iti śrutisampuṭanigūḍhaṃ cātrodghāṭitam | atra hi jñānināṃ prāpyāntaravatprāpakāntaramapi saviśeṣaṇoktyā vyudastam| śrutyuktapratyabhijñayā prāpyaikyavat upāyaikyamapi hi yuktam | ato vidisthāne dhyāyatyupāsivadbhajatirapyatra viśeṣakatayā prayuktaḥ | puṃsūktabhagavadgīte pramāṇatamasaṃmate | na mitho bādhamarhetāṃ naikārthye smṛtyanādaraḥ || 315 || iti | nanu bhaktyā māmabhijānātī tyādau bhaktisādhyena jñānena paraprāptirgītā; maivam, tatrāpi tato māṃ viśate iti bhaktereva prāptihetutvena parāmarśāt; anyathā tataḥ ityasya nairarthyāt | ato bhaktyā praveṣṭumi tyuktyaikārthyam || evaṃrūpāyā dhruvānusmṛteḥ sādhanāni yajñādikarmāṇīti yajñādiśruteraśvavadityabhidhāsyate | yadyapi vividiṣantīti yajñādayo vividiṣotpattau viniyujyante; tathā'pi tasyaiva vedanasya dhyānarūpasyāharaharanuṣṭhīyamānasyābhyāsādheyātiśayasya āprayāṇādanuvartamānasya brahmaprāptisādhanatvāttadutpattaye sarvāṇyāśramakarmāṇi yāvajjīvamanuṣṭheyāni | vakṣyati ca āprayāṇāttatrāpi hi dṛṣṭam, agnihotrādi tu tatkāryāyaiva taddarśanāt, sahakāritvena cetyādiṣu | karmaṇāṃ vividiṣāsādhanatvenopayoga iti pakṣasya nirāsaḥ | nanu upāttaśrutismṛtisvārasyāt vedānuvacanayajñādinirapekṣā bhaktireva muktisādhanamastu; tataśca na karmavicāravṛttatvaṃ sidhyedityatrāha -- evaṃrūpāyā iti | sukṛtasāpekṣadhyānādibhaktyantaparvaviśeṣavattayā śrutismṛtisūtravākyasiddhāyā ityarthaḥ | śrutisūtrayoḥ vividiṣāviṣayatvaṃ prakaraṇato'rthataśca pratyūḍhamityabhiprāyeṇa dhruvānusmṛteḥ ityuktam | abhidhāsyate -- sūtrakṛtā; asmābhiśca samarthayiṣyata iti bhāvaḥ | vividiṣantī tyasya sannidhau manasaivānudraṣṭavyamiti viśadavedanaṃ vihitam; etameva viditvā munirbhavatī ti stutam | ato vidhistutiviṣayasyaiva vedanasyātra vidhyantarākāṅkṣā; na tu tadubhayarahitāyā vividiṣāyāḥ | vividiṣāsādhanatvena vidhānaṃ ca durvacam | na hi yāgena svargaṃ jigamiṣatītyu kte yāgasya jigamiṣāsādhanatvaṃ syāt; iha ca vedanecchāvirahe vividiṣākāmatvasyāsiddheḥ, tatsaṃbhave tadupāyānapekṣaṇaṃ, vedanecchayā ca vividiṣākāmanā, tayā yajñādyanuṣṭhānaṃ, tena vividiṣotpattiriti cakrakaṃ syāt | atra parvasaṅkocena ātmāśrayam, anyonyāśrayaṃ ca kecidūcuḥ | na cātrājñātasukṛtanītiḥ; sāvadhānakṛcchrasādhyatvādyajñādeḥ | ataḥ asinā jighāṃsatī tyādiṣvivānupapattyā necchāsādhanatvenānvayaḥ | sādhyecchayā vinā kvāpi sādhanecchā na sidhyati | ato vividiṣārthatvāyogādvidyarthatā tviha || 316 || apavargābhilāṣāttatsādhanecchā'pi sidhyati | ato vedanakāmasya yuktaṃ tatsādhane vidhiḥ || 317 || bhaktiratra phalatvena prakṛtyā parimṛśyate | adhikāratayā khyāpyā tadicchā pratyayena tu || 318 || nanu adṛṣṭasya sāṃsārikasarvakāryahetutvamevaiṣṭavyam; anyathā viṣamasukhaduḥkhādihetubhūtavicitrecchotpatteḥ kadācittadanutpatteścāyogāt | ata icchāmātrasya sādhyatve vedanecchāyā api tathātvāṃ tatkhaṇḍanaṃ sarvatantraviruddhaṃ syāt | atraivaṃ pratyuktaṃ śrutaprakāśikāyām -- bhogādṛṣṭodbodhitapūrvavāsanāsacivāt viṣayavailakṣaṇyajñānādicchotpattyupapatte riti| bhogārthena hyadṛṣṭena puṃbhiraprārthitānyapi | antarasthāni kāryāṇi syuḥ phalapradabuddhitaḥ || 319 || tadiha bhaktirūpabrahmavedanakāmaḥ śāntyādisahitaiḥ yajñādibhiḥ tadbhāvayediti prayogavidhiḥ | nanu bhaktyarthopāyavidhāvapi tvaduktacakrakādiprasaṅgassyāt | na syāt -- bhakterupacayam anuvṛtiṃta cāpekṣya tadvidhānāt; evaṃ vedanasādhanavidhāvapi na virodhaḥ; sāmānyato vidite'pi viśeṣato bubhutsayā pravṛtteḥ | na ca viśeṣe'pi viditāviditavikalpānupapattiriti vācyam; tavāpi bubhutsāpraśnādighaṭite vādādau pravṛtteḥ; anyathā pāmaraparīkṣakavirodhāt | athaivamutpannavividiṣasya tadanuvṛttikāmanayā tadupāyavidhirityucyeta; tatrāpi phalavaiṣamyābhāvāt tadanvārohāt paroktavedanasya prāgeva nirastatvāt | svoktabahvākāraviśiṣṭavedanecchānuvṛttyai yāvajjīvaṃ karmaṇo'nuṣṭheyatvamāha -- yadyapī ti | paroktavividiṣāmātrasādhanatve tvanvāroha iti pakṣe tu vividiṣānuvṛttyā pratyuttaraṃ kathaṃcinneyam | tasyaiva -- vividiṣāgocarasyaiva | na hyetadvedanaṃ yāgādivat apūrvādivadvā sakṛdutpannaṃ sāntaraṃ vā sādhanamityabhiprāyeṇa dhyānarūpatvo ktiḥ | aharahari tyādikaṃ nirantarasyāpyekāhasādhyatvaṃ darśapūrṇamāsādivaddivasāntaritasādhyatvaṃ ca vyavacchinatti | āprayāṇādanuvṛttivacanaṃ saṃvatsarādyavadhikapratidinakartavyatvavyudāsārtham | abhyāsādheyātiśayasye tyanena dṛṣṭopakāraścāstīti vyajyate | tadutpattaye -- anuvṛtte riṣṭatayā yajñādisādhyatvenābhimatavividiṣotpattaya ityarthaḥ | sarvāṇī tyetadyathārhaṃ vibhājyam | yāvajjīvami tyanena janmāntaraśatetyādeḥ prāguktasyopālambhaḥ | vividiṣāyāṃ jātāyāmapi madhye karmaṇāṃ tyāgo na yuktaḥ; vividiṣāvicchede vedanavicchedaprasaṅgāt | na hi sakṛdutpannayā vividiṣayā vedanānuvṛttiḥ sidhyet; sakṛdbubhukṣayeva bhojanānuvṛttiḥ | prācīnasukṛtabhūmnā'nuvṛttisaṃbhave'pi pākṣikavighnaśāntyai pravartitavyamiti bhāvaḥ | pūrvaṃ vedanasya dhyānopāsanādirūpatve sūtraṃ darśitam; atha aharaharāprayāṇādanuvartanīyatve tadvadeva tadaṅgakarmānuvṛttau ca sūtrāṇi santītyāha -- vakṣyati ce ti | sūtraireva tattadviṣayavākyānyapi sūcyante | etena svoktānabhyupagame sūtrādivirodho dṛḍhīkṛtaḥ | āprayāṇāttatrāpi hi dṛṣṭa mityanenaiva karmaṇo yāvadāyuranuṣṭheyatvaṃ siddham; sa khalvevaṃ vartayan yāvadāyuṣa miti vākyasya dṛṣṭamityanena vivakṣitatvāt tatra ca kuṭumbe śucau deśe ityādyuktadharmānuvṛtteḥ evaṃ vartayanni tyatrānūditatvāt | yāvajjīvamagnihotraṃ juhotī ti niyatasyāpi vidyāṅgatvajñāpanāya agnihotrādi sūtropādānam | vihitatvāccaśramakarmāpī tyāśramāṅgatayoktasya kathaṃ vidyārthatvamityatra viniyogapṛthaktvavyañjanāya sahakāritvena ce ti sūtragrahaṇam | ādiśabdena sarvathā'pi ta evobhayaliṅgādi ti karmaṇāṃ vidyāśra māṅgatve tantrānuṣṭhānasūcakasūtrasaṃgrahaḥ | vākyakāraśca dhruvānusmṛtervivekādibhya eva niṣpattimāha -- tallabdhirvivekavimokābhyāsakriyākalyāṇānavasādānuddharṣebhyaḥ saṃbhavānnirvacanācceti | vivekādīnāṃ svarūpaṃ cāha -- jātyāśrayanimittāduṣṭādannāt kāyaśuddhirviveka iti | atra nirvacanam -- āhāraśuddhau sattvaśuddhiḥ sattvaśudau dhruvā smṛtiriti | vimokaḥ kāmānabhiṣvaṅga iti | śānta upāsīteti nirvacanam | āraṃbhaṇasaṃśīlanaṃ punaḥ punarabhyāsa iti | nirvacanaṃ ca smārtamudāhṛtaṃ bhāṣyakāreṇa -- sadā tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ iti | pañcamahāyajñādyanuṣṭhānaṃ śaktitaḥ kriyeti; nirvacanam -- kriyāvāneṣa brahmavidāṃ variṣṭhaḥ, tametaṃ vedānuvacanena brāhmaṇā vividiṣanti yajñena dānena tapasā'nāśakeneti ca | satyārjavadayādānāhiṃsānabhidhyāḥ kalyāṇā nīti| nirvacanam -- satyena labhyaḥ, teṣāmevaiṣa virajo brahmaloka ityādi | deśakālavaiguṇyāt śokavastvādyanusmṛteśca tajjaṃ dainyamabhāsvaratvaṃ manaso'vasāda iti | tadviparyayo'navasādaḥ | nirvacanam -- nāyamātmā balahīnena labhya iti | tadviparyayajā tuṣṭiruddharṣa iti | tadviparyayo'nuddharṣaḥ; atisantoṣaśca virodhītyarthaḥ | nirvacanamapi śānto dānta iti | evaṃ niyamayuktasyāśramavihitakarmānuṣṭhānenaiva vidyāniṣpattirityuktaṃ bhavati | vākyakāroktavivekādi sādhanasaptakam | atha virodhādapramāṇatvāt ityādipūrvapakṣahetūn sūtrakārābhiprāyavidāṃ vacasā'pi pariharati -- vākye ti | evakāreṇa śamādeḥ yajñādeśca virodhābhāvaḥ svoktasaṃvādaśca khyāpyate | athavā na sādhanacatuṣṭayena, na ca vivekādiṣvanyatamena, karmamātreṇa, śamādimātreṇa cetyarthaḥ | niṣiddhakāmyavyarthebhyo nivṛttasya śamādibhiḥ | svāśramocitavidyāṅgapravṛttirna virudhyate || 320 || avirodhena saṃbhūya sādhanatvavyaktyai vākyamupādatte -- tallabdhiri ti | atra tacchabdārtho dhruvānusmṛteḥ ityanena darśitaḥ | upāsanaṃ syāt dhruvānusmṛti riti tatra prakṛtaṃ hi parāmṛśyate | vivekādīnāṃ saptānāmekasmin kārye'nyonyasāpekṣatvarūpeṇetaretarayogena samapravṛttinivṛttirūpāṇāmāśramabhedena vyavasthā śakyetyapi katipayaśaṅkā ca vyudastā | saṃbhavāt -- ekatra yogyatayā virodhaprasaṅgābhāvāt | nirvacanāt -- atīndriye'rthe niścāyakamānatayā niṣkṛṣṭādvacanāt, yuktisahitādāgamāditi yāvat | iha vidyāyāḥ karmajanyatvasiddhyarthatayo pāttāḥ ke vivekādayaḥ kathaṃ ca teṣāmavirodha ityatra vākyakāreṇaiva vyākhyātatvamamāha -- vivekādīnāmi ti | svarūpaṃ ca uddiṣṭānāṃ mitho vyāvartakarūpaṃ cetyarthaḥ | jātiduṣṭam -- laśunādi | āśrayaduṣṭam -- śūdrānnādi | nimittaduṣṭam -- keśādyupahatam | tādṛśadoṣarāhityenāśuddhebhyo vibhaktādannāt sendriyasya dehasya rajastamo'bhibhavarahitasattvonmeṣāpādanena śuddhitaḥ pṛthakkaraṇaṃ viveka iti | pradarśakaṃ vākyamāha -- jātīti | atra nirvacanami ti bhāṣyoktiḥ | āhāraśuddhau sattvaśuddhiri ti nirvacane sattvamantaḥkaraṇaṃ sattvaguṇo vā | tasya śodhanīyasarvopalakṣaṇatayā vākye kāyoktiḥ; sā'pi karaṇavargopalakṣikā | āyussattva ityādibhiḥ śuddhāśuddhāhāraśca gītaḥ | vimokaśabdasyātra kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobha ityādyuktatyājyavargānupaśleṣaparatayā kāmānabhiṣvaṅga iti mūlaghātoktirityabhiprāyaḥ | kāmotra tīvratamasaṅgajanyaḥ; saṅgāt saṃjāyate kāma ityukteḥ | tenābhiṣvaṅgo'nuvṛttadṛḍhagrahaṇam; tadabhāve kāmāt krodho'bhijāyata ityādyuktaparaṃparānivṛttiḥ | śānta upāsīte tyatra śāntaśabdaḥ karaṇavyāpāranivṛttimukhena kāmādirāhityaparaḥ | āraṃbhaṇam yogamārurukṣoḥ cittālambanaṃ śubhāśrayarūpam | vivaraṇe tu jñānālaṃbanamupāsya mityuktam | tasya saṃśīlanam anukūlatayā śīlanam | punaḥ punarityetadaṅgaprakaraṇāt vyāpṛtenāpi manase tyādismṛtyā cotthānakāle yojyam | ata eva nātmāśrayaśaṅkā | idaṃ ca yogānuguṇavāsanāpracayārthaṃ kaṣāyāpākaraṇārthaṃ ca | bālyaṃ ca pāṇḍityaṃ ca nirvidyātha muniḥ iti śrautanirvacanasyāspaṣṭārthatayā tadupabṛṃhaṇaṃ darśitamityabhiprāyeṇa smārtoktiḥ | atra bhāṣyakāro brahmanandīvākyavyākhyātā dramiḍācāryaḥ | tenānyeṣu śrutirudāhṛtā, atra tu smṛtiḥ | atha vā'nyatra vākyakāreṇaiva śrutirudāhṛtā, atra tu bhāṣyakāreṇaiva smṛtiriti | yadyapi yaṃ yaṃ vā'pi smaranni ti prakramāt sadetyādikaṃ sāmānyam; tathā'pi tasmātsarveṣu kāleṣu māmanusmara ityuttaravākyānusāreṇa prakṛtārthatvāttadgrahaḥ | pañcamahāyajñopādānaṃ gṛhastho'pi vimucyata iti smṛtisūcanārtham | ādiśabdenāśramāntaradharmāṇāmapi saṃgrahaḥ | yadyapi kāmye sakalāṅgopasaṃhāraḥ prāptaḥ; tathā'pi atra vacanādyathāśaktyanuṣṭhānaṃ paryāptamityabhiprāyeṇa śaktita ityuktam | taddhi kurvan yathāśakti prāpnoti paramāṃ gati miti hi smaryate | kriyāvāneṣa brahmavidāṃ variṣṭha ityatra sanprayogābhāvena karmaṇāṃ vidyānvayasphauṭyāt vividiṣantī tyetadapi niyamitam | idaṃ ca vākyaṃ kriyāyā aṅgatvena vidyāpauṣkalyahetutvaparam; na tu niṣkriyabrahmavitsadbhāvasūcakam, yāvajjīvaṃ kriyānuvṛtteruktatvāt | matvarthīyasya bhūmaparatayā vidhurādibrahmavidvyāvṛttiparaṃ vā | teṣāṃ hi varṇadharmamātrayogitvādavaratvam ata stvitarajjyāyo liṅgācce ti sūtrasiddham | atra mantreṣu karmāṇī tyārabhya tānyācarata niyataṃ satyakāmā iti śrutirapyanusandheyā | kriyā śabdasya cittasamādhānādimātravyāvṛttyai tameta mityādyupāttam | anāśakena -- anaśanena | atra gobalīvardanayāttapaśśabdasaṅkocaḥ | yadvā nāśakādanyeneti; yajñādyapi bhogārthaṃ cet saṃsārātmakanāśapradameva śrutyādisiddham | bhūtahitaṃ yathārthaṃ ca vākyaṃ satyam | ārjavam -- karaṇatrayasyaikarūpyam | dayā -- svārthanirapekṣā paraduḥkhanirācikīrṣā | dānam -- nyāyasiddhadravyasya yathāvidhi pātrasātkaraṇam | tena lobha nivṛttirvyajyate | daip śodhane iti dhātau svapakṣādiśodhanaṃ vā | do avakhaṇḍane ityatra parāhaṅkārakhaṇḍanaṃ vā, nigṛhṇīyādyathāśakti devatāgurunindakāni ti smṛteḥ | na vigṛhya kathāṃ kuryādi tyasya kāmakāraviṣayatvāt | aśāstrīyaprāṇipīḍāvarjanamatrāhiṃsā; ahiṃsan sarvabhūtānyanyatra tīrthebhya iti sthāpanāt | abhidhyā -- parapratikūlacintā; abhicārādau hyabhiḥ prātikūlyārthaḥ, parakṛtadrohe nirantarasmṛtirvā, vitathābhiniveśo vā, parasve grāhyatvadhīrvā; tannivṛttiranabhidhyā | evaṃ katipayopādānamārjavadayādisahapaṭhitānāmanyeṣāmapyupalakṣaṇam | ityādī tyanena amānitvamadambhitvaṃ, dayā sarveṣu bhūteṣu, kṣāntiranasū yā ityādeḥ saṃgrahaḥ | anavasādaḥ arthāt sidhyediti kṛtvā sahetukaṃ tatpratiyogisvarūpaviṣayaṃ vākyamupādatte -- deśa iti | śokanimittaṃ vastu śokavastu; śocatyaneneti karaṇavyutpattyā vā śokaśabdaḥ | ādiśabdo bhītihetu paraḥ, bhūtabhāvyaniṣṭagocaradhīrūpe duḥkhe śokabhaye | vaiguṇyāt anusmṛteśce tyanayormanaso'bhāsvaratvamityanenānvayaḥ | abhāsvaratvam bhāsvaratvābhāvaḥ tadvirodhi vā | tajjanitaṃ tadabhāsvaratvam | tatsvarūpābhivyaktyai tadvivaraṇavākyasyākāṅkṣāyāṃ madhye tajjaṃ dainyami ti vākyāntaram | tasyāṃ jātaṃ tasminmanasi vā jātamabhāsvaratvaṃ dainyam, upayuktaprakāśanāśaktatvamityarthaḥ | yadvā manaso yadabhāsvaratvaṃ, yacca tajjaṃ dainyaṃ tadubhayamavasāda iti yojyam | tajjam -- tādṛśadayāviśeṣājjātamityarthaḥ | asti hi puṃsāṃ paraduḥkhaduḥkhitvādi bhāsvaratvavirodhi manaso dainyam, tajjaṃ ca śokādikamiti vā neyam | bhāsvaratvamiha prakāśakatvam; tadabhāvaḥ | tajjaṃ ca dainyamavasāda ityatra tadviparyayo'navasāda iti vākyaśeṣo bhāṣyoktaḥ, vākye tu śiṣyāṇāmūhaśaktisaṃpattyai tadanuktiḥ | balahīnena -- samaduḥkhasukhaṃ dhīra mityuktamanobalarahitenetyarthaḥ | tadviparyayajā -- deśādiguṇairbhūtabhāvisukhahetudhiyā bandhusukhena ca jātetyarthaḥ | uddharṣoktāvapi pūrvavattadviparyayo'nuddharṣa iti ūhyatvādvākyānuktaṃ bhāṣye darśitam | yadṛcchālābhasaṃtuṣṭaḥ, satataṃ yogī, svādhyāyaśaucasaṃtoṣa ityādivirodhamāśaṅkyāha -- atisantoṣa iti | asaṃtoṣavadatisaṃtoṣo'pi viṣayāntareṣvapi pravartakatayā virodhītyarthaḥ | idaṃ coddharṣa ityupasargeṇa sūcitam | aiśvaryamadamatto hī tyādiṣu tattadvṛttānteṣu cāsya virodhitvaṃ prasiddham | nirvacanamapī tyatrāpiśabdassaṃbhavasamuccayārthaḥ pūrvanirvacaneṣvapi bhāvyaḥ | prakṛtaṃ karmaṇāmupayogaṃ nivṛttyaṃśena teṣāmavirodhena niveśanaṃ ca sūtravākyābhipretanyāyasamāhārasiddhaṃ nigamayati -- evami ti | evakāreṇa parāniṣṭatvaṃ dyotyate | tattvamasyādivākyāni vā vyavacchidyante | tadiha karmaṇaḥ anupayogavirodhapramāṇābhāvā nirastāḥ | vidyā ca iti īśāvākyaśrutyarthaḥ | tathā ca śrutyantaram -- vidyāṃ cāvidyāṃ ca yastadvedobhayaṃ saha | avidyayā mṛtyuṃ tīrtvā vidyayā'mṛtamaśnuta iti | atrāvidyāśabdābhihitaṃ varṇāśramavihitaṃ karma | avidyayā -- karmaṇā, mṛtyuṃ -- jñānotpattivirodhi prācīnaṃ karma, tīrtvā -- apohya, vidyayā -- jñānena, amṛtaṃ -- brahma, aśnute -- prāpnotītyarthaḥ | vidyāṃ ca iti īśāvākyaśrutyarthaḥ | atha mṛṣāvādinā samuccayavādibhyāṃ cānyathā vyākhyātā śrutirasmaduktaprakārameva vyanaktītyāha -- tathe ti | co 'vadhāraṇe | śrutyantaraṃ ca tatheti vā'nvayaḥ | antara śabdaḥ sanpratyayarahitatvena sphuṭārthatvādaṅgānāmaṅginiṣpādane dvārapradarśanāt karmaṇāṃ vidhyantānāṃ kaṇṭhoktavedanakaraṇakaphalabhāvanāniṣṭhatayā paramapuruṣārthaviśrāntibodhanācca prāguktavākyādviśeṣaṃ vyanakti | vidyāṃ ce tyādeḥ paravidyāṃ tadaṅgabhūtāṃ karmarūpāvidyāṃ cānuṣṭheyatvena śāstrato yo vettītyarthaḥ | cakārāvatroktasamuccayārthau | tayoranuktadyotakatve tu tattaditikartavyatāviśeṣayoreva vidyāphalayornivartyayośca prāptyupāyavirodhinorgrahaṇam | ubhayaṃ sahe tyatrāṅgāṅgitayā tṛtīyādhyāye sādhayiṣyamāṇayoranuṣṭheyayorbuddhyārohaṇe sāhityamabhipretam; na tu samakālatayopādeyatve | vedyatve hi sahabhāva ucyate; na tu sahitatayā vedanam | na hyutpattidaśāyāṃ virodhinirāsadaśāyāṃ ca vidyākarmaṇoḥ sahatvasaṃbhavaḥ | atra andhaṃ tamaḥ praviśantī tyādinā tato bhūya iva te tamaḥ ityādinā ca pratyekanindāparatvam | cakāraḥ sahaśabdaśca samasamuccayasthāpakāviti na bhramitavyam, teṣāmanyathāsiddhatvāt | ya u vidyāyām̐ ratā iti karmānādareṇa vidyotpattyarthotsāhavanta ityarthaḥ | karmaniratānāṃ vidyānirapekṣakarmasvarūpaṃ tāvanniṣpadyata eva; na tu tāvanmātreṇa muktiḥ; vidyāniratānāṃ hetvabhāvādvidyaiva na saṃbhavati, kutastarāṃ muktiriti bhūyaśśabdābhiprāyaḥ | avidyāśabdasyātra karmaviṣayatvaṃ prakaraṇena sthāpayati atre ti | na tu sarvatra ; avidyāyāmantare vartamānāḥ, kṣaraṃ tvavidyā, anātmanyātmabuddhirye tyādiṣu arthāntare prayogāt | iha tu ātmanyevānupaśyati, kurvanneveha karmāṇī tyādinā vidyā tadaṅgaṃ karma ca prakṛtam; tadevātrāvidyāśabdena vidyopayogajñāpanārthamanūditam | paravyākhyāyāṃ vyākhyātau saṃśayaviparyayau chettuṃ padārthavākyārthau spaṣṭayati -- avidyaye ti | pāpasyānarthahetutayā avayavaśaktyā gauṇyā vā mṛtyuśabdabodhyatvāya, yajñādervividiṣotpattivirodhinivartakatvavyudāsāya, coditajñānanivartyatayā śrutismṛtiśatasiddhaprāptivirodhivyāvṛttyai ca jñānotpattivirodhitvoktiḥ | yādavaprakāśīyanirvāho'pyetena nirastaḥ | yadyatra mṛtyutaraṇaṃ muktireva, kathaṃ vidyayā'nyatsādhyaṃ syāt | ktvāśrutiśca na ghaṭate; svāpekṣayā svasya pūrvatvāyogāt | dhīsaṅkocanivṛttiścedavidyākhyena karmaṇā | dhīvikāso'pi saiveti na sādhyāntarasaṃbhavaḥ || 321 || pratibandhanirāsaśca sādhyate cedavidyayā | amṛtāptiḥ svatassidhyennādṛṣṭāntarakāṅkṣiṇī || 322 || svataḥ svānubhavādhānapravaṇaḥ prāṇināṃ prabhuḥ | praśāntapratibandhānāṃ nirapekṣaṃ hi kāraṇam || 323 || mṛtyuśabdasya sādhāraṇyasaṃbhave'pi tameva viditvāti mṛtyumetī tyādispaṣṭārthabahuśrutismṛtibalena vidyānivartyaprāptivirodhiviṣayatvāsaṃbhavāt, tatra ca nānyaḥ panthā iti sādhanāntarapratiṣedhena karmaṇo vimuktisādhanatvena samuccetavyatvāyogāt, karmaṇaḥ śrutyādibhireva vidyāsādhanatvasthāpanādihopāyavirodhini karmaṇyeva vṛttiḥ | vidyāyā iva karmaṇaḥ uttarāghavirodhitvābhāvāt prācīnagrahaṇam | tīrtve tyasya svarasārthaṃ tyaktvā prāpya sthita iti paroktaṃ kliṣṭatvādadhyāhāratvāccayuktam | yajñādisatkarmaṇāṃ vividiṣāvirodhitayā mṛtyuśabdavācyaṃ karma tīrtveti gamanikā'pi vividiṣārthaviniyogapratiṣedhātpratyuktā | etaṃ setu mityādiṣu gatyabhāvāttarateḥ prāptivacanatvamityabhiprāyeṇa apohye tyuktam | vidyāśabdasya śāstrādiṣvapi prayogādiha prakṛtabrahmavedanaviṣayatvaṃ vyanakti -- jñānene ti | etadamṛtam, etadabhayam, etadbrahma, brahmavidāpnoti parami tyādiśrutyanusāreṇāha -- amṛtaṃ brahme ti | nanu pūrvam avidyānivṛttireva mokṣaḥ sā ca brahmavijñānādeva bhavatīti paroktamabhyupagatam; iha tu brahmavidāpnotī tyuktyā asyāṃ śrutau sādhyāntaraṃ svīkṛtamiti bhāti; maivam, avidyānivṛttiśabdena jñānasaṅkocanivṛtteḥ vivakṣitatvena bhāvāntarābhāvanayena saiva brahmaprāptiriti samānārtha tvāt | mokṣaśabdasvārasyānurodhāt avidyā karmasaṃjñetyuktabandhakakarmanivṛttivivakṣāyāṃ tu tāvanmātramevopāsanasādhyam | dhīsaṅkocahetunivṛttau setubhaṅgasrotaḥpravṛttinītyā tādṛśeśvarasaṃkalpena svataḥ prāpto dhīvikāsaḥ | ataḥ vidyayā'mṛtamaśnuta ityanena pratibandhanivṛttau vidyātaḥ siddhāyāṃ svatassetsyantī brahmānubhūtirucyata iti na pūrvāparavirodhaḥ | brahmaprāpteśca paramapuruṣārthatayā kāmyamānatve'pi tatpratibandhakanivṛttyupāyasya kāmyavargātpṛthageva vyapadeśaḥ | prāptitatsādhanānāṃ hi pratibandhanivartakāḥ | nivṛttidharmāḥ sarve'pi naimittikapade sthitāḥ || 324 || atra karaṇavibhaktyantarūpakarmajñānaśabdābhyāṃ kaṣāyapaktiḥ karmāṇi jñānaṃ tu paramā gatiḥ, kaṣāye karmabhiḥ pakve tato jñānaṃ pravartata iti spaṣṭārthopabṛṃhaṇārthaḥ sūcyate | tena ca mṛtyuśabdasyātropāyavirodhiviṣayatvaṃ vedānuvacanādīnāṃ vividiṣantītyatra prakṛtyarthenānvayaḥ samuccayavādanirāsaśca sidhyet | kaṣāyasya pāpasya tajjanyarāgādervā paktiḥ, pacyate'neneti pākanimittam, gamyate'neneti gatiḥ | tato jñānam -- na tu vivi diṣā, nāpi muktiḥ pravartate | ucitaviṣaye prakṛṣṭavṛttimadbhavatītyarthaḥ | puṇyasya pāparūpatvaṃ puṇyapāpayīrdharmāpanodyatvaṃ ca | mṛtyutaraṇopāyatayā pratītā avidyā vidyetarat vihitaṃ karmaiva | yathoktam -- iyāja so'pi subahūn yajñān jñānavyapāśrayaḥ | brahmavidyāmadhiṣṭhāya tartuṃ mṛtyumavidyayā || iti | āstāṃ prakaraṇam | asminneva vākye karmaṇāṃ vidyāṅgatve sādhāraṇānāmavidyādiśabdānāmasmaduktapadārthaniyame ca nirbādhaḥ svārasyaprāpto vastusāmarthyarūpo heturlakṣya ityabhiprāyeṇāha -- mṛtyutaraṇe ti | pratīte ti hetugarbham | vidyetaradi tyetat atratyāvidyāśabdaniruktiḥ | abrāhmaṇādiśabdanayāttadanyavṛttau prakaraṇasthāsannaviṣayatvaṃ yuktamityabhiprāyeṇa vihitaṃ karme tyuktam | na tvavihitaṃ karma, nāpi brahmajñānādikamiti padadvayānvitāvadhāraṇābhiprāyaḥ | etena kurvanneveha karmāṇī tyatra karmaśabdaḥ sādhāraṇo'pi ucitaviṣaye niyamitaḥ; na hi kāmyādikaṃ yāvajjīvamanuṣṭheyam | uktaśruterupabṛṃhaṇena svoktau padārthavākyārthau sthirīkṛtāvityāha -- yathoktami ti | jñānavyapāśrayaḥ āgamotthajñāne pratiṣṭhitaḥ | brahmavidyāmadhiṣṭhāya -- vivekādijanyāṃ paravidyāṃ bhaktirūpāpannāṃ niṣpādyatvenābhisaṃdhāyetyarthaḥ | āgamotthaṃ vivekācce ti prastutaṃ jñānadvayameva hyatra spaṣṭīkṛtam | ata eva mṛtyuśabdasyātra vividiṣāviro dhitvaṃ cāyuktam; tasyāḥ sādhyatvenānupādānāt | brahmavidyāmadhiṣṭhāyetyanenaiva vividiṣāniṣpatterarthasiddhatvācca | tartuṃ mṛtyu miti prayojanavacanena tīrtve tyasya prāptyarthatvaśaṅkā ca nirastā | upabṛṃhaṇīyaśrautapadasūcakāvidyāśabdoktameva ca yajñaśabdena vyañjitam | yajñān iyāja -- cakāretyarthaḥ | jñānavirodhi ca karma puṇyapāparūpam | brahmajñānotpattivirodhitvenāniṣṭaphalatayobhayorapi pāpaśabdābhidheyatvam | asya ca jñānavirodhitvaṃ jñānotpattihetubhūtaśuddhasattvavirodhirajastamovivṛddhiddhāreṇa | pāpasya ca jñānodayavirodhitvam eṣa evāsādhu karma kārayati taṃ yamadho ninīṣatīti śrutyā'vagamyate | rajastamasoryathārthajñānāvaraṇatvam, sattvasya ca yathārthajñānahetutvaṃ bhagavataiva pratipāditam -- sattvātsaṃjāyate jñānamityādinā | ataśca jñānotpattaye pāpaṃ karma nirasanīyam | tannirasanaṃ cānabhisaṃhitaphalenānuṣṭhitena dharmeṇa | tathā ca śrutiḥ -- dharmeṇa pāpamapanudatīti | nanu dharmeṇa pāpasyaivāpanodyatvaṃ śrutam, atratu prācīnaṃ karmetyaviśeṣeṇa puṇyasyāpi taraṇaṃ kathaṃ bhāṣitamityatra vakṣyamāṇaśrutāvapanodyatayoktaṃ śodhayati -- jñāne ti | puṇyasya kathaṃ dharmāpanodyatvaṃ, pāpaśabdavācyatvaṃ cetyatrāha -- brahme ti | ubhayori ti vigītāvigītasaṃvalitatvoktirnidarśanaparā | atra abhidheyatvam -- bodhyatvam | lakṣayediti vivaraṇoktirvaibhavāt | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- sa eva dharmasso'dharmastaṃ taṃ prati naraṃ bhave dityādi smaryate | ataḥ puṇyābhisandhiprasiddhamapi mumukṣudaśāyāṃ pāpāyate | mumukṣutvāmumukṣutvadaśābhedena karmiṇaḥ | karmaikaṃ pāpapuṇyatve sādhyaikye'pi samaśnute || 325 || śyenādeścoditasyaiva dvairūpyaṃ dvividhaśruteḥ | ekasyaivaikadaivāsti kālabhede tu kiṃ punaḥ || 326 || prakṛṣṭasukharūpasvargaikasādhanaṃ puṇyamapi hyantarāyanirayaśabdaninditasvaphalasaṅgārthasiddhyai nirupādhikasukharūpabrahmajñānaṃ pratiruṇaddhi; ataḥ pravṛttidharmasya nivṛttidharmeṇāpanodyatvaṃ yujyate | pāpalakṣaṇaṃ ca karturaniṣṭaphalasādhanatvena śāstravedyatvam; naitam̐ setumahorātre tarato na jarā na mṛtyarna śoko na sukṛtaṃ na duṣkṛtam | sarve pāpmāno'to nivartanta iti śrutau ca nigamanasthasya pāpmaśabdasya śokādiṣu lākṣaṇikatve'pi sukṛtaduṣkṛtayornimittasaṃbhavānmukhyatvameva grāhyam | chatrinyāyena sarvatra lakṣaṇāvṛttyaikyapakṣe'pi tāratamyamasti | na ca sukṛtadu ṣkṛtaśabdayoriva duṣkṛtapāpmaśabdayoriha, gobalīvardanyāyāt pāpmaśabdasya duṣkṛtaviśeṣaparatvaṃ śaṅkyam; ubhayorapi vyāpitvena hayaturaṅgaśabdayoriva tadayogāt; sarvaśabdaviśeṣaṇavaiyarthyaṃ ca | apahatapāpmā hyeṣa brahmalokaḥ ityanantaravākyaṃ ca prakṛtasarvaheyanivṛttiprakhyāpane svarasam | tadiha pūrvāparapāpmaśabdayorasaṅkocena samānārthatvameva yuktam | evaṃ sati puṇyaviśeṣe pāpaśabdaḥ pravṛttinimittaikyāt ghaṭata iti | nanu rajastamasorjñānavirodhitvamiṣṭam; tat kiṃ pāpena saha samuccayataḥ, vikalpataḥ, kāraṇāntareṇa veti niyāmakābhāvātpāpasya jñānavirodhitvaṃ duravadhāraṇam; ato duḥkhasādhanatvameva tasyetyatrāha -- asye ti | śuddhasattvamihābhibhūtarajastamaskamupayuktaprakāśādijanakaṃ sattvam | jñānotpattidaśāyāmapi puṃsāṃ traiguṇyānuvṛttyā tadātanaguṇāntarābhyāṃ viśeṣavyaktyai vivṛddhiśabdaḥ | karmavaśyā guṇā ityādibhiḥ guṇānāṃ taddvāratvasiddhiḥ, pāpasya duḥkhasādhanatvaṃ ca nānyavyavacchedeneti bhāvaḥ | dvayorapi jñānavirodhitve mānābhāve kathaṃ dvāradvāritvakalpanamityatra dvāriṇastāvadvirodhitve mānamāha -- pāpasye ti | eṣa eve tyādiśrutau na tāvat adho ninīṣatī tyetannirayādininīṣārtham; atronninīṣāyāḥ svargādiviṣayatvābhāvāt | yamebhyo lokebhya unninīṣatī tyatra svargādisarvalokebhyo hyunnayanaṃ svarasataḥ pratīyate | ato'pavargaprāpaṇapratipakṣabhūtādhonayanārthamihāsādhukarma tatsādhanaviruddhameva syāt; tatsādhanaṃ cātra māmupāssve tyādivihitam | tasya copakrame yaṃ tvaṃ manuṣyāya hitatamaṃ manyase iti hitatamatvamavyavahitamokṣopāyatvaṃ siddham | tadevātra sannidhibalāt sādhāraṇenāpi sādhukarmaśabdena gṛhyate | tatkārayitṛtvaṃ ca dadāmi buddhiyogaṃ tami tyādibhirviśeṣato'pyuktam | tasya cotpattipratibandhakatvena viruddhaṃ karma bhagavadvaimukhyāpādanaṃ karma; tatsāṃmukhye'dhogatiprasaṅgābhāvāt | asādhukarmaṇaścādhogatinidānatvam tānahaṃ dviṣataḥ krūrāni tyārabhya tato yāntyadhamāṃ gati mityantena sphuṭīkṛtam | yadvā sādhukarmaśabda iha prastutopāyākāṅkṣitāṅgaparaḥ | na cātra karmaṇa unnayanaśabdoditamuktyupāyatvam advārakam; śrutyādibhissadvārakatvasthāpanāt | ato vidyāṅgakarmapratikoṭisthamasādhukarmātra vidyotpattiviruddhameva | kiṃ ca sādhvasādhukarmakārayitṛtvamiha na prācīnajīvakarmanirapekṣam; vaiṣamyanairghṛṇyaprasaṅgāt | na ca vāyūdakādivat prerakatvam; śāstravaiyarthyādiprasaṅgāt, buddhipradānādivacanavirodhācca | ataḥ yamadho ninīṣatī ti yadvṛttena kasyacidanuvādo'dhoninīṣāhetubhūtapāpakāritvaṃ vyanakti | pūrvapāpe cottarapāpārambhe jñānalopaḥ tanmūlaviparītajñānaṃ ca dvāram | tathā copabṛṃhitam -- yasmai devāḥ prayacchanti, pāpaṃ prajñāṃ nāśayatī tyādibhiḥ | sarvadeveṣu sarvapāpeṣu ca sāmānyoktamapi prakṛte' pyakuṇṭhitam | viśeṣataśca gīyate -- kṣipāmyajasrami tyādi | ataḥ pāpasya jñānodayavirodhitvaṃ siddham | nanu śrutena dvividhena pāpenaiva jñānaṃ niruddhatām, nivṛttidharmeṇa cotpadyatām; alamubhayatra prakṛtiguṇairdvārīkṛtairityatrāha -- raja iti | sattvasye tyupādānamiha rajastamasorvyatirekavyāptyā ca jñānahetutvaniścayārtha sādhukarmadvārapradarśanārthaṃ jñānotpattihetubhūtaśuddhasattvetyuktasthāpanārthaṃ ca | śrutismṛtipramitānyataratyāgasya sati gatyantare vikalpasya cāyogāt dvāradvāritvamevātra yuktamiti bhāvaḥ | nanu rajaso lobha ityanenānyathādhīhetutvamapi siddham, aprāptaviṣayalobhasya bhrāntihetutvāt; yayā dharmamadharmaṃ ce tyādinā tadvyaktam | nābhuktaṃ kṣīyate karme tyādismṛtyā karmaphalabhogāvasāne jñānaṃ sādhyatāṃ, dharmasya ca dhṛtiśabdārthasukhasādhanatvameva prāptamiti śaṅkāpanuttyai niṣkṛtiśāstraviniyogapṛthaktvābhyāṃ siddhaṃ nirāsyanirāsakasvabhāvaṃ nirdhārayannuktamarthadvayaṃ nigamayati -- ata iti | nirasanīyam -- ananteṣu pāpeṣu saṃtanyamāneṣu na kadācidapi bhogena niśśeṣaśāntyavasaraḥ; ataśśāstroktaniṣkṛtyaiva tannirāsaḥ kārya iti bhāvaḥ | tathā'pyaparimitānāṃ niṣkṛtirapyaśakyetyatrāha -- tadi ti | svalpamapyasya dharmasye tyādinyāyena phalāntarasaṅgarahitanivṛttidharmamāhātmyāttannivartanaṃ śakyamityāśayaḥ | ya u cainamevaṃ vede tyādiṣu śāstrārthavedane phalaśrutiḥ praśaṃsārthā, paraṃparayā vā syāt, adhikāribhedena vā | ataḥ anuṣṭhānaṃ pradhānam; tatparityāgināṃ tu kāraṇābhāvāt kāryābhāva ityabhiprāyeṇoktam -- anuṣṭhitene ti | upāttaśrutigatānāmavidyādiśabdānāṃ sveṣṭārthatvaṃ, pāpasya bhogena vinā'pi nivartyatvaṃ ca spaṣṭayantīṃ śrutimudāharati -- tathe ti | tatra dharmaśabdaḥ prāyaścittamātraviṣayo'pyaviśeṣānnivṛttidharmamapi gṛhṇāti | vijñānādānando brahmayoni rityādinā brahmavidyāsannidhānāt | sahapaṭhitadānādiṣu pratītāni dviṣadvaśīkaraṇaphalāntarāṇyapi brahmavidyāniṣpattyanuguṇānyeva | aṅgiphalaṃ cātra bhūyo na mṛtyumupayāhi vidvā niti prasphuṭam | ato'tra nivṛttidharmeṇa sāṃsārikapuṇyapāpayoḥ dvayorapi pāpaśabdoktayornivartyatvaṃ sidhyediti | karmavicārasya pūrvavṛttatā | tadevaṃ brahmaprāptisādhanabhūtaṃ jñānaṃ sarvāśramakarmāpekṣam | ato'pekṣitakarmasvarūpajñānaṃ kevalakarmaṇāmalpāsthiraphalatvajñānaṃ ca karmamīmāṃsāvaseyamiti saivāpekṣitā brahmajijñāsāyāḥ pūrvavṛttā vaktavyā | etāvatā kimāyātamityatra tanmūlamupāsanātmakaṃ jñānamityanenābhipretaṃ karmasāpekṣatvaṃ nirūḍhamityāha -- tadi ti | tat -- uktaśrutismṛtisūtropapattisaṃpradāyabalāt | evam -- niṣkā makarmaṇāṃ brahmavidyāpratibandhanirāsakatvaprakāreṇa | astvevaṃ vicāryasyopāsanasya svāṅgakarmāpekṣā | tadvicārasya kṛtsnakarmavicārāpekṣā kathamityatra sthāpitamarthaṃ nigamanena sthirayati - ata iti | muktisādhanavidyāyā nivṛttidharmanairapekṣyāyogāt ityarthaḥ | apekṣitakarmasvarūpajñānāmi tyanena vṛddhavyavahāreṇa vrīhyādivatkarmamīmāṃsayā yajñādipadārthānāṃ setikartavyatākānāṃ viśeṣato veditavyatayā vidhiviniyojyasvarūpāpekṣiṇi viniyoge nāgṛhītaviśeṣaṇanyāyataḥ svāṅgasādhyasya phalasādhanatayā tatsvarūpānvitasyaiva bubhutsitatvam, acintite'pyupāsane karmaṇaścintayituṃ śakyatvaṃ ca sūcyate | vidyānaṅgakarmanindayā vidyāprarocanaṃ ca tādṛśakarmajñānāpekṣamityabhiprāyeṇa kevala ityādikamuktam | avaseyam -- sādhyamiti yāvat | mīmāṃsā atra vicāraḥ | tyājyopādeyasahitopāsanaśāstrārthaṃ vicārayatāmavaśyaṃbhāvinastadubhayasvarūpaniścayasya karmamīmāṃsāsādhyatayā atra apekṣitā tvadaniṣṭāvṛttatvena vaktuṃ yuktetyabhiprāyeṇa saive tyuktam | antataḥ karmaparīkṣāsāpekṣā tāpatrayavṛttatoktiścānena nirastā | sādhanacatuṣṭayasya vā vyudāsa evakāreṇopakṣipyate | sādhanacatuṣṭayapūrvavṛttatānirāsaḥ | api ca nityānityavastuvivekādayaśca mīmāṃsāśravaṇamantareṇa na saṃpatsyante, phalakaraṇetikartavyatādhikāriviśeṣaniścayādṛte karmasvarūpatatphalatatsthiratvāsthiratvātmanityatvādīnāṃ duravabodhatvāt | eṣāṃ sādhanatvaṃ ca viniyogāvaseyam, viniyogaśca śrutiliṅgādibhyaḥ, sa ca tārtīyaḥ | na kevalamasmaduktasya yuktatvamātram; tvaduktasya doṣo'pyastītyabhiprāyeṇāha api ceti | tatrānyonyāśrayamuddhāṭayati -- nitye ti | castvartho vartiṣyamāṇasya vṛttatāvaiparītyadyotakaḥ | mīmāṃsā śabdo'tra bhāgadvayārthaḥ; ātmanityatādyupādānāt | śravaṇa śabdaśca vicāraparyantaḥ | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- kimatra vivekaśabdena niścayo vivakṣitaḥ, āpātadhīrvā ? nādyaḥ, kṛtsnamīmāṃsāsādhyasya brahmavicārāpekṣayā pūrvavṛttatvāyogāt; ātmanityatvādikaṃ brahmakāṇḍe hi nirūpayiṣyate | na dvitīyaḥ, tasyāḥ karmabrahmakāṇḍasādhāraṇatvena viśeṣato'tra vaktumayuktatvāt | prathamātikrame kāraṇābhāvasya coktatvāt | na ca sā phalāntaravairāgyāderhetuḥ; ubhayatrāmṛtatvādyāpātadhīsiddheḥ | na ca kapilakaṇādāditantrairvivekaḥ; adhyayanādikrameṇa tadavasaranirodhokteḥ, teṣu ca bahudhā niḥśreyasatatsādhanādau vivekavaiparītyasya tvayā'pi saṃmatatvāt | ata eva hi nirasiṣyante | nityaṃ hi nāsti jagatī tyādyupabṛṃhaṇaṃ tu śrutimanurudhyaiva vive kārthaṃ syāt | na tu svātantreṇa; anyathā kiṃ śārīrakeṇa ? tato'nyatra saṃśayādisaṃbhavāditi cet; tarhi tatra na vivekasiddhiḥ | yattvatra vācaspatinoktam -- nityānityayorvasatīti nityānityavastu taddharmāḥ, nityānityayordharmiṇostaddharmāṇāṃ ca viveko nityānityavastuviveka ityārabhya, nityatvaṃ satyatvaṃ tadyasyāsti tannityaṃ satyaṃ, tathā cāsthāgocaraḥ | anityatvamasatyatvaṃ, tadyasyāsti tadanityamanṛtam; tathā cānāsthāgocara iti; yadṛtaṃ tannityaṃ sukhaṃ vyavasthāpyate, tadāsthāgocaro bhaviṣyati, yattvanityamanṛtaṃ bhaviṣyati, tāpatrayaparītaṃ tattyakṣyata iti so'yaṃ nityānityavastuviveka iti ca | etadapi mandam -- anityasyāpyabādhitatvena satyatvasya sthāpayiṣyamāṇatvāt | na ca nityaṃ sukhamanupādeyamiti dhiyā karmiṇāṃ karmavicārādau pravṛttiḥ; kiṃ tu tasya karmasādhyatvabhramādvā daurlabhyabuddhyā vā | kiṃ ca nityatvādimātraṃ nāsthāgocaratvādinidānam | puruṣārthatatsādhanatvābhyāmeva sā''sthā, tadvaiparītyāccanāsthā | te ca nityānitye ca yathārhe syātām | nirūpakasyāpi hyanityasukhatyāgaḥ aśakyāni durantāni samavyayaphalāni ce ti nyāyāt, adhikasukhalābhatṛptyā vā syāt | tadabhāve atyalpamapi sukhamupādīyate | nityamapi yadi duḥkhātmakamanubhayarūpaṃ vā, kathamāsthārham ? prakṛtasya prakṛṣṭasukhatvena pratītatvāditi cet; tatpratītistāvanna vyāptyā, adṛṣṭeḥ | na ca śrutyā, tanmūlāpātadhiyassādhāraṇyādidausthyāt, niścayasya tu mithassaṃśrayagrastatvāt; tantrāntarasmṛtyoścāsādhakatvasya darśitatvāt | nityasukhasaṃbhavamūlopāditsā ca sādhāraṇī | tantrāntare tadasaṃbhavaśca suvyaktaḥ | ānando brahme tyādiramīmāṃsitakarmabrahmabhāgairdurbodhaḥ, pramāṇādhyāye tarkapāde ca tannirāsāt | tata evātrādyasūtre'nyatra ca nityaphalāsaṃbhavaḥ prakṛtopayogāt pratiṣṭhāpyata ityapi durvacam, yuṣmābhirevaṃ sūtravākyārthānukteśca | api ca nityasukhasyātra saṃbhāvanāmātram | svargādisukhasyānityatvaṃ ca na śāstrāntareṇānumānena vā sidhyet, tābhyāmeva vaiparītyasyāpi suvacatvāt, svargasukhamanityaṃ sukhatvādityāderamṛtatvādiśrutibādhāt | tadānyaparyasya tannirūpaṇasāpekṣatvāt; anyathā muktasukhamanityaṃ sukhatvādityāderapi prasakteḥ | tadaprasaktiśca trayyantarthanirṇayāt, sa ca tayeti mithassaṃśrayaḥ | ataḥ karmavicāra evātrāpekṣyaḥ | śamadamādīnāṃ sādhanatvavivekaḥ tatsvarūpamātraṃ vā vṛttamityucyate, na pūrvaḥ, tasya śamadamādyupetaḥ syādi ti sādhanalakṣaṇe niṣpādyatvāt | nottaraḥ, tatra śravaṇaupayikāvadhānādimātrarūpāṇāṃ sarvaśāstrasādhāraṇyena viśeṣato'tra vaktumayuktatvāt | yogaupayikānāṃ tu bāhyāntaḥkaraṇanirodhādirūpāṇāṃ trayyantārthaśrava ṇāt pūrvamayukteḥ, tasmādevaṃvicchānto dānta iti brahmadhīpūrvatvokteśca | kiṃ ca nityānityavivekādayaḥ kiṃ hetusādhyarūpeṇa sthitāḥ, anyathā vā ? ādye karmavicāro'pi parīkṣya lokāni tyādiprakāreṇa mumukṣāyāḥ paraṃparayā hetuhetumadbhāvātsaha pāṭhyaḥ; anyathā mumukṣatvamekameva hi pāṭhyam; kiṃ catuṣkagrahaṇena ? dvitīye'pyabhyugamavirodhāt vivekādvairāgyami tyādikramasya parairvyākhyātatvāditi | atra mīmāṃsāśravaṇamantareṇe tyuktaṃ vivṛṇoti -- phale ti | karmabhāge svargādiryāgādiḥ prayājādiḥ bubhukṣuśca phalādayaḥ; brahmabhāge tu muktyupāstiśamādimumukṣavaḥ | eṣāṃ viśeṣaḥ pūrvapakṣoktādvyāvṛttaṃ rūpaṃ mitho bhedaśca | nātra phalakaraṇādiniścayena karmasvarūpādibodhoktau sādhyāviśeṣaḥ; padārthavārkyārthanityā teṣu teṣvadhikaraṇeṣu tattadavāntaravākyārtha niścayena paścānmithaḥ saṃsṛṣṭaviśiṣṭamahāvākyārthabodhokteḥ | vairāgyādimūlabhūtasya nityānityavivekasya phalakaraṇādiniścayāntargatabodhanaparatvācca | karmagrahaṇamihopāsterapyupalakṣakam kriyata iti vobhayasaṃgrahaḥ | upāsane'pi karmaśabdassūtre'pyuktaḥ -- prakāśaśca karmaṇyabhyāsādi ti | tatra ca bhāṣyam upāsanātmake karmaṇī ti | anyatra ca yāgādikamupāsanātmakaṃ ca karmeti | mānasakarmoktiśca smṛtyādiṣu dṛśyate | karmaśabdasyātra jyotiṣṭomādimātraviṣayatvaṃ matvā tatsthiratvāsthiratvetyetannirūpaṇaprakārasyānukāraḥ; na tu niścayaprakārasyeti kecit | atra vaighaṭyavyañjakena vyatirekeṇa bhāṣyamāṇasyāyaṃ bhāvaḥ -- kiṃ kena kathamityākāṅkṣitaphalādyaṃśatrayaniścayamantareṇa kathaṃ tryaṃśabhāvanātmakakarmabodhaḥ; kathaṃ ca jīvanādiviśeṣitādhikārānvitasvargādipadārthasya dehāntaradeśāntarabhāgyatvaniścayaḥ ? tadabhāve ca kathaṃ lokāyatasaugatagatikhaṇḍanagarbhapūrvottaradehānuvṛttātmādhyavasāyaḥ ? ātmani ca sukhatayopalabdheranyathāsiddhyā vacanamantareṇa kathaṃ sukhatvaśrutimukhyatvam ? tādṛśātmaniścayābhāve dehamevātmānaṃ manyamānasya kathamaihikaphalaviraktiḥ ? nityasukharūpatayā siddhasyāpyadhikartuḥ pravṛttidharmaphalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ parimitaviṣayabhogarūpamanityaṃ, nivṛttidharmaphalaṃ paraṃ nityamiti niścayālābhe kathaṃ svargādyanityaphalajihāsā, naigamāntikanityaphaladhiyā samākarṣaśca ? atassādhanacatuṣkavṛttavāde vivekaviśeṣādermūlatayā bhāgadvayavicāra eṣṭavyaḥ | tataśca karmavicārasāpekṣatvam | paramanyonyāśrayastvadhikaḥ -- iti | ādiśabdena jñānānandarūpatvasaṃgrahaḥ | śamādisādhanasaṃpattau viśeṣataśca doṣamāha -- eṣāmi ti | śānto dānta ityādiviniyojakavākyoktānāmityarthaḥ | viniyogo'ṅgāṅgitvabodhanam | saṃbandhaḥ iti tu nyāyasudarśanam | śamāderaṅgatve bodhite hyatra sādhanatvamanuktamapyarthātsidhyet | tataḥ kimityatra śeṣalakṣaṇasiddhapramāṇalakṣaṇasāpekṣatvamāha viniyoga iti | etairmānairbrahmakāṇḍa eva tadviniyogaścintyatāmityatrāha -- sa iti | sa ca tārtīyaḥ -- prāguktasaṃgatikrameṇa karmakāṇḍatṛtīyādhyāyoktaḥ | iha punastṛtīye lāvānusārātpūrvaṃ vyutpāditaistairevākṣepasamādhānamātraṃ kariṣyate | evamevādhyāyāntaranyāyopajīvanaṃ cātra draṣṭavyamiti bhāvaḥ | udgīthādyupāsanānāṃ sāṅgatyam | udgīthādyupāsanāni karmasamṛddhyarthānyapi brahmadṛṣṭirūpāṇi brahmajñānāpekṣāṇītīhaiva cintanīyāni | tānyapi karmāṇyanabhisaṃhitaphalāni brahmavidyotpādanasādhanānīti tatsādguṇyāpādakānyetāni sutarāmihaiva saṃgatāni | teṣāṃ ca karmasvarūpādhigamāpekṣā sarvasaṃmatā || atha yuktyantaraṃ darśayannudgīthādyupāsanavicārasya sthānāntarānarhatayā'traiva mukhyasaṃgatyā karmabrahmacintākramaṃ sthāpayati -- udgīthe ti | karmasamṛddhyarthānyapī tyanena pūrvatropayogaḥ, iha neti śaṅkoddhāṭyate | karmasamṛddhiḥ -- tadeva vīryavattarami ti śrutyukteḥ prabalakarmabhirapratibandho guṇaphalarūpaḥ | brahmadṛṣṭirūpāṇī ti hetugarbham | brahmajñānāpekṣāṇi -- na hyāropyasvarūpamanyatrājānataḥ kvacidapi tadāropaḥ; anirvacanīyādidṛṣṭerdūṣayiṣyamāṇatvāt | iha ca brahmajñānaṃ prathamadvikasādhyamityāśayaḥ | dṛṣṭyupāsanānāṃ pradhānānupayogaṃ praṇāḍyopayogāt pariharati -- tānī ti | udgīthādyupāsanaparihāryapratyūhyānīti yāvat | api ratra parāropitavirodhadyotakaḥ | yadvā pūrvagranthe'nupayogamanvāruhya sajātīyaprayogamātrātsaṃgatirananyagatikākāṅkṣoktyā parihṛtā | atra tūpayogaścāstīti vyajyate | anabhisaṃhitaphalāni -- bandhakaphalasaṃkalparahitatvādityarthaḥ | brahmavidyā'tra svābhīṣṭā | sādguṇyam -- pūrvoktaiva samṛddhiḥ; na tu vaikalyanivṛttiḥ | tadāpādakāni karmasamṛddhyutpādakāni | karmajātkarmasādguṇyaṃ vidyā sādguṇyataśca sā | ato virodha ityalpaṃ vyaktibhedādvyavasthiteḥ || 327 || sutarām -- svāpekṣayā paravidyāpekṣayā ceti bhāvaḥ | ihaive tyayogavadanyayogo'pi vyavacchidyate | abrahmadṛṣṭyādiṣu tu pradhānaikārthatā bhavet | vidyaupayikadṛṣṭyādi hetunyāyādiheṣyate || 328 || nātiprasaktirevaṃ syādadhītyāsattyanudruteḥ | kathaṃcitsaṃgatiścātra pareṣṭā na praṇudyate || 329 || astu yathāvadanavagate'dhiṣṭhāne mithyādṛṣṭiḥ prasiddhetyatrāha -- teṣāmi ti | na hyetanmithyādṛṣṭimātram; api tu yathāvadavagate vaidhamāropaṇam | tataścādhiṣṭhānabhūtaṃ karmāṅgaṃ yathāvadavijānatā tatrānyadṛṣṭividhirna cintayituṃ śakyate | sarvasaṃmatā -- viśvāpalāpino'pi nirūpakasannidhau durapahnavā; āhatya sanmātre avagativimateriti bhāvaḥ | nanu kāmyakarmaṇo'pyanaṅgairapi svavīryavattaratvāpādakairetairapekṣā'sti, teṣāmapi vicārānuṣṭhāne ca karmajñānāpekṣā siddhā | ata ubhayākāṅkṣayā karmakāṇḍe taccintā'stu; maivam; aviditabrahmaṇastadayogasyoktatvāt | ata eva hyupaniṣatsveva tadadhītiḥ | yattu adhītavedāntasye tyādinā vedāntamātrādhyāyinastāvanmātracintā śakyeti pūrvaṃ coditam; tadasat; adhyayanavidhirhi yathākramaṃ kṛtsnādhyayanaṃ prayuṅkte | na ca vidhyatilaṅghanena pravṛttamāpatkṛtaṃ vā trayyantamātrādhyayanamapekṣyedānīṃ tadvicārasya pūrvavṛttaṃ mṛgyate | etena prācīnasukṛtaviśeṣaniyatavairāgyātiśayādekadeśādhyayanavicārau syātāmityapi nirastam, tasyāpyadhyayanavidhyatilaṅghanāyogāt | anadhigatakarmaṇaḥ karmāṅgavidyādhigatiraśakyavicāra iti coktam | aviśadanirūpaṇena paścāccheṣapūraṇaṃ ca kliṣṭam | brahmacintodyatasya vidyāṅgakarmaṇāṃ gurūpadeśamātreṇa jñaptirastviti cet, tarhi tenaiva nyāyena brahmavicāro'pi mā bhūt | tadiha yathāvidhi kṛtsnādhyāyinaḥ prāgiva kṛtāvaśiṣṭe vicāraparvaṇi vṛttaviśeṣaḥ sthāpyata iti śuddhaḥ panthāḥ || śrutikirīṭaśarīravikṛṣṭikṛnmalinavṛttimalimlucavṛttibhiḥ | vighaṭitāmiva viṃśatilakṣaṇīṃ yatipateriti nītirajīghaṭat || 330 || || iti laghusiddhāntaḥ || gaḍḍhandya ghddhaḍḍhadhtdṛdvadma mīmāṃsāpūrvabhāgajñātasya karmaṇaḥ alpāsthiraphalatvāt, uparitanabhāgāvaseyasya brahmajñānasyānantākṣayaphalatvāñca pūrvavṛttātkarmajñānādanantaraṃ tata eva hetorbrahma jñātavya mityuktaṃ bhavati | tadāha vṛttikāraḥ -- vṛttāt karmādhigamādanantaraṃ brahmavividiṣā iti | vakṣyati ca karmabrahmamīmāṃsayo raikaśāstryam -- saṃhitametacchārīrakaṃ jaiminīyena ṣoḍaśalakṣaṇeneti śāstraikatvasiddhiḥ iti | atra tāpatraya ihi granthe yādavaprakāśoktaṃ pūrvavṛttāntaraṃ sāṅkhyādivicārasyānārabhyatāsthāpanaṃ ca vivakṣitamiva pratibhāti; tadvyudasyan vākyārthamāha -- mīmāṃsā iti | māṅ māne ityatra nātatvaṃ nipātya vā, mānapūjāyām ityatra vā mānbadha ityādinā anicchāsannanto'yaṃ śabdaḥ | mānerjijñāsāyām ihi vaiyākaraṇoktistvadūraviprakarṣāt; jijñāsāviśeṣotthāpye hi pūjitavicāre tadanubandhini praśastanyāye vā vṛddhaprayogādasya śaktiniṣkarṣaḥ | āhuśca -- mīmāṃsāsaṃjñitastarkassarvo vedasamudbhavaḥ ityādi | tādṛśanyāyanibandhātmani tu śāstre bhākto mīmāṃsā śabdaḥ | ataḥ pūrvāparabhāgavibhāgena jñātatvāvaseyatvoktiraviruddhā | atra pūrvavṛttādityādinā vākyayojanā | śiṣṭaṃ tatratyahetvaṃśasamarthanam | vicārakramanirdeśaḥ sautrastadvyaktaye tviha | śāstraikyatatkramau proktau sūtrakārābhisaṃhitau || 208 || pūrvabhāgoparitanabhāgaśabdābhyāṃ niyatakramavyākhyānarūpaprabandhaikyaṃ vyajyate | tannidānaṃ vyākhyeyasya vedasya kramavattvaṃ padayojanāyāṃ saśiraskaśabdena darśitam | padavākyanirvāhayostātparyabhedādapunaruktiḥ | jñātasya nirṇītasya | avaseyasya abādhitāpātadhīsthatayā nirṇetavyasya | brahmajñānasya brahmopāsanasya | brahmasvarūpamātravivakṣāyāmatra jñāna śabdādhikyāt, jñātasya karmaṇaḥ ityetatsamaśīrṣatayā sādhyaviśeṣagrahaṇaucityāt, vicārarūpasya nirṇayarūpasya vā jñānasya avaseyatvoktyayo gāt, nirdiśyamānaphalaṃ pratyacoditatvāñca | tadiha samanvayanītyā svayamanantākṣapa phalatvena pradhānatayā jñātavyamapi brahma svopāsanasyānantākṣayaphalasādhanatvena tadviṣayatayāpi jñātavyamiti tadupasarjanatayoktirapi susaṅgatā | brahma jñātavyamityanena tu tatprādhānyaṃ vyajyate | atra prayojanavattayāpātadhīsthatvaṃ vicāryatve hetuḥ | karmavicārāt paścādbhāvitasya tu pratibandhaśāntau tatsāpekṣatvamānantaryasya ca tādṛśāpekṣaṇīyāntarābhāvaḥ | ataḥ śrutyuktanirvedapūrtiparyantavicāraviśeṣābhiprāyeṇa tata eva ityuktam | avadhāraṇamiha hetuvaikalpyanivṛttyartham, sāvadhāraṇahetuniṣedhāyogāt | kecittu hetvantarādbrahmavicāre'nāvaśyakatvaśūdrādhikāratvayoḥ prasaṅgāt karmadhīvyatiriktahetvanādaropadeśo'yam ityāhuḥ | atra pradhānapratijñā taddhetuḥ pratijñāntarahetuśca noktaḥ syāditi bahvanaucityam | ākāṅkṣitahetupūrvakasādhyaviśeṣāyogavyavacchittyaivārthataḥ hetvantarādinirāsastu yuktaḥ | jñātavyam vicāryamityarthaḥ | vicāraḥ kartavyaḥ iti bhāṣiṣyate | atrārhārthe kṛtyapratyayaḥ | karmajñānādityatrāpi jñānaṃ vicāraḥ | brahma jñātavyamityuktaṃ bhavatītyanena svārasyaṃ yukiṃta ca sūcayatā brahmaiva jñātavyamiti vākyārthaṃ vadantaḥ pratyuktāḥ | idaṃ hi sūtramavicāryatvanirāsārtham | brahmaṇo jñātavyatvasya itaḥ pūrvamasiddhatayā tadeva jñātavyamiti niyamo nodeti | kathaṃ ca śabdānāṃ siddhaparatvasambhavamasādhayitvā siddhaviśeṣasya vicāryatvoktiḥ; samanvayasūtrāt tatsādhanam, sākāṅkṣayojanā ca na yuktā | atra codanāsūtravacchabdato'rthataścāyogānyayogavyavacchedau vākyabhedābhāvaścetyapyayuktam, anupayuktapratijñāmātrānupapatteḥ | brahmaśraddhāvardhakatā anyaniṣadhaḥ prastutopayogī iti ca mandam; tatpratijñāne'pi hetuścātrohyaḥ; tadūhe tu īkṣityadhikaraṇādyaistarkapādāntaissādhanaprāptaiḥ kṛta karatvaṃ ca syāt | kiṃ ca śārīrake'nuktāṃśasya sāṅkhyayogāvagamyatvaṃ vadadbhiḥ kathamiha tanniṣedhaḥ pratijñāyate ? vedaviruddhāṃśānādaraṇīyatvaṃ tu virodhādhikaraṇataḥ prāgeva svoktau padārthavākyārthau vṛttyāpi draḍhayan tanmatānusāre tatkṛtisaṃvādaṃ darśayati -- tadāha iti | ananyathāsiddhapūrvatvavivakṣayā karmavicārasya hetutvamapi vṛttyabhipretam| adhigamyate'neneti adhigamo'tra vicāraḥ | vividiṣoktiḥ jijñāsoktivanneyā | svoktasūtrārthasiddhyai sūcitaṃ śāstraikyamapi saṃvādayati -- vakṣyati iti | vyākhyāsyamānapradeśāntaraviṣayatayā bhaviṣyannirdeśaḥ | aikaśāstryamiha na kevalamekavidyāsthānatvam; kiṃ tu aikaprabandhyamapītyabhiprāyeṇa saṃhitatvoktiḥ | adhītakṛtsnavedārtharūpavicāryaikyasiddhau karmabrahmakāṇḍayoḥ pratyekamapūrṇārthatvena parasparasākāṅkṣatvāt naṣṭāśvadagdharathanyāyena saṅghaṭitamityarthaḥ | iyaṃ ca vṛttiḥ śāstrabhedabhramahetūn tatparihārāṃśca sūcayati -- sarvaśarīrigocaratvaṃ darśayatā śārīrakaśabdena viṣayabhedajñāpanāt, etat iti prayojanādhikāribhedayorarthavirodhasaphuraṇasya cāṅgulyaiva nirdeśāt| jaiminīyena iti bhedaśaṅkādyotanam | parihārastu ṣoḍaśalakṣaṇena iti, dvādaśādhyāyīrūpakāṇḍadvayena | atra karmadevatābrahmagocarā sā tridhodbhabhau sūtrakārataḥ | jaiminermuneḥ kāśakṛtsnato bādarāyaṇādityataḥ kramāt || iti tattvara tnākarokteśca vṛtteśca kvacidupacāreṇāvirodho grāhyaḥ | ṣoḍaśalakṣaṇeneti pratibandīmabhiprayatāvāntaraviṣayādibhedānāṃ na prabandhaikyavirodhitvamiti darśitam | jaiminīyena ityanenaivārthavirodhaśaṅkā sūtratātparyānabhijñatayeti sūcyate | sūtrayiṣyati hi śārīrakārtheṣu bahuṣu jaiminessaṃvādam | vyāmohaśāntyai dharmaṃ jaiminirata eva ityādiṣu kvacidvisaṃvādoktitannirāsau | parāsarśaṃ jaiminiḥ ityādau naiṣṭhikādyāśramābhāvo jaiminyasūtrito'pi nūnaṃ sakāmānāṃ gṛhasthadharmavaimukhyanivāraṇārthaṃ kadācidukto'nūdyāpāstaḥ | anyathā tadbhūtasya tu nātadbhāvo jaiminerapi ityādau naiṣṭhikādyāśramapracyutiniṣedhasya jaiminisaṃvādoktyayogāt | madhvādiṣvasaṃbhavādanadhikāraṃ jaiminiḥ, bhāvaṃ jaiminirvikalpāmanādityādiṣvapi na śāstraikyaviruddhānuktiḥ, svoktavyāravyābhedavatsvalpānyathoktestadavi rodhāt | saṃhitatvoktyā tu kartṛbhedābhedayoḥ yathādṛṣṭi prabandhabhedābhedānāpādakatvaṃ ravyāpitam | arthasaṅgatau satyāṃ hyanyatarābhisandherubhayābhisandhervā sandhāyakatvaṃ yuktam | brahmasaṃvādadārḍhyena pradhānārthāvirodhataḥ | apradhānavirodhastu tātparyādapanodyate || 209 || parakalpitasaudhārdhaviruddhāṃśavyapohataḥ | śeṣapūraṇavadvātra saṃhitatvoktisaṃbhavaḥ || 210 || ataḥ pratipipādayiṣitārthabhedena ṣaṭkabhedavadadhyāyabhedavañca pūrvottaramīmāṃsayorbhedaḥ | mīmāṃsāśāstram athāto dharmajijñāsetyārabhya anāvṛttiśśabdādanāvṛttiśśabdāt ityevamantaṃ saṅgativiśeṣeṇa viśiṣṭakramam | kutastarhi tadbhedaprathā, sati vā bhede kathaṃ ca prabandhaikyam ityanavahitānuyoge dvitīyavṛttyabhipretaṃ vyanakti -- ata iti | sayuktikasaṃpradāyādityarthaḥ | pratipipādayiṣitatvoktyā karmakāṇḍadevatādhikaraṇāderdevatātattvaniścayarahitānāmapi
