pradhānaṃ sat sādhyatayā buddhyāroheṇa puruṇaṃ pravartayati, kṛtsnaṃ ca devatādi kriyāśeṣabhūtam | nanu phalapradāyā devatāyā ārādhyatvena prādhānyamanuśośrūyāmahe, atrāha -- guṇatve devatā śrutiḥ | haviṣpradānaṃ prati guṇībhūtāṃ hi devatāmanuśrṛṇumaḥ; mantrārthavādopasthāpitaṃ devatāprītirupamapūrvaṃ coditasya karmaṇaḥ kṣaṇikasya kālāntarabhāvi phaladvāratayā upādīyeta; ato vāstavaprādhānyaśālinyapi devatā phalakāmapravartaka śābdaprādhānyavatkriyāguṇībhūtā na prādhānyena prayojiketi | atirthestarhi kathaṃ prayojakatvam itthamityāha -- atithau tatpradhānatvamabhāvaḥ karmaṇi syāt | ātithyaṃ pratyatitheḥ pradhānatvaṃ prāptam; anyathā hi tadarthe karmaṇi prayojakābhāvāt tadabhāvaḥ syāt | tatsaparyāvidhireva tatprayojaka iti cet tatra pratyāha -- tasya pratividhā natvāt | ātithyakarmaṇo hi atithyāgamanapratividhānatayaiva codanā | krīyāprayuktapuruṣasamāhūtā tu devatā | saṃnidhatte tadiṣṭarthaṃ na tatastatprayuktatā || 212 || atithistu svayaṃ prāptaḥ svābhīṣṭaṃ ca prayojayet | tadiṣṭānuvidhānena tatsaparyārthacodanā || 213 || ataḥ prāptāprāptavivekādatithiprādhānyoktiriti | yathā cātithervigrahādimattve tadupacaraṇānuṣṭhānasya na kadācit kṣatiḥ, pratyuta svarūpalābha eva; evaṃ devatāyāstadvattve'pi na cātra tatpratikṣepasāphalyaṃ paśyāmaḥ | guṇībhāvasādhane'pi kiṃ phalamiti cet, anirdhāritavāstavaprādhānyānāmapi karmaśraddhāsaṃvardhanamiti | sūtreṣu tāvadeteṣu pūrvapaścimapakṣayoḥ | devatāvigrāhaderna pratikṣepyatvasūcanam || 214 || śābare pūrvapakṣoktadektāvigrahādiṣu | svataḥ prāmāṇyavedibhyaḥ svadate na nirākṛtiḥ || 215 || smutyopacārādanyārthadarśanaiśca svabhāṣitam | na vāṅmātreṇa nihnotuṃ śakyate nāstiketaraiḥ || 216 || adarśanakutarkābhyāṃ śrutārthānāmapahnave | cārvākādimatāpattyā sarvopalpavasambhavaḥ || 217 || śrutānāṃ vigrahādīnāṃ ralpyatoktiśca mohajā | śrutaśaktyādyabhāvasya kalpane gauravaṃ tu vaḥ || 218 || kṣaṇikasya phaladvāraṃ kiṃ bhavediti cintane | dvāraklṛptervaraṃ hyatra śrutadvāraparavigrahaḥ || 219 || devatānāṃ kriyārthatvaṃ karmaṇāṃ ca tadarthatā | mukhabhedena siddhatvānna mitho bādhamarhataḥ || 220 || ādityādimatīraṅge sthāpayanbādarāyaṇaḥ | devatānāṃ pradhānatvamarthasiddhamasūtrayat || 221 || nāsiddhadevatārūpadṛṣṭiścānyatra yujyate | na ca sarvatra nirbādhe kalpyo dṛṣṭividhikramaḥ || 222 || devatānāṃ tapaścaryādyuktiśca na virudhyate | svādhikeśvaratoṣārthapravṛtterupapattitaḥ || 223 || praśāsituśca ghuṇayā dharmasaṃsthāpanārthinaḥ | tattaddharmapravṛttissyātkarmavaśyānusāriṇaḥ || 224 || tiryaksthāvaranirjīvatatpratīkaguṇakriyāḥ | abhimatyanubandhena devatāstadapi śrutam || 225 || havirbhedānusāreṇa phalabhedapradāyitā | pratiṣiddhaiḥ prakopaśca rājādinyāyato bhavet || 226 || yadi śrutyanusāreṇa svabhāvo havirādiṣu | tenaiva tattadārādhyasvabhāvasvīkriyocitā || 227 || mantrārthavādasiddhe'pi yatra bādhā na dṛśyate | tanmūlā smutirapyatra na bādhārhā svamūlavat || 228 || paryāye ca viśiṣṭe ca devatābhedakalpanam | tattacchabdopadhānena taduddeśyatvasiddhaye || 229 || aviditvā svamandatvaṃ nāstikairāstikeṣviha | yairajalpyata mandatvaṃ śocyāste sūkṣmadarśibhiḥ || 230 || dravyadaivatasāmānye balīyo dravyamityapi | pratyakṣe ca parokṣe ca pramāṇaprasthitervaśāt || 231 || dravyasyādhyakṣasiddhasya haviṣṭvaṃ śāstragocaraḥ | devatāyāssvarupaṃ ca dharmatvaṃ ceti bhedataḥ || 232 || pratyakṣādyupajīvitvācchāstrato dhīrvilambitā | tato hi paradaurbalyaṃ śrutiliṅgādikeṣvapi || 233 || dravyadaivatavaiṣamyaṃ na satyāsatyabhāvataḥ | daivataṃ yadi mithyā syātkathaṃ bhedādidharmabhāk || 234 || arthopaśliṣṭaśabdātmā śabdamātrātmikāpi vā | yathā śrutagṛhītā vā satyaiva khalu devatā || 235 || maṇimantroṣadhādyaiśca siddhiruktābhyupeyate | janmasiddhāpi sādhītā kiṃ na deveṣu gṛhyate || 236 || na vastudeśāntarayordevadṛṣṭividhānavat | iha kalpayituṃ yuktaṃ rvarupavidhisausthyataḥ || 237 || rātrisatrādinītyā ca vidhyapekṣānusārataḥ | phaladāḥ phalabhūtatvādapi sidhyanti devatāḥ || 238 || itthaṃ prācīnayā gatyā kṣiptaṃ nirdaivataṃ matam | śeṣaṃ taduparītyādisūtrabhāṣye bhaviṣyati || 239 || dramiḍabhāṣyakārairapyuktam -- añjasaiva viśvasṛjo rūpamityārabhya, na hyarūpāyā devatāyā rūpamupadiśyate, yathābhūtavādi hi śāstramiti | nanvarthavādānāṃ vidhiśeṣatvaṃ pūrvatroktam; samanvayādhikaraṇe tvanyathā; tatkathamavirodhaḥ ? ittham- utsargāpavādataḥ pravṛtteḥ | dṛṣṭaṃ caitacchāstrāntare kāṇḍāntare ca | evamanyatrāpi kudṛṣṭikalpito virodhaḥ śamayitavyaḥ | ṣaṭkabhedavat iti karmakāṇḍe pratibandī, adhyāyabhedavat iti tu kāṇḍatraye'pi; cakāro'trānuktapādādisamuñcaye | devatākāṇḍāccharīrakasya pṛthakkaraṇaṃ ca tatpṛthakkaraṇapratibandyā nirūḍham | atha vinnakramatvabhinnaprabandhatvavyudāsaṃ vṛttisiddhaṃ vyanakti -- mīmāṃśāśāstram iti | saṅgativiśeṣeṇa hetuhetumadbhāvādinā sambandhenetyarthaḥ | sa ca viṃśatilakṣaṇyāmekaprayojana sādhanatvenaikaprayatnasādhyatvamiti vivaraṇam | idaṃ ca aikaprabandhyavyaktyartham | viśiṣṭakramam u niyatakramam; na hi śāstrāntaravadavasaramātrādiha kvāpi krama ityāśayaḥ | tatra viśeṣaḥ -- vicārātpūrvamevātra prāptamadhyayanaṃ vidheḥ | ato'nadhītavedasya vicāraśśrutivāritaḥ || 240 || kramo viṃśatilakṣaṇyā na vaidhaḥ kiṃtu yauktikaḥ | ato vyutkramacintāyāmanaucityaṃ prakāśyate || 241 || ārabhya ityanena dharmajijñāsāsūtre kṛtsnavedārthavicārapratijñā sūcyate, dharmaśabdena siddhasādhyaparāvarakṛtsnadhṛtihetusaṃgrahāt | karmabhāgamātrapratijñāpi tatraiva tantrataḥ āvṛttyā vā sidhyet | tāvataiva sāre karmavicārārthatvoktiḥ | bhāgadvayapratijñābhyāṃ sāmānyapratijñā gamyā; nyāyasūtre sādharmyavaidharmyasamoktyā pratidharmasamonnītivat | tadetatsava saṅgatimālāyāmuktam | na ca vācyam ādyapratijñayaiva kṛtsnasiddhau kiṃ bhūto viśeṣapratijñayeti ; śaṅkāviśeṣoddhārādiprayojanavaśāt prācīnādhyāyeṣvavātrāpi tadupapatteḥ | na cāyam athāto dharmajijñāsā ityādiraprastutārthaḥ; yathānyatra saṅgatyā kramaniyatistathātreti tātparyāt | atra hyamānakasyānirūpyatayā pramāṇalakṣaṇena prathamenābhāvi | kārtsnyena vedasya prāmāṇye siddhe tadartheṣu bhedābhāve'ṅgatvādessarvasyāyogāt mānacintānantaraṃ śāstrārthabhedacintā prāvartiṣṭa; śāstrabhedacintetyeke | tatra śabdāntarābhyāsasaṃkyāguṇaprakriyānāmadheyaiḥ siddhe bhede śrutiliṅgavākyaprakaraṇasthānasamāravyābhiḥ śeṣalakṣaṇaṃ pravṛttam | śeṣāṇāmeva śeṣibhiḥ prayojyatvāya caturthe kratvarthapuruṣārthajijñāsā, vidhyapekṣārūpopādānacinteti kecit | prayukteṣu śrutyarthapāṭhapravṛttimukhyakāṇḍaiḥ pañcame kramo'nukrāntaḥ | sakrame śāstrārthe sthāpite tatprayoktā ṣaṣṭhe proktaḥ | evamupadiṣṭaprakṛtiniścaye vikṛtāvatideśassāmānyataḥ saptame sthāpitaḥ | aṣṭame'pi tadanubandhiviśeṣaḥ | atidiṣṭamantrādīnāṃ navame bahuvidha ūhaḥ | atideśaprāpteṣu kvacitprayojanābhāvādanyato vā tallābhātpratiṣedhato vā daśame bādhaḥ | ukteṣu pṛthakprayuktiśaktimadubhayagocaratve deśakālādyaikye caikādaśe tantram | dvādaśe'pi kasmiṃścitprayogamadhyapātinyanyasmiṃstatprayogopajīvini prasaṅga iti | tadidaṃ sañjagṛhuḥ -- dharmadhīmānabhedāṅgaprayuktikramakartṛbhiḥ | sādideśaviśeṣohabādhatantraprasaktibhiḥ || iti | evaṃ tarkite karmaṇi saṅkarṣakāṇḍe caturlakṣaṇyā tattatkarmārādhyadevataiva svarūpamedaguṇaprakarṣaiḥ nirakṛṣyata | tatsamāptau ca ante harau taddarśanāt sa viṣṇurāha hi taṃ brahmetyācakṣate taṃ brahmetyācakṣate iti vicārayiṣyamāṇamupacikṣipe iti tattvavṛddhāḥ | tato'ntime kāṇḍe sadvārakamadvārakaṃ ca yathārhaṃ dvādaśalakṣaṇyuktasarvadharmasamārādhyamanantaracaturlakṣaṇyavadhāritasarvadaivataśarīrakaṃ paraṃ daivataṃ parīcikṣiṣitam | tatra sarveṣāṃ kāraṇavākyānāmayogānyayogavyavacchedena brahmaṇi samanvayaḥ prathame'dhyāye pratipādyate | taduktaṃ nyāyasudarśane -- vyudasyāviṣayatvānyaviṣayatve samanvayaḥ | vākyānāṃ brahmaṇi prācyādhyāyeneha pradarśyate || iti | tatra śaṅkitavirodhoddhūnanaṃ dvitīye'dhyāye | tābhyāṃ sthāpiti brahmaṇyutpattikramāttṛtīyacaturthābhyāṃ sādhanaphalaśomanamiti viṃśatyadhyāyyā viśiṣṭakramatvaṃ diṅmātram | hantaivamatra kathaṃ ṣoḍasacatuṣkapaurvāyaryam ? vyutkrame'pi hi na virodhaḥ, vedaprāmāṇyādikaṃ tūpajīvyamapi yathāsthānaṃ śārīrake nibandhuṃ śakyam, tāvanmātraṃ vā saṃśrutya brahmacintā syāt; maivam -- asti hyanādyabhyaste trivarge karmakṛt prathamamā doṣadarśanādabhiniviśata ityarthakramaḥ | ubhayatra parimitāparimitaphalāpātapratītyaviśeṣe'pi atke cenmadhu vindeta iti nyāyāt karmasāpekṣavidyāprayāsato varaṃ tannairapekṣyanirdhūtavikalpatatsamaphalakarmacintā prathamamiti ca | yajñādipadārthasāpekṣaśca tadaṅgakavākyārthadhībodhaḥ | vidyābhedeṣu tatra tatra yajñatadavayavadṛṣṭividhivimarśaśca dṛṣṭiviśeṣaṇanirdhāraṇāpekṣaḥ | iṣṭakacitādidṛṣṭāntadhiyaśca dārṣṭāntikopajīvyāḥ | karmabrahmapracurasvādhyāyabhāgasyā nādisampradāyaniyatādhyayanasaṃskārakrameṇa tadvicārakramo'pi yuktaḥ | sa cātra mukhyakrama eva, karmopāsanārūpāṅgāṅgyutpattikramāñca | tathā coktaṃ nyāyasudarśane -- karmavijñānayorhetuhetumadbhāvasammateḥ | prāgbhāvaḥ karmaṇaḥ sidhyet paścādbhāvo'parasya ca || tayośca kramavattvena tadvicārau ca tādṛśau | mukhyakramanayādeva syātāṃ sārasvatāṅgavat || yathā sārasvatau bhavata etadvai daivyaṃ mithunam ityatra yugalotpanne yāgadvaye kasyāṅgānāṃ prāthamyamityanirṇaye sarasvatīyāgasya yājyānuvākyābhyāṃ prāthamye siddhe tatkrameṇa tadaṅgānāmeva prāthamyamuktam -- mukhyakrameṇa vāṅgānāṃ tadarthatvāditi | pūrvakāṇḍaprasiddhānāṃ nyāyānāmīha saṃgrahāt | brahmakāṇḍo vṛthetyetatprācyādhyāyeṣvapi smara || 242 || vyutpādanamapūrvāṇāmākṣipya sthāpanaṃ tathā | apavādaḥ kvacicceti sārthatvamiha ca sthitam || 243 || nanu yadi anāvṛttiśśabdāt anāvṛttiśśabdāt ityantā mīmāṃsā; tadā śārīrakasya viraktādhikāratvasvīkārāt, tatra nirdoṣānantaphalaniścayāñca na svargādiphalasādhanānuṣṭhātā kaścitsidhyet, tataśca kāmyavidhīnāmananuṣṭhālakṣaṇamaprāmāṇyaṃ syāt; maivam -- mohādvighnādvā yaḥ karmamātraṃ vicārya viśrāntaḥ, yaśca khyātilābhapūjāpravacanādimātrakāmastrayyantārthaṃ cintayet, yo vā paścānniyativaśānnivṛttavairāgyaḥ, te śrutaśārīrakā api pravṛttidharmaṃ ca jahyuḥ || paṇḍito'pyāturaḥ kaścidapathyeṣu pravartate | niṣiddheṣvapi kiṃ naivaṃ kāmyaṃ prājñe'pi sambhavet || 244 || kathyante ca mahānto|pi kāmādubhayabhāvanāḥ | kramamuktiśca keṣāṃcit tat evābhidhīyate || 245 || tathāhi -- prathamaṃ tāvat svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ ityadhyayanenaiva svādhyāyaśabdavācyavedākhyākṣararāśergrahaṇe vidhīyate | prakṛtasyaikaśāstryasya brahmacintodyamasya ca | kramādeścopapattyarthaṃ tathāhītyādi bhāṣyate || 146 || atra karmavicārātprāgapi brahmavicārassyāditi paśyankimadhyayanādapi tasya pūrvatvamicchati, utādhītavedasya karmanirūpaṇāt prācyatvamiti vikalpaṃ hṛdi nidhāya ādyaṃ niṣedhati -- prathamam iti | tāvacchabdo'dhyayanānantaryasya sarvasammatiṃ darśayati iti vivaraṇam | etena vicārasyādhyayanānantarabhāvitvavadvatyākhyeyasyaikavidhisiddhāghyayanasaṃskāragocaraniyatakramaikaprabandhatvam, adhyayanasya vidhibalātkṛtsnasvādhyāyaviṣayatvam, tata eva tadvicārasya tathātvaṃ ca yathāvatkarmabrahmacintakaissarvaiḥ dustyajamiti vyajyate | avadhāraṇārtho vā tāvacchabdaḥ | tena cāṣṭavarṣādyupanīnasyānantaraṃ śaucācāraśikṣaṇapūrvakeṇa niyatenādhyayanena śāstrāntarāvasaranirodhāt tanmūlatvena sambhāvanīyasādhanacatuṣṭayādipūrvavṛttāntaranirāsaḥ | svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ iti svavidhiṃ gṛhṇatā tatprayuktirabhipretā | adhyayanenākṣararāśigrahaṇam ityenena saṃskāralābhassūcitaḥ | evakāra iha niyamasya phalitatvaṃ dyotayati | yadyapyakaraṇe pratyavāyānnimittādṛṣṭeśca nityo'yamadhyayanavidhiḥ, tathāpi dṛṣṭasya phalasyāparityājyatayā tatsvīkārārthadadhyayanādakṣararāśigrahaṇe satyanyasya grahaṇahetornātrāvakāśaḥ | adhyayanasya niyogārthatvaṃ vadatāpi hyarthātpustakapāṭhādi pratiṣedhyam; ata eva hi likhitapāṭhakanindāpi | svādhyāyaśabdavācya ityādibhistribhiḥ svaśāravaikadeśamātraṃ vā vicāryo vedārtho vā na svādhyāyaśabdavācya iti vyajyate; yathākramādhyayanaṃ paramparāprāptaṃ vidhyanumatamiti ca bhāvaḥ | grahaṇaṃ vidhīyate phalatvena bodhyate, sambhavadupāyāntaraṃ phalamidamupāyaviśeṣato niyamyata ityarthaḥ; yata evakārastato'nyatra hi niyamaḥ | yadyapyakṣaragrahaṇasyānyato'pi śakyatvānna svarūpato niyamaḥ, tathāpi jāpādyupayogo'dhyayanagṛhītenaiveti niyamopapattiḥ | arthajñāne niyamaṃ vadatāmapyevameva nistāraḥ | tañvādhyayanaṃ kiṃrūpam ? kathaṃ ca kartavyamityapekṣāyām aṣṭavarṣaṃ brāhmaṇamupanayīta tamadhyāpayet ityanena, śrāvaṇyāṃ prauṣṭhapadyāṃ vā upākṛtya yathāvidhi | yuktaśchandāṃsyadhīyīta māsān vipro'rdhapañcamān || ityādivrataniyamaviśeṣopadeśaiścāpekṣi tāni vidhīyante | nanvadhyayanavidhinā svādhyāyasyādhyetavyatvamātraṃ pratīyate | na tāvatā sādhanacatuṣṭayasaṃpattyādihetubhūtaśāstrāntarāvasaranirodhaḥ; tataḥ paścādapyadhyayanopapatteḥ | niraṅgaṃ vā sakṛdadhītya vā śāstrāntaramabhyasyatāmityatrādhyayanasvarūpakālādhikāryādikaṃ vyanakti -- taditi; sarvasaṃmatanityavidhisiddhamādyādhyayanamityarthaḥ | kiṃrūpaṃ -- kiṃ japādivatsvatantroñcāraṇam, utānūñcāraṇam, kiṃ vāpanyāyamūlaṃ gauḍādhyayanavat, pārāyaṇavañcānāvṛttam, utāvaghātavañcāvṛtattamityarthaḥ | rūpaśabdena phalagrahamam iti tūlikāyā api yāvadgrahaṇamāvṛttarūpatve tātparyam | katham iti itikartavyatāparam | adhyāpanārthaśaṅkārhasyopabṛṃhaṇīyasya adhyayanārthatayā sampratipannānāmupabṛṃhaṇānāṃ ca viśeṣamaikarasyāvaśyaṃbhāvaṃ cābhipretya anena upadeśaiśca iti vibhajya nirdeśaḥ | upākṛtyādhīyīta ityetat, upanīto'dhīyīta iti śrutitātparyaklṛpteḥ sthāpakam | upanītasya hyadhyayanārthatayopākarmādi nirdiśyate | yuktaḥ -- avahitaḥ, vratādiyukto vā| ardhaṃ pañcamaṃ yeṣāṃ te ardhapañcamāḥ | ādiśabdena ata ūrdhvaṃ tu chandāṃsi śukleṣu niyataḥ paṭhet | vedāṅgāni ca sarvāṇi kṛṣṇapakṣeṣu saṃpaṭhet || ityādīni prāguktasāṅgādhyayanānuguṇavacanāni gṛhyante | vrataviśeṣāḥ sopākṛtayaḥ prājāpatyasaumyādayaḥ | niyamaviśeṣāḥ śuklakṛṣmapakṣārdhapañcamamāsādivibhaktāṅgājhrṅgyaṭadhyayana kālabhedaviṣayāḥ, śūdrasamīpe nādhyetavyamityādyuktadeśādiviṣayāśca | evaṃ satsatnānaprasūtasadācāraniṣṭhātmaguṇopetavedavidācāryopanītasya vrataniyamaviśeṣayuktasya ācāryoñcāraṇānū ñcāraṇarūpamakṣararāśigrahaṇaphalamadhyayanamityavagamyate || nanu upanayīta tamadhyāpayet iti śrutyā ācāryakartavyatāśrutau kathamadhyayanāpekṣitavidhiḥ, kathaṃ cātropattaśrutyāderapi śāstrāntarāvasaranirodhādisiddhirityatrāha -- evam iti | pradarśitaśrutismutisahakṛtasvavidhisiddhasāṅgādhyayanavidhānaprakāreṇetyarthaḥ | abhijanavidyāsamudetamityādibhirācārya guṇagrahaṇānnādhyāpanavidhiparatvaṃ śaṅkyam, ṛtvigguṇoktinyāyādityabhiprāyeṇa satsantāne tyādyuktiḥ | atra ācārātmaguṇau samāhitaśabdābhipretau | vedavit iti vidyāsamudetatvaviśadīkaraṇam | niṣidhyate ca ayogyādadhya yanam; tadguṇahānau pratisamādhīyate ca | tathā ca tamaso vā eṣa tamaḥ praviśatītyādibhiḥ śiṣyasya hāniruktā | saṃskartāramīpset, tasmiṃścaiva vidyākarmāntamityādinā ca tadguṇānāṃ māṇavakārthatvaṃ vyaktam | yathā adhyāpanavidhi vādināmaṣṭavarṣatvādimāṇavakaviśeṣaṇamācāryārtham, tadvat ācāryaviśeṣaṇaṃ māṇavakārthamiti pratibandīsūcanāya vrataniyamaviśeṣayuktasya ityādyudāhṛtam; ṣaṣṭhyantapadābhyāmadhikārisyāpi niyamaviśeṣatvādaṣṭavarṣādyupanītasyādhyayanavidhyavaruddhatvāñca | ācāryoñcaraṇānūñcāraṇam ityanena svatantroñcāraṇaṃ vicārasyādhyayanaśāstrārthānupraveśaśaṅkā cāpāsyate | upanayanasya yathā adhyāpanānuguṇaśiṣyāsattirdṛṣṭaphalatayopakārikā matāntare, tathā anūñcāraṇānuguṇapratyāsattirasminmate | syāditi ca bhāvaḥ | asminprathamādhyayane avaghātanyāyātsakṛdasakṛddvistrirityādiviśeṣānādareṇa yāvatphalamāvṛtterarthasiddhimabhipretyāha -- akṣararāśiṃgrahaṇaphalam iti | anena akṣaragrahaṇakāmatvamadhikāriviśeṣaṇamityapi vyañjitam | phalatvenāśritasyāpi tathātvaṃ vituṣatvavat | upayogaśca yāgādau grahaṇasyāpi dustyajaḥ || 247 || vidhito'nujñayā vārthajñānaṃ phalamihecchatā | phalānubandhānnityatvaṃ prahīyeteti durvacam || 248 || ye tu pūrvapakṣe nityādhyayanavidhau viśvajinnyāyātsarvāviśiṣṭaṃ svargaṃ phalamiti kalpayanti, siddhānte cārthajñānam; te'pyanena praticikṣipire | akṣaragrahaṇasya hi dṛṣṭasya sukhādanyasyāpyarthajñānāderiva sukhādiparyavasānātphalatvaṃ yuktam | tadevam anūñāraṇam, akṣararāśigrahaṇaphalam ityubhābhyāṃ kiṃrūpamiti bubhutsitamādyādhyayanabhāvārthasvarūpaṃ pradarśitam | tathā ca vivaraṇam -- ekaphalāvacchinnakriyākṣaṇanicaye hi dhātorvṛttiḥ, yathā odanaṃ pacadīti; itarathā vartamānanirdeśabhaṅgaprasaṅgāt | prārabdho'parisamāpto hi vartamānaśabdārthaḥ | kṣaṇabhaṅiginyāstu kriyāyā dhātvarthatve śabdaprayogātpūrvameva jhrjāṭajñātasya kriyākṣaṇasya naṣṭatvāduttarasya ca bhaviṣyattvātsamakālasyājājhrjñāṭatatayā śabdāviṣayatvāñcākṣuṣatve'pi kṣaṇadhvaṃsādādimadhyāntānirūpaṇāñca na prārambhāparisamāptyoḥ siddhirityato grahaṇaphalāvacchinnakriyākṣaṇanicaye'dhyayanaśabdasya vṛttirityāheti | adhyayanasyācāryopanītakartṛkānūñcāraṇatvoktiḥ upanayīta, tamadhyāyayedityubhābhyāmācāryakartṛkopanayanādipūrvakatvaṃ vidhīyata iti vyanakti | nanu adhyāpayediti vṛttyupāyaniyamārthatvaṃ syāt | maivam -- anupaneturapi tadarthādhyāpanadṛṣṭerupanayanavidhānanairarthakyāt | nāpyupanītamevādhyāpayediti kramaniyamo'pi, tathā'hyaṣṭavarṣaṃ brāhmaṇamityāderanapekṣitavacanatvaprasaṅgāt | anyārthamiha tadupadeśastva saṅgata eva | na cātra upanītau niyamaḥ śaṅkyaḥ, tatprāpakāntarādaṣṭeḥ | smutirdṛśyata iti cenna, aṣṭavarṣādyukteranupayogā deva | na cātra vṛttyupāyadvayoktiḥ; upanayanasya tadupāyatvenāparisaṃkhyānāt | tathātve'pi prāpakābhāvena niyamānupapattiruktaiva; dattottaratvāñca | ato'dhyayanāpekṣitavidhirevāyam | prayojake cātra vidhiḥ yājayet itivatsyāt | adhyāpanamapi hi yājanavadvṛttyarthatayā prāptatvānna vidheyam | tadatra aṣṭavarṣo brāhmaṇaḥ svādhyāyagrahaṇakāma uktaprakārācāryopanītastadupagatyā yathoktavrataniyamavānadhīyīta iti sopabṛṃhaṇādyādhyayanaśāstrārthasthāpanā | ata eva adhyayanavidhau niyojyāśravaṇādanyaprayuktānuṣṭhānatvaklṛptirayuktā; adhyāpanavidhāvapyaśravaṇāñca klṛpteścobhayatrāviśeṣāt | na ceha tatklṛptiḥ; brāhmaṇamityādeḥ prajākāmādimadvibhaktivipariṇāmamātreṇa tatsiddheḥ viprodhīyīteti smṛtyanugrahāñca | bālasya svādhikārājñānānna svavidhiprayuktiriti cenna, niṣādasthapatinyāyādanyaistadabhijñairanuṣṭhānopapatteḥ | hitaiṣiṇa eva hi bālādīnāmaviditasvādhikārāṇāṃ jātakarmādisaṃskārānapi svayaṃviditopayogāḥ kurvanti | adhyayane tu bālasyāpyāptapreraṇādibhiḥ sāphalyānumānātpravṛttiryuktā | nityamadhyayanaṃ kāmyaprayuktamitivādinām | kathaṃ tatra niyogasya kṛtyuddeśyatvalakṣaṇam || 249 || prabuddhānāṃ svavidhinā'buddhānāmanyatastviti | prayuktibhedaklṛptau ca syādardhajaratīyatā || 250 || yañca nistīrṇādhyayanaduḥkhe māṇavake vicārātpūrvamadhyayanavidheradhikāraparyavasānāya dṛṣṭamarthajñānaṃ viṣayasādhyaprayojanatayā svīkriyate iti; tadapi mandam, adhyayanasyānyataḥ niddhau tadaprayojakena sidhyatā kāryeṇa tasya prayojanāntaraklṛpterayogāt; nityāntaravadasyāpi te niyogamātraprayojanatvopapatteḥ | dṛṣṭavtādanyadapyanujñātamiti cenna, ānuṣaṅikasya lābhapūjāderapyatra vidhyanujñātatvena svīkāraprasaṅgāt | na ca dharmānuṣṭhānopayuktatayā'rthajñānameva vidhiranujānāti, nānyaditi vācyam; dhanāderapi tadupayuktatvena tasyāpyanumatiprāpteḥ | sarvavidhyupakāritvamarthajñānasya saṃbhavet | naitāvatā viśeṣeṇa dṛṣṭamanyadupekṣyate || 251 || dhanāderupakartṛtvaṃ svaśaktyaiveti cenmadam | arthajñānaṃ ca tadvatsyānna vidhibhrūvaśaṃvadam || 152 || arthatastadanujñātaṃ śabdaśaktyaiva bhāvitam | sāpekṣairyāgadānādiniyogairupajīvyatām || 253 || api caikasya vairūpyaṃ vidhyanujñātmakatvataḥ | pradhānaguṇakarmatvaviṣaye ca prasajyate || 254 || tasmādadhyayanārambhavelāyāmeva māṇavakasya hitamācāryādayo'bhisandhāya parabuddhairupadiśya vā tatra pravartakā iti yuṣmadgrāmeṣvapi vṛttāntaḥ | na punaranyasyācāryakaṃ mayā bhāvanīyamiti buddhyā kaścitpravartamāno dṛśyate | śikṣayantaśca hitaiṣiṇo bālasyaivāgāmi phalaṃ vyapadiśanti | chāndogye ca -- brahmacaryaṃ bhagavati vatsyāmyupeyāṃ bhagavantam iti jābālo gautamamāha; tena ca pratyuktam -- samidhaṃ somyāhara, upa tvā nepye ityādi | ataḥ śiṣyārthamevācārthaḥ pravartate; tatastu varādikaṃ tena prāpyamiti siddham| ata eva dravyārjanādilubadhācāryarāgaprayuktamadhyanamiti yatkaiśiciduktam; tatsvavidhiprayuktyasaṃbhave'pyadhyāpanavidhiprayuktistāvadayukteti sthāpayitum | na hi māṇavakasya prayojanamabodhayitvā tatpravartananmabaladravyārjanādisaṃbhavaḥ; anyathā haṭhātpravṛttirācāryasya syāt | ataḥ sāṅgādhyayanavidhau kaṇṭhokto viprādiḥ svahitāmisandhiradhikarteti nānyataḥ prayuktiḥ | etena ācāryakaraṇavidhiprayuktyanaṅgīkāre kratuvidhiprayukteḥ avaśyāśrayaṇīyatayā tattatphalakāśūdrāderapyadhyayanādhikāraḥ syāditi kaiściduktaṃ nirastam; ādhānavanniyatakartṛkeṇa svavidhinaiva adhyayanasya prayukteḥ | adhyayanavidhāvadhikārāścavaṇacodyamapi vaitupyavaddṛṣṭasyākṣaragrahaṇasya phalatvoktyā prayuktam | upanīyetyādismutirapi nādhyāpanaṃ vidhatte, nāpyācāryakaṃ tatphalatvenopādatte; anyataḥ prāptaviśiṣṭādhyāpanānuvādenācāryaśabdavyutpādanaparatvāt upādhyāyādiśabdavyutpādanavat; na hyatra tadatiriktatātparyaklṛptihetuḥ | na ca ācāryakamekamanyādṛśam, mānābhāvāt | nimittāntarādṛṣṭyā tatklṛptiriti cenna; saniyamakopanayanādhyāpanātyantāyogavyavacchedamelakasya nimitasya dṛṣṭeḥ | ata eva upanayanāderuttarakāle'pyupādhyāyādinayādācāryaśabdaprayogopapattiḥ | pūrvaṃ tvanāgatāvekṣaṇasya duśśakatayā nimittajhrāṭajñānasandehābhyāmaprayogaḥ | api ca smṛteratra śabdavyutpādanamātraparatve vṛddhavyavahāra eva mūlaṃ dṛṣṭam; ācāryakaraṇavidhyarthatve tu alaukikārthaśrutimūlatvaṃ kalpyam; klṛptakalpyayośca virodhe klṛptameva grāhyam | ktvādiśrutiścātra darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmiṣṭvetyādivadanaṅgatve'pi sūtroktasamānakartṛkatvādisādharmyamātreṇaghaṭate | nanu samāsakartṛkatvasvārasyādbādhakābhāvāccaikaprayogatayā'ṅgāṅgitvasiddhiḥ syāt; tanna ; ktvāśruteḥ smṛtisaṃsthatvādanuvādatayā'pi ca | śrutisthaṃ liṅgamevātra balīyo hyavilambataḥ || 255 || brāhmaṇamiti māṇavakaikasaṃskāratayā śrutamupanayanaṃ prayojyaprayojakavyāpāratayā'dhyayanādhyāpanayordvayoḥ phalavatoḥ sannidhāvapi karmasthatayā antaraṅgaliṅgādupanītagatādhyayanāṅgameva; anyārthatve tu praṇāṅyā syāt | evaṃ śrautaliṅgato'dhyayane viniyuktasyādhyāpanāṅgatvaklṛptau viniyuktaviniyogavirodhaḥ | na hi smṛtisthā katvāśrutiḥ śrautaṃ liṅgaṃ bādhituṃ kṣamā; smṛtiḥ svamūlam, anūktiḥ puroktimapekṣata iti vilambadvayena pratirodhāt | nanu svaritetyādivihitādātmanepadādupanayanamupanetṛgatādhyāpanāṅgaṃ syāt | na syāt, sammānanādisūtravihitatvāt | akartrabhiprāyārtho'yamārambha iti śābdā | kartaryeva phalānvayaḥ kartrabhiprāyatvam, akartrabhiprāyatvaṃ tu niyamābhāva iti cenna; ādadhītetyatra svaritetyādisūtroktātmanepade'pi phalasyobhayānvayāt | na ca kriyāphalasya cetanadvaye'nanvayastat; jāyāpatī agnimādadhīyātāmityatrāpi taddṛṣṭeḥ | kartṛvyatiriktacetane'nanvayastadityapi nirastam | prāmāṇikadṛṣṭyā sarveṣu śāstrārthaṣu akartaryārādhye prītirūpaphalaśruterādhānādhiṣvātmanepadalopaprasaṅgāt, abhicaranyajetetyādau bhrātṛvye'pi taducitaphalasaṃmateśca | ṛtvijo vṛṇīta ityatra ca varaṇīyeṣvapi phalaṃ siddham | avyavahitaphalasya kriyāphalaśabdena vivakṣitatvāttasya kartranvayaḥ kartrabhiprāyatvam | sammānanādisūtraṃ tu vyavahitaphalasya kartranvayārthaṃ syādityetadapi dattottaram, ādadhīta ityādāveva vyabhicārāt | asti hi atrāgnisaṃskāravyavahitamādhātaryāhitāgnitvaṃ phalam | nanu āgāminityakāmyādiyāgopajīvyasaṃskṛtagnisiddhirevādhātuḥ phalamiti na vyavahita phalānvayaḥ | maivam; atrāpyupanayanasaṃskṛtādhyetṛsiddhirevopanetuḥ phalamiti sammānanādisūtravaiyarthyaprasaṅgāt | avyavahitaphalasya kartrabhimatatvānabhimatatvābhyāṃ sūtradvayasāphalyamiti cenna; ācāryakārthino'pyupaneturupaneyasaṃskārānabhimatyayogāt | ataḥ kartranvayasijhrddhyarthaṭaddhamevātrātmanepadam | evamadhyāpayedityanenāpi na phalasya kartṛgāmitvam | tadevaṃ na vidhyantaraprayuktamadhyayanam | vicāraśca kimadhyayanavidhinā prayujyate, uta adhyāpanavidhinā ? na prathamaḥ, viṣayaphalānujñāyā nirastatvāt | na dvitīyaḥ, yāvacchatānatikramaṇāt | svādhyāyaṃ grāhayitvā hi guruṇā'pi viramyatām | dayādipreritatve tu prāgapyevamiti sthitaḥ || 256 || ato gurumate kṛtsnamīmāṃsaiva na sidhyati | iti matvā vidhūtaṃ tatprakṛtasthāpanārthibhiḥ || 257 || adhyayanaṃ ca svādhyāyasaṃskāraḥ; svādhyāyo'dhyatavyaḥ iti svādhyāyasya karmatvāvagamāt | yadyapyevamakṣaragrahaṇāvadhi śāstrāntarāvasaro niruddhaḥ, tathā'pi gṛhītākṣarasyāsau syāditi śaṅkāyāmuttaratrāpi tannirodhārthamadhyayanasya niyogaviṣayatvapakṣapratikṣepeṇa prāksūcitaṃ svādhyāyasaṃskāratvaṃ vyanakti -- adhyayanam iti | caḥ śaṅkānivṛttyarthaḥ; yadvā bhinnakramaḥ, asakṛdanūñcaraṇatvādinā saha saṃskārarūpatvasya samuñcayārthaḥ | saṃskāraḥ puṃsa eveṣṭo mantraṇaprokṣaṇādibhiriti vadadbhiradhyayanasaṃskāro'pi kartureveti svīkṛtaḥ | tena vivakṣitāsiddhiriti śaṅkāṃ nivartayitumāha -- svādhyāya iti | uktaṃ ca bṛhaṭṭīkāyām -- saṃskāragaṇanāyāṃ ca yuktaivākṣarasaṃskriyā | svādhyāyo hi sphuṭaṃ karma sākṣātsaṃskriyate hi saḥ || iti | puruṣātiśayādhānaṃ prokṣamādyaiśca ye viduḥ | te'pi saṃskārakarmatvaṃ tatra tatra na tatyujuḥ || 258 || tattatkarmakriyājanyaḥ saṃskāraḥ puruṣāśrayaḥ | tattatsahakṛtaṃ kāryaṃ karotītyavadhāraṇāt || 259 || atrādhyayanasya svādhyāyasaṃskāratve karmatvaṃ heturiti na vaiyadhikaraṇyam | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- atra hi tavyapratyayasyārthāntaraṃ na ghaṭate; tataśca dvitīyāśrutestavyādervā karmārthatve viśeṣābhāvātkārakāṇāṃ kriyārthetve'pi dravyaniṣṭhasya bhāvarthasya dravyārthatvādava hantyādinayo'tra yukta iti | siddhaṃ cāvahantyādeḥ tattaddvavyajhrsyaṭasaṃskāratvaṃ bhedalakṣaṇe tāni dvaidhaṃ guṇapradhānabhūtāni iti | svādhyāyasya ityanena nirvartyatvādyanupapattiḥ sūcitā; na khalvasau nirvartyaḥ, anādisiddhakramatvāt; yathāpūrvoñcāraṇe vākyanirmāṇavyavahārābhāvāñca | nāpi vikāryaḥ, dugdhadadhyādivadanyathābhāvādṛṣṭeḥ | nāpi prāpyatva mātrarūpaḥ, upayogāntaravattve tadayogāt | ataḥ pariśeṣasahakṛtakarmatvāvagatiḥ saṃskāryatve heturiti| saṃskāro hi nāma kāryantarayogyatākaraṇam | saṃskāryatvaṃ ca svādhyāyasya yuktam, dharmārthakāmamokṣarūpapuruṣārthacatuṣṭayatatsādhanāvabodhitvāt, japādinā svarūpeṇāpi tatsādhanatvāñca || nanu karmatvāvagame'pi śrutyādibhiraviniyuktasyādravyasya svādhyāyasya kathaṃ saṃskāryatvamityatrāha -- saṃskāra iti hiḥ prasiddhau | nāma śabdaḥ parasaṃmatiparyante tatprakarṣe | svādhyāyasaṃ bhāvitabhāvyupayogisaṃskārābhiprāyeṇātra kāryāntarayogyatākaraṇoktiḥ| yadvā kasyacitsato'tiśayādhānaṃ saṃskāra iti lakṣaṇamatra vivabhitam | tataśca bhūtopayoginyapi tadanuguṇopayogavivakṣayājhratraṭakāryāntarayogyatāśabdaḥ kathaṃcidyojyaḥ | prahṛtā api paridhayaḥ tenaiva rūpeṇa bhūtopakārarūpakāryāntarayogyāḥ śrūyante | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- na tāvadaviniyuktatvādasaṃskāryatvam; viniyogābhāve'pyupayogadṛṣṭyaiva saṃskāryatvasaṃ bhavāt | asti ca ṛgvedena hotā karotītyādibhiḥ sāmānyato viśeṣataśca viniyogaḥ| nāpyadravyatvādasaṃskāryatvam; yathoktādhyayanagṛhītatve virodhābhāvāt | grahaṇaviṣayatvādeśca guṇādāvapi sarvasammateḥ | coditakriyāsādhyasyeśvarānugraharūpasyātiśayasya svādhyāyādhāratvābhāve'pyadhyayanaprāptatayā ārādhyabuddhisaṃgṛhītena tenaiva yathārhottara kriyāyā- śāstrato niyamānnātiprasaṅgaḥ | vrīhyadiṣvapi prokṣaṇādibhiratīndriyātiśayo bhavatu vā mā vā; uktanyāyaḥ sārvatrika iti | nanu saktūñjuhoti, suvarṇaṃ bhāryamityādiṣu nirvartyatvādirahitakarmatvāvagame'pi bhāvārthasya na dravyārthatā | tathā svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ, svādhyāyamadhīyītetyādijapavidhāvapi karmatvāvagatiraviśiṣṭā | atastatrānaikāntyam; tatrāpi vā jhraṭasaṃskāryatvaprasaṅga ityatrāha -- saṃskāryatvam iti | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- saktvādīnāṃ bhūtabhāvyupayogāsaṃbhavāt, japādeśca gṛhītākṣaraviṣayatvāvaśyaṃ bhāvāt, anekasaṃskāraklṛpratau gauravāt, japādisaṃskārasādhyopayogāntarādarśanāt, phalaśravaṇāñca tatra saṃskāraparityāgaḥ; na tviha tathā syāt, tathā'pi avagatakarmatvasya nirbādhatvāditi| atraiva nyāyasudarśanam -- ādyādhyayanamicchāmaḥ saṃskāraṃ karmatā miteḥ| svādhyāyasyopayogitvāt phalāśravaṇato'pi ca || japāderapi saṃskārakarmateṣyeta cettadā | ādyantu sarvasvādhyāyānupayogādasaṃskṛtiḥ || sarvatra karmatābādhaḥ svādhyāyasya prasajyate | tena saṃskāra ādyaṃ syādapare tvarthakarmaṇi || ārthavādikamevātra phalaṃ syādrātrisatravat || atrānīpsitakarmatvaṃ svādhyāyasyeṣyate budhaiḥ | ādye tvīpsitakarmatvaṃ tadarthā ca kriyā matā || japāderapi saṃskārakarmatve sarvasaṃskārasaṃskāryasya svādhyāyasyārthāvabodha eva bhāvyupayogaḥ syāt | tasya ca anadhikṛtakarmabhāge humādiṣu ca vaiyarthyātsarvāṇyadhyayanānyarthakarmāṇi syuḥ; tadā svādhyāyasya karmatābhaṅgaḥ syāt, tasmādādyādhyayanamekameva saṃskāraḥ iti | nanu atrāpyupayogādarśanādayuktiḥ siddhā; saṃskāryatvādevopayogaklṛptāvanyonyāśrayaṇāt | āhuśca -- saṃskāravidhiśca na saṃskāryaṃ viniyuṅkte; pramāṇāntarāvasitopayogasya saṃskāraparyavasāyī tu saṃskāravidhirna saṃskāryasya kāryaṃ kalpayatīti; tatrāha -- dharmārtha iti | upayogādarśanāddhi saktvādau karmaśrutibādhaḥ; svādhyāyasya tu bhāvidṛṣṭādṛṣṭavividhaprayojanadarśanātsaktvā divannāsaṃskāryatvaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ | atra puruṣārthacatuṣṭayasya vedavedyatvavacanaṃ sarvabhāgānuvṛttaprayojanasāmānyadarśanena kṛtsnasya mīmāṃsitavyatvaravyāpanārtham; bāhyagamoktānāṃ teṣāmaśraddheyatvārthe ca | arthakāmatadupāyānāṃ keṣāñcillokasiddhatve'pi trailokyavibhavādirūpayorarthakāmayostatsādhanānāṃ ca vedavedyatvaṃ yuktam | laukikārthakāmayorapi kārīryādiṣūpāyeṣu śāstravyāpāraḥ siddhaḥ | dharmastu dravyādyātmanā pratyakṣo'pi dhṛtisādhanatvena śāstragrāhyaḥ | yathāhuḥ -- śreyassādhanatā hyeṣāṃ nityaṃ vedātpratīyate | tādrūpyeṇa ca dharmatvaṃ tasmānnendriyagocaraḥ || iti | mokṣaśca nāsmadādipratyakṣaḥ | ātmā kadācitsamastaviśeṣaguṇaśūnyaḥ, anityaviśeṣaguṇavattvāddhaṭavadityādīnāṃ tu vipakṣe bādhakābhāvānnānumānatvam; muktiparaśāstropajīvanena vipakṣe bādhakoktau ca anumānanaiṣphalyam | niratiśayānandabrahmānubhavātmani tu mokṣe hetupravṛtterna prasaṅgaḥ; tadviparītasādhane tvāgamabādhaḥ | api ca, jīvaḥ kadācitsamastaviśeṣaguṇaśūnyo na bhavati; ātmatvādīśvaravadityapi vaktuṃ śakyam | atra arthasyeva dharmasyāpi samīhitasādhanatayā pumarthasya sato dharmaviśeṣaḥ sādhanam; ataḥ so'pi tatsādhanaśabdoktaḥ | mantrārthavādayorapi yathārhaṃ caturvargabodhakatvaṃ tadbodhakopakārakatvaṃ ca grāhyam | śyeneṣu vajraprabhṛtiṣvapi nānarthacodanā | iṣṭasyārātibhaṅgāderupāyāṃśopadeśataḥ || 260 || ghoropāyāntarebhyaśca labhyetātra nivāraṇam | laghuniṣkṛtinistāryaṃ hyabhicāraṃ pracakṣate || 261 || kiṃ cānabhicaranṣaṭsu patedityapi śiṣyate | tena dharmopayuktatvamātatāyivadhe viduḥ || 262 || nanu alaukikapuruṣārthādibodhaktvaṃ smṛtyādāvapyasti, ato'nyasādhye prayojane kiṃ vedasya saṃskāreṇa | artabodhaśca humādau nāsti | puruṣabhedenānadhigatācikīrṣitabhāgayośya sannapyasāvanuṣṭhānaparyantatvābhāvānnopayogī syāt | tadiha svādhyāyasyānya labhyopayogatvādadhyayanasya kṛtsnasvādhyāyasaṃskāratvāyogādekadeśasaṃskārasyāśābdatvāñca | adhyetavyaḥ ityasya saṃskāravidhitvābhāve niyogārthatvapakṣa eva prāpta ityata āha -- japādinā iti | ādiśabdena dhāraṇaṃ gṛhyate | svarūpeṇāpi -- na kevalamarthajñānadvāreṇetyarthaḥ | yadvā adhyāpanamādiśabdagrāhyam | tadā svarūpeṇāpi -- dhutasvarūpamātreṇa ceti yāvat, ṛgvedaṃ dhārayanvipraḥ ityādismṛteḥ | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- adhyayanagṛhītasvādhyāyasādhyameva jñānaṃ vidhibhisupajīvyam; upabṛṃhaṇānāṃ tu na svātantryeṇa dharmādisādhanatvam; asti ca śrutiḥ | vedābhyāsena satataṃ satyena tapasaiva ca | adroheṇa ca bhūtānāṃ jātiṃ smarati paurvikīm || ityādiprasiddhama nanyasādhyaṃ japādiprayojanam | tenaivānarthakānadhikṛtācikīrṣītabhāgeṣvapi saṃskāryatvopapattiḥ | japavidhiśca nirarthakoñcāraṇaviṣayo'pi svādhyāyasyārthaparatāṃ na bādhate, sarvavidhibādhena svavyāghātaprasakteriti | na ca ubhayārthatve viniktaviniyogavirodhaḥ, ekenaiva rūpeṇānekārthatvābhāvāt | tathā ca nyāyasudarśanam -- svarūpeṇa japādyarthaḥ svaśaktyā'rthāvabodhakaḥ | rūpabhedādvirodho na yathāgnerdāhabhāsayoḥ || iti | tadihādhyayanasaṃskṛtādvedādanantaprayojanasaṃbhavaṃ tadvicāramantareṇānyatra śāstrābhyājhrbhāṭase kaḥ prayasyediti tātparyam | evamadhyayanavidhirmantravanniyamavadakṣararāśigrahaṇamātre paryavasyati | nanu evaṃ viditopayogenādhyetrā arthajñānamapi vidhiphalatayā svīkāryam; aviditopayogena tu akṣaragrahaṇamapi na phalatvena pratipattuṃ śakyam; ato'nuṣṭhānaṃ pratyavyavahitopayuktamarthajñānamapi grahaṇavadadhyayanavidherdṛṣṭaṃ phalamastviti śaṅkā prastutopasaṃhāravyājena pratikṣipati -- evam iti | vidheyasvarūpaphalādinirūpaṇaprakā reṇetyarthaḥ | mantravattvaṃ niyamavattvaṃ ca anūñcāraṇasthaṃ tatphale gṛhītāvupacaritam | mantrāḥ -- kāṇḍavratādyaṅgabhūtāḥ, adhyayanadaśājapyāśca śaṃ no mitraḥ ityādyāḥ | niyamāḥ -- prāguktāḥ | mantravadityetat dṛṣṭāntoktirityeke -- yathā mantre codyamānamadhyayanamakṣaragrahaṇamātraparyavasāyīti svīkriyate, tathehāpīti | apare tu -- yathopanayanadaśoñcaraṇīyeṣūpanītamātrasya samidādhānādimantreṣu ca, tathehāpīti veditavyamiti | humādivadityanye, viṣaharaṇādimantraviśeṣavaditi ca | mātracā paryavasānaśabdena cākṣaragrahaṇātpaścātpūrvaṃ ca vidhiviśrāntirniṣidhyate | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- adhyayanaśabdasya na tāvadarthajñānavācakatvam, avyutpatteḥ, kiñcidadhītya brāhmaṇa ityādau ca tasyārthaparatvāsaṃbhavāñca | vidhiviṣayamadhyayanaṃ pratyavyavahitasādhyamabhivyāptamavarjanīyaṃ ca phalaṃ dṛśyate | tadanyasyāpi tatphalatvaklṛptau gauravaṃ syāt, vyavahitasādhyasyāpi phalatvaklṛptau jñānavattatsādhyasyānuṣṭhānasyāpi tatklṛptiprasaṅgaḥ | uttaravidhyavyavahitāpekṣitatvamapi grahaṇajñānayoḥ samam | yadi cārthajñānaṃ karmaviṣayatayāmnātaṃ, tadā tu avyāpini vyavahite'pi tasminsaṃpratyayaḥ syāt, na tvetadasti | ato'rthadhiya upayogitayaiva svīkāryā iti | nanu samanvayādhikaraṇanyāyādarthajñānasyaiva svataḥ prayojanatayā phalatvaklṛptiryuktā ; mevam; niratiśayānandabrahmapratipādakabhāgamātre tadukteḥ atra tu kṛtsnādhyayanaphalavimarśāt virūpaklṛptyayogāñca | nanu bṛddhavākyāni śruṇu ityādau vākyaśravaṇavigherarthadhīparyantatvaṃ lokadṛṣṭamiti cenna, vṛkṣādivanmārgalakṣaṇabhūtasya kasyacidvākyasya śrotavyatvopadeśe tātparyāttadabhāvasyāpi dṛṣṭeḥ | kiṃ ca kvacidvākyaśravaṇopadeśasyārthaparatvamagatyā; iha tu na tathā, loke dṛṣṭā | nanu yo ha vā aviditārṣeyacchandodaivatena mantreṇa ityādiśrutibhiḥ, aviditvā ṛṣiṃ chandaḥ yadadhītamavijñāta mityādibhiḥ smṛtibhiśca viparyaye doṣoktyā'rthajñānamavaśyasampādyatvena sthāpitam; tadabhāve'dhyayanasya naiṣphalyaṃ tatsadbhāve sarvapuruṣārthāvāptiścocyate -- sthāṇurayaṃ bhārahāraḥ kilābhūdadhītya vedaṃ na vijānāti yo'rtham | yo'rthajña itsakalaṃ bhadramaśnute jhrsaṭanākameti jñānavidhūtapāpmā || iti; tasmādvaidho vedārthavicāraḥ | maivam; yathā rāgaprāptasya ṛtugamanāderakaraṇe doṣaḥ, vidhivatkaraṇe santatyādilābhaśca phalatvena smaryate, evamihāpi syāt | tasmāt etāni mantre mantre vidyāt ityetatu prayogakāle pratimantraṃ prajñātaṛṣyādyanusmaraṇaparam | ata eva aviditārṣeyatvādiniṣedhaśca tāvanmātraviṣayaḥ | ataḥ yadadhītam sthāṇurayam yaśca mīmāṃsate'dhvaram ityādibhirarthajñānapraśaṃsayā svataḥ pravṛttisutabhyate | etaiśca arthajñānasyāvaśyāpekṣitatvena vidhāvapi nādhyayanavidhestatparyantatvaṃ kalpyam; nairapekṣyāt, anyataḥ prāpte vidheraudāsīnyāśca, tāvatparyantadhāvane'pi svataḥ puruṣārthāparyavasānāñca | yattu kaiścit pratyavasthīyate -- adhyayanavidherarthajñānaparyantatvāt, ācāryakulādvedamadhītya yathāvidhānaṃ guroḥ karmātiśeṣeṇābhisamāvṛttya kuṭumbe śucau deśe svādhyāyamadhīyano dhārmikānvidadhat ityādibhiḥ śrutibhiḥ, adhītya snāyāt ityādibhiḥ smṛtimiśca ātmarūpārthajñānasyāpi karmārthatayā tatkartṛsaṃskāratvena viniyogāt draṣṭavyaḥ śrotavyo mantavyo nididhyāsitavyaḥ, so'nveṣṭavyaḥ sa vijijñāsitavyaḥ iti jijñāsyatayoktasyātmano'vahantavyavrīhivatsvarasāvagatasaṃskāryatvābādhena karmaśeṣatvasiddhyā tattvamasi ayamātmā brahma ityādibhiḥ karmavaśyasyaiva brahmatvokteḥ viśvakartṛtvasya ca karmadvāropapatteḥ klṛprakalpyavirodhe klṛptagṛhīternyāyyatvājjīvasya karmasu kartṛtayā prāptasya tadarthaṃ saṃskārārhatvācca jīvapare vedānte sati tadatirikteśvaraviṣayaśāstrā sambhavāt kasyaikaśāstrayaṃ kramaśca kalpyata iti | tadapi akṣaragrahaṇamātraparyavasānabhāṣaṇātpratyuktam | sūtrakāro'pi adhītya, abhisamāvṛtya ityādibhirnārthajñānasya karmaśeṣatvena viniyogaḥ; ktvāśruteḥ samānakartṛtvādimātre viśramāt | tathā viniyoge'pi karmānuṣṭhānopayuktārthajñānādanyadevopāsanā tmakaṃ jñānaṃ vedāntavākyaividhitsitam | upāsyaścātmā jīvātiriktaḥ śrutyaiva siddhaḥ, na tu kalpyaḥ | jīva brahmasāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca acidbrahmasāmānādhikaraṇyavadaikyavirodhādanyārtham | tiṣṭhatu ca tathāvidhijñānavidhānam, tathāpi na virodhaḥ; karturivārādhyasyāpi karmārthatvena vicāryatvātasya ca karmavaśyādanyatvena śrutisiddhatvāttadvicārārthakāṇḍāntarādisiddheḥ | yadyapi atrāpyarthajñānasyānuṣṭhānaśeṣatve'pi yathāṃśaṃ parabrahmopāsanaśeṣatvamapi syādityuttaraṃ prāptam | tathāpi arthajñānaprayantatāmūle codye prathamaparvasthodbhaṭāparādhopekṣāyogādanvāruhyavādamanādṛtya mūlaccheda evātra kartavya ityabhiprāyeṇa sūtrabhāṣyayormātraśabdaḥ | adhyayanagṛhītasya svādhyāyasya svabhāvata eva prayojanavadarthāvabodhitvadarśanāt, gṛhītātsvādhyāyādavagamyamānām prayojanavato'rthānāpātato dṛṣṭvā tatsvarūpaprakāraviśeṣanirṇayaphalavedavākyavicārarūpamīmāṃsāśravaṇe'dhītavedaḥ puruṣaḥ svayameva pravartate | tatra karmavidhirvarūpe nirūpite karmaṇāmalpāsthiraphalatvaṃ dṛṣṭvā adhyayanagṛhītasvādhyāyaikadeśopaniṣadvākyeṣu cāmṛtatvarūpānantāsthiraphalāpātapratītestannirṇayaphalavedāntavākyavicārarūpaśārīrakamīmāṃsāyāmadhikaroti | nanu adhyayanavidhāvakṣaragrahaṇaparyavasite'nyārthatayaivādhītasya svādhyāyasya pratīto'pyarthastātparyaviṣayatvāyogādavicāryaḥ; tato nirarthako vedaḥ; avyayanavidhiśca na puruṣārthaparyantaḥ, nirviṣayatayā adhītya snāyāt iti smṛtiniruddhāvasaratayā ca mīmāṃsāpi nārabhyeta; kutastadaikyādi syāt iti śaṅkāmapanudannekaviṣayatayā vedāravyaikavyāravyeyavyākhyānātmakaśāstraikyamapi darśayanmīmāṃsārambhasūtrārthaṃ ca sūcayati -- adhyayana iti | atra svādhyāyanirṇayavicārarūpādhītavedaśabdaiḥ mīmāṃsāyā viṣayaphalasvarūpādhikāryaikyavyañjanam | gṛhītasya ityanena vidhivyāpārasya viśramoktiḥ | prayojanavadarthadarśanoktistu puruṣārthaprayavasānajñāpanārthā | svabhāvata eva -- vidhīvyāpāramanapekṣyetyarthaḥ; vyutpannapadapatārthoderiti śeṣaḥ | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ -- grahaṇārthamupātto'pi svādhyāyo vahnivatsvayam | prakāśayati yattatra svato mānamabādhataḥ || 263 || japāda jhr rthā ṭa dhyayanaṃ śrautatattatphalasamanviṃtam | na rundhe śabdasāmarthyaṃ grahaṇārthaṃ tu kiṃ punaḥ || 264 || viniyogaviśeṣeṇa vede'rthaparatāṃ kṣipan | viniyogārthadhībādhāt svavyāghātena bādhitaḥ || 265 || vivakṣitārthaiva na vā syādadhyayanacodanā | ādye vyāharirantye tu pūrvapakṣasya notthitiḥ || 266 || arthajñānaphalatvena mānatvaṃ cātra durbhaṇam | tatphalatve hi tanmānaṃ tanmānatve ca tattviti || 267 || svīkarotyarthaparatāṃ niyogārtho'pi cedvidhiḥ | saṃskārārtho'pi tadvatsyāt svasiddhyautsukyasāmavat || 268 || vedaḥ nirapekṣavedakaḥ; na tu puṃvākyavat mūjhrlaṭalībhūtamānāntaramapekṣyetyarthaḥ| ata eva na mūladoṣavicāraśaṅkyā vicārastambhanabhiti bhāvaḥ | prayojanamatra caturvargaḥ | tadvanto'rthāstadupāyāḥ karmopāsanārūpāḥ | avabodhitvam iha nirṇayajananānuguṇatvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ durapahnavam | na ca dṛṣṭe anupapannaṃ nāmetyabhiprāyeṇa darśanāt ityuktam | svata eva bodhaktave'pi sādhyābhāvānna mīmāṃsyamityatrāha -- gṛhītāt iti | arthānāpātato'vagamyamānān dṛṣṭvā iti tatkālaviśeṣaṇatayā'nvayaḥ | āpātadhīreva dṛṣṭā; ataḥ saṃśayādinirāsaḥ sādhya ityāśayaḥ | pūrvaḥ prayojanavadarthaśabdaḥ kākadantoktivyāvṛttyā śrutiprāmāṇyārthaḥ | uttarastvāpātadhiyaḥ svaviṣayavicārarāgajananena prerakatvajñāpakaḥ | pratītamapratītaṃ vā na mīmāṃsyeta kiñcana | iti codyamapi kṣiptamāpātajñātatoktitaḥ || 269 || nanu yaji śabdasvabhāvādāpātadhīḥ, tarhi avyutpannānāmapi syāt; na cātra vyutpattipatāmeva tadvidhirasti, jhrataḥṭaaṅgeṣvapyaṅgivadakṣaragrahaṇānte vidhau tadasaṃbhavāt vidhyaikyarūpye cāṅgādhyayanasyārthajñānaparyantatve viśeṣahetvabhāvāt | atra brūmaḥ sya saṃskṛtabhāṣaiva bālyātprabhṛti śīlitā | tadā tu tasya sā tatra syādāpātamatissvam || 270 || niraṅgādhyayane'pyevaṃ sāṅgādhītau tu kiṃ punaḥ | vaidārthāpātadhīvṛddhimaṅgārthāpātadhīrdiśet || 271 || hitaiṣivākyajātāṃ ca kecidāpātasaṃvidam | prāpanubanto vicāre hi pravartante manīṣiṇaḥ || 272 || kecittvaṅgyupakārārharūpeṇāṅgākṣaragrahe | sārthajñānatvamācaravyurdṛṣṭārthatvaṃ tu laghviti || 273 || astvevamāpātadhīḥ; tadariktapi jñānaṃ vidyāsthānāntaraireva sādhyatāmityatrottaram -- tatsvarūpe tyādi | sūpvapakṣoktāt vyāvṛttarūpāvadhāraṇamihānyairasādhyaṃ phalamiti bhāvaḥ | vedavākyavicārarūpe tyanena vidyāsthānāntaravyāvṛttamīmāṃsāśarīravyañjanam | mīmāṃsāyā vicārarūpatvoktistadabhedopacārāt, vicāraśabdasya karaṇavyutpattyā vā | vidhiviṣaye kṛtyaśeṣaṃ nāstītyabhiprāyeṇādhītavedatvoktiḥ āpātadhīmattvāditi hetvabhiprāyā ca | puruṣa iti hetugarbhe prayojanārthitvāditi | svayameva -- vidhinirapekṣasvecchayetyarthaḥ | āpātasvopayuktārthe bhāte tannirṇayārthinaḥ | tadupāye pravṛttasya vidhānaṃ hyanapekṣitam || 274 || sveṣṭaniścayahetutvamanvayavyatirekataḥ | siddhameva vicārasya tatrāpi hyaphalo vidhiḥ || 275 || saṃprekṣya nidhiratnādīṃstadyathārthanirūpaṇe | aparapreritā eva pravartante tadarthinaḥ || 276 || ato na vidhisiddho'tra vicārastatkramo'pi vā | anyathā doṣadṛṣṭyaiva dvitīyasyopapattitaḥ || 277 || svayaṃ pravṛttāvapyācāryanairapekṣyavyudāsāya śravaṇatadāśrayaṇe pravṛttiḥ | akaraṇe tarhyadoṣassyāt; tanna -- tadadhīnaniścayatatsāpekṣahitapravṛttyādīnāmabhāvasyaiva doṣatvāt | tadabhiprāyeṇa hyetadapyucyate -- adhītya vedānsāṅgāṃstu yo vicāramupekṣate | svaprayāsaṃ ca vismṛtya prabhraṣṭassyātprayojanāt || iti | nanvevaṃ vicārasya avaidhatve adhītya snāyādityādividhiniruddhāvasaraḥ kathaṃ mīmāṃsatām; duḥkhātmakagurukulavāsānnivṛtteḥ svataḥ prāptatvāt ānantaryameva hyatra vidheyam | maivam, saniyamakasamāvṛttiyuktasnānarūpasaṃskāra eva hyatra vithīyate, anyathā nivṛttyānantaryasyāpi svataḥ prāptatvādavidheyatvaṃ syāt | kiñca vicārasya vaidhatve'pi kathamavasaraḥ | śrutyā smṛterbādhāditi cenna; śrutāvapi adhītya, abhisamāvṛtya ityukteḥ | tatra samānakartṛkatvapūrvakālatvamātraparatayā''nantarye tātparyaṃ nāstīti cet, smṛtāvapi kiṃ na tathā syāt | na ca śrutāvadhyayanaśabdo'rthajñānaparyantaḥ, eva smṛtāvakṣaragrahaṇaparyanta iti niyantuṃ śakyam | yadadhītamityādivatsyāditi cenna, virodhāvirodhābhyāṃ viśeṣāt | astu tarhi śrutismṛtyordvayorapyarthajñānaprayantādhyayanānuvātaḥ, tathā sati snānavidhiḥ vaidhasya vicārasyāvasaraṃ na virundhyāditi cet; tarhi rāgaprāptasyāpi svopayuktadravyārjanāderiva śravaṇasyāvasaraṃ na virundhyādeva | jñātvā'nuṣṭhānamicchantaḥ snānādividhayaḥ svataḥ | prācīmeva svaviṣayāṃ mīmāṃsāṃ parigṛhṇate || 278 || kiṃ cātra mānabhedāṅgakramakartrādyavedinaḥ | na snānavidhimaṣyekaṃ yathāvaddhedituṃ kṣamāḥ || 279 || agatyā'dhyayanādau prāgavicārya pravartate | snāne tu gatisadbhāvāt na syādagatikā gatiḥ || 280 || anujñātaṃ ca sarvatra na svāṅgaṃ vyavadhāyakam | ato mīmāṃsayā nātra vyavadhānaṃ virodhakṛt || 281 || yadvā adhyayanasnānanairantarye'pi na virodhaḥ | avicāritadharmāṇāmuttarānuṣṭhānāsiddhiprasaṅgādvirodha iti cenna; snātasyāpi yāvadvicāraṃ hitakāmairbrahmacāriṇa ivānuṣṭhāpalopapatteḥ | na ca hitaiṣivākyādanuṣṭhāne'paśūdranayavirodhaḥ, tattaducitadharmeṣu hitaiṣibhiḥ pravartanāt na cāsyopadiśeddharmamityādiniṣedhadṛṣṭeśca | anyathā'pyanuṣṭhānasiddhau mīmāṃsāśravaṇaṃ nirarthakaṃ syāditi cet, tanna -- vaiparītyaśaṅkāyāṃ mūlajijñāsayā paranaiparekṣyapravacanakhyātyādiśraddhayā ca tadupapatteḥ | evameva pūrveṣāmuttareṣāmapītyavicchedasiddhiḥ | kaścidālasyātpatrādīneva sarvathā pramāṇayediti cet, tataḥ kim; analasairanyaiśśāstraśravaṇopapatteḥ | snātasya śrṛṇvato gurvarthavyāpāraiḥ svadharmoparodhaḥ syāditi cet, na; adhyayanavidhiprayuktānāṃ teṣāṃ nivṛtteṛ | yathoktaṃ nyāyasudarśane akṣaragrahaṇopāyaniyamārtho hyayaṃ vidhiḥ | tadgrahāvadhikā dharmasthitirityabravīt smṛtiḥ || adhītādvedataḥ paścādarthajñānaṃ svato bhavet | tattu nādhyayanaṃ nāpi dharmāṇāṃ ca prayojakam || iti | kimarthaṃ tarhi mīmāṃsāmācāryaḥ śrāvayet ? lābhādyarthaṃ dharmārthaṃ vā | gṛhasthadharmoparuddhasya kaḥ śrotumavasaraḥ ? ko vācāryasya pravaktum ? tasya vṛttyarthino'sti dravyārjanakāla iti cet, tarhi vidhyanujñātadṛṣṭarthapravṛttyantaravacchravaṇasyāpi syāt | itihāsādyarthatayā ca gṛhiṇo'pyasti kaścidvicārakālaḥ | tadā ca vedopabṛṃhaṇaistaiḥ svasādhyānuguṇatvena mīmāṃsā'pyupādīyeta | vedābhyāsaṃ caivaṃ vibhajante -- vedasvīkaraṇaṃ pūrvaṃ vicāro'bhyasanaṃ japaḥ | taddānaṃ caiva śiṣyebhyo vedābhyāso hi pañcadhā || iti | kulakramāgatadhanāderdaivādāgatadhanādeḥ kasyacit tadārjanakālo'pyapekṣita śravaṇasya kālaḥ | gṛhasthādayaścāvicāritavarṇādidharmāstattaddharmaśrotāraḥ śrutismṛtiṣu dṛśyante | gṛhasthasyāpyatiśayitavidyārthaṃ pratyabdaṃ dvau dvau māsau gurugulavāsaśca kenacidanujñātaḥ | yathānūdyate -- niveśe vṛtte saṃvatsare saṃvatsare dvau dvau māsau samāhita ācāryakule vasedbhūyaśśruti; micchanniti śvetaketuḥ etena hyahaṃ yogena bhūyaḥ pūrvasmāt kālācchatamakurvi iti | nanvatra tacchāstrairvipratiṣiddhamniveśe hi vṛtte naiyamikāni śrūyante agnihotramatithayaḥ ityādinā''pastambaḥ svamatamāha; satyam; tenāpi tadā māsadvayaṃ nirantaragurukulavāsamātraṃ niṣidhyate; na tu pravaktṛvacchrotussidhyan vicārāvasaraḥ kṣipyate | astvadhyayanānantaraṃ vicāraḥ, sa ca rāgataḥ kṛtsnaviṣayaśca; tathā'pi avaidhatve vicārasya kramasya ca yathāruci | apravṛtteḥ pravṛtteśca prāptau tatraiti bhāṣyate || 282 || dustyajatvādvicārasya yaugapadyavirodhataḥ | vyutkrame doṣadṛṣṭyā ca kramassautro hyasāviti || 283 || tatra vede mīmāṃsāyāṃ vā; svecchātaḥ pravṛttau satyāmiti vā'rthaḥ | karma vidhiriha kāmyakarmacodanā kāmyānuṣṭhānaṃ vā; aviśeṣādvā nityāderapi saṃgrahaḥ | svarupaśabdena tyaktaphalasya paravidyāṅgaviniyogo na cintita iti sūcyate | sa hi sādhanalakṣaṇe śodhyaḥ; tannirūpaṇe hi anantasthiraphalaparyantatvaṃ budhyeta | yadvā kevalakarmaṇāmalpāsthiraphalatvasya kacidamīmāṃsitatve'pīti bhāvaḥ | nirūpite ityanena karmanirūpaṇasya vṛttatvāvaśyaṃbhāvo'bhipretaḥ | prapañcitaṃ caita ttātparyatūlikāyām -- tatredaṃ niyataṃ karma naiva śakyamupekṣitum | taddhisarvāsvavasthāsu pumāṃsamanuvartate || bubhukṣurvā mumukṣurvā yo yo gṛhyeta puruṣaḥ | tasya sarvasya bahunā karmaṇāmugamo'sti hi || nityaṃ naimittikaṃ karma pratiṣiddhaṃ ca sarvadā | sarvairapi parīkṣyaṃ hi pratyavāyajihāsayā || na ye bibhyati duḥkhebhyaste mā kārṣurvicāraṇām | itareṣāmiyatkarma vicāryamiti tu sphuṭam || kāmyaṃ tu karma bhogāya vināpi brahmaṇā kṣamam | na karmaṇā vinā brahma mokṣasāmarthyamaśnute || sarvāpekṣā ca yajñādiśruteriti hi vakṣyate | vedaikadeśacintāpi proktā kṛtsnaprayojikā || tasmādavaśyacintyatve karmaivāgre vicāryate || iti | karmaṇāmalpāsthiraphalatvaṃ dṛṣṭvā -- tattadvākyairevārthato viśadaṃ niścityetyarthaḥ| jyotiṣṭomagnihotrādisvarūpanirūpaṇe hi yathopāyaṃ guruladhusvargabhedaklṛptissyāt | jyotiṣṭomo'gniṣṭoma ityanena jyotiṣṭomasyāgniṣṭomarūpatve niścite ca tatsādhyasya svargasya yāvadagniṣṭomenopāpnotītyādinā deśakālādiparicchedaniścayaḥ | tatrāvṛttividhirapyanāvṛttasya phalālpatve liṅgam | nityakarmaṇāmapi kasmiṃścidadhikāriṇi prājāpatyaṃ brāhmaṇānāmityādibhirvarṇāśramabhedena phalatāratamyaṃ smaryate | vaiśvadevavaruṇapraghāsādīnāṃ cāturmāsyānāṃ svarūpe'vagate hi eṣā vai vaiśvadevasya mātrā, etadvā eteṣāmavamam, ato'to vā uttarāṇi śreyāṃsi bhavantīti vaiśvadevādermitaphalatva darśanāt, akṣayyaṃ ha vai cāturmāsyayājinassukṛtamityatra ciropabhogyatvamātre tātparyagrahaḥ | yadyapyakṣayaphalatvamidaṃ vidyāṅgatvena paraṃparayā netuṃ śakyam, tathā'pyatra tadvivakṣāvirahānna tathā nīyate | evaṃ parimitaphalasomahaviṣkarmasvarūpaniścaye satyeva apāma somamityādāvamṛtatvasya ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ sthānamamṛtatvamityādismṛtyā niyamaḥ | svargasvārājyādiphalabhedasādhakakarmasvarūpabhedasiddhau ca tatra svargaśabdoktasyālpatvasiddhiḥ | yaṃ yaṃ kratumadhīta ityādiṣu ca phalatāratamyaklṛptiḥ gurulaghukarmasvarūpaniścayādeva | utpattināśavadārādhyaprīṇanakarmasvarūpaniścayāñca tatsādhyasya tatsāyujyā derasthiratvadṛṣṭiriti | tadevaṃ nirastapratibandhabrahmavicārārthasya śārīrakasya vidyāsthānāntaravyāvṛttasvarūpaphalābhyāṃ mīmāṃsaikadeśatvavyaktyarthaṃ nirṇetavyaviśeṣasiddhyarthaṃ ca punaḥ adhyayane tyādikamuktam | atrāmṛtatvaśabdena trayyantapradhānavedyaphaloktiḥ; tenārvācīnānāmānuṣaṅgikānnavattvādīnāṃ saṅgatyantaraghaṭitadṛṣṭividhyādiphalānāṃ ca vyavacchedaḥ | karmabhāgoktamamṛtatvamāpekṣikaṃ sādhitam | idaṃ tu bādhādarśanāt nirṇītāṃsasaṃvādivedāntaikadeśopaṣṭambhāñca na prācyavaditi pratyāyitaprāyamityabhiprāyeṇa anantasthiraphalāpātapratīterityuktam | na hyatra phalatvādyanumānaiḥ alpāsthiratvādiklṛptiḥ śakyā, atiprasaṅgāditi | anavacchedādiha sarvaśarīraḥ śārīraḥ, tamadhikṛtya pravṛttaṃ śāstraṃ śārīrakam | vakṣyati hi ānandamayādhikaraṇe -- sa eva nirupādhikaḥ śārīra ātmā | ata evedaṃ paraṃ brahmādhikṛtya pravṛttaṃ śāstraṃ śārīrakamityabhiyuktairabhidhīyata iti | saiva mīmāṃseti śārīkamīmāṃsā; tasyām | adhikaroti svārthabuddhyā tatrodyukto bhavati, na tu pūrvavṛttāntarādadhikarotītyarthaḥ | brahmavicārānantarye yuktisiddhe tadviṣayaśāstrānantaryamapi sidhyediti bhāvaḥ | grahaṇaṃ ca phalatvaṃ ca sārthatā ca svataḥ śruteḥ | rāgātkṛtsnavicāraścetyapūrvamiha bhāṣitam || 284 || tathā ca vedāntavākyāni kevalakarmaphalasya kṣayitvaṃ brahmajñānasya cākṣayaphalatvaṃ darśayanti | tadyatheha karmācito lokaḥ kṣīyate, evamevāmutra puṇyacito lokaḥ kṣīyate | antavadevāsya tadbhavati | na hyadhruvaiḥ prāpyate | plavā hyete adṛḍhā yajñarūpāḥ parīkṣya lokān karmacitān brāhmaṇo nirvedamāyānnāstyakṛtaḥ kṛtena | tadvijñānārthaṃ sa gurumevābhigacchet samitpāṇiśśrotriyaṃ brahmaniṣṭham | tasmai sa vidvānupasannāya samyak praśāntacittāya śamānvitāya | yenākṣaraṃ puruṣaṃ veda satyaṃ provāca tāṃ tattvato brahmavidyām | brahmavidāpnoti param, na punarmṛtyave tadekaṃ paśyati na paśyo mṛtyuṃ paśyati, sa svarāṅ bhavati, tamevaṃ vidvānamṛta iha bhavati, nānyaḥ panthā ayanāya vidyate, pṛthagātmānaṃ preritāraṃ ca matvā juṣṭastatastenāmṛtatvameti ityādīni | nanu karmaphalālpatvādau liṅgamātraṃ dṛṣṭam; yathāśrutaviruddhapratyayadārḍhyāya prāptirapi vaktavyā, karmasvarupanirūpaṇaṃ cātra svayaṃpravṛtteḥ pratibandhaśāntartham; hetustvanantasthiraphalāpātapratītireva, sā kutastyetrāha -- tathā iti | uktaprakāreṇāsya sūtrasyāpyaidamarthyaṃ yathā syāttathetyarthaḥ | caḥ avadhāraṇe | atra kṣatitvoktirakṣayitvoktiścālpatvāderupalakṣikā | niścitasaṃvādenāniścite'rthāntare'pi śraddhāsaṃvṛddhyai pūrvaṃ tadyathetyādivākyodāhṛtiḥ | loko lokyaḥ, bhogyaḥ | deśaparatve tvihāmutretyābhyāmananvayaḥ | karmacitaḥ laukikakarmalabdhaḥ | puṇyacita ityaviśeṣoktyā nivṛttidharmasādhyasyāpi kṣayitvabhramaṃ nivārayitumāha -- antavat iti | upāttavākyai kārthyāt kriyāsvarūpāntavattvasyānapekṣitavacanatvāñca phaladvārā'trāntattvoktiḥ | yo vā etadakṣaraṃ gārgyaviditvā'smin loke juhoti yajate tapastapyate bahūni varṣasahasrāṇīti pūrvavākyāt yo vā etadakṣaraṃ gārgyaviditvā'smāllokātpraiti sa kṛpaṇa ityuttaravākyāñca; antavadityasya brahmavedanarahitakarmaviṣayatvasiddhau puṇyacitaḥ ityatrottareṣu ca tadviṣayatvaṃ sugamam | jñānarahitakarmasu svargasvārājyādiphalabhedavat keṣucinnityaphalabhedasaṃbhavāt sarvebhyaḥ kāmebhyo jyotiṣṭoma iti śravaṇāñcatropāttaṃ vākyaṃ prāyikaviṣayaṃ syādityātrāha -- na hīti | adhruvaiḥ adhruvaphalasādhanatayā coditairityarthaḥ | dhruvaṃ taditi vākyakhaṇḍānvayāt nityaphalārthatvābhāvaḥ ravyāpyate | punarāvṛttiniyamavataḥ sarvakarmanirmūlanatvāyogena dhruvaphalasādhanatvābhāvaṃ draḍhati -- plavā iti | adṛḍhāḥ tamasaḥ pāraṃ gamayitumakṣamāḥ | aṣṭādaśoktamavaraṃ yeṣu karma | etacchreyo ye'bhinandanti mūḍhāḥ jarāmṛtyū te punarevāpi yanti | iti hyatra vākyadeṣaḥ | atha sūtrārthānuguṇaṃ karmaṇāṃ nityaphalasādhanatvābhāvaniścayasya nirvedahetutvaṃ brahmajñānasyānantaphalatvaṃ ca samuñcitya vadadvākyamāha -- parī kṣyeti | iyaṃ śrutiḥ sāre vyāravyātā -- brāhmaṇaḥ -- vedābhyāsarataḥ, karmacitān -- karmaṇā saṃpāditān, lokān ārādhyakṣayitvena kṣayasvabhāvān, karmamīmāṃsayā parīkṣya, akṛtaḥ -- nityaḥ paramapuruṣaḥ, kṛtena -- karmaṇā nāsti na saṃpadyata iti yo nirvedamāyāt, sa tadvijñānārthaṃ gurumevābhigacchet samitpāṇiḥ śrotriyaṃ -- vedāntavedinam, brahmaniṣṭhaṃ sākṣātkṛtaparamapuruṣasvarūpam | sa ca guruḥ samyagupasannāya tasmai, yena vidyāvi śeṣeṇa tama kṣaraṃ satyaṃ paramapuruṣaṃ vidyāt, tāṃ brahmavidyām provāca prabrūyādityarthaḥ | sa gurumevābhigacchet tasmai sa vidvān provācetyananvayāt, aprāptatvāñca | vidhāvapi liṭo vidhānāt; chandasi luṅlaṅliṭa iti, iti | atra nyāyasiddhānuvādāṃśe jātivācino'pi brāhmaṇaśabdasya prakṛtakarmaparīkṣaṇaupayikasāṅgādhyetṛsamarpaṇenājahallakṣaṇayā traivarṇikaviṣayatvārthaṃ vedābhyāsarataḥ ityuktam | brahma aṇatītyapi brāhmaṇaśabdaṃ nirbruvanti | ārādhyakṣayitveneti sukṛtavināsopalakṣaṇam | karmamīmāṃsayetyarthalabhyoktiḥ | akṛtaśabdasya puṃliṅgatānurodhāt vākyaśeṣaśaktyā ca paramapuruṣo viśeṣyo darśitaḥ | atra nāstiśabdenākṛtasya svarūpaniṣedhāyogāt karmaṇā ityanena cānanvayāt utpattiniṣedhasyānapekṣitatvāt tasya viśadabodhāyetyarthaḥ | samitpāṇitvamiha brahma vidyāśravaṇārthopanayanāntaravyañjanārthamiti kecit | uktaṃ hi chāndogye jābālaṃ prati gautamena -- naitadabrāhmaṇo vivaktumarhati samidhaṃ somyāharopa tvāneṣya iti | anyetvāhuḥ -- anupanīte jābāle yuktamupanayanam; anyatra tu samitpāṇitvoktirariktapāṇitvopalakṣaṇārthā; dṛśyate hi vaiśvānaravidyāyām -- te ha samitpāṇayaḥ pūrvāhṇe ca praticakramire tān hānupanīyaivaitaduvāca iti | prajāpativākye ca ekasyaivendrasya bahuṣu praśneṣu samitpāṇiḥ punareyāyetyāvartyate | na hi tatra bahuvāramupanayanaṃ dṛṣṭamiṣṭaṃ vā | sūtrakāraśca saṃskāraparāmarśādityetāvanmātraṃ vakṣyatīti | ekāṃ śākhāmadhītya śrotriya ityuktasyādhītasvādhyāyamātrasya prakṛtānupakārakatayā vedāntavedinamiti śrotriyaśabdasyātrākāmahataśrotriyaparatvaṃ darśitam | sphuṭapravacanakṣamatvamadṛṣṭata upakārakatamatvaṃ ca brahmaniṣṭhaśabdābhipretamityāha -- sākṣātkṛtaparamapuruṣasvarūpamiti | praśāntacittāyetyuktatvācchamo'tra bāhyakaraṇavyāpārāntaranivṛttiḥ | śamadamāviha śravaṇaupayikāvadhānārthau | tasmādevaṃvicchānto dānta ityādau tu śravaṇato viditārthasya vidyārthau | yenetyatra liṅgavyatyayasya kliṣṭatvātsāmānyopakramatvaṃ dyotayati -- vidyāviśeṣaṇeti | tathā ca prayuñjate tatra bādhakamabhavat kṣaṇabhaṅgo vā bāhyārthabhaṅgo vā ityādi | svarūpataḥ svabhāvataśca vikāraṃ nivartayadbhyāmakṣarasatyapadābhyāṃ pradhānakṣetrajñavyavaccheda ityabhiprāyeṇāha -- paramapuruṣamiti | saṃśayaviparyayārhavacanam, apūrṇavacanaṃ ca kṣeptuṃ tattvataḥ iti viśeṣaṇam; ācāryo'pyanācāryo bhavati śrutātpariharamāṇa iti smaranti | vṛttārthakathanabhrabhanirāsāyāha -- prabrūyāditi | abhigacchedityupakramapratītavidhibādhena vyatyayānusaraṇaṃ kliṣṭam; ataḥ provācetyasya bhūtaparatvenānanvaya ityabhiprāyeṇāha -- sa gurumeveti | niyamavidhitvamavadhāraṇena vyañjitam | provācetyasya vidhiparatve hetvantaramāha -- aprāptatvāditi | yadyapi lābhādyapekṣayā kasyacidrāgataḥ pravṛttiḥ; tathā'pi tannirapekṣasya guroḥ sacchiṣyaviṣaye dharmārthamidaṃ vidhīyata iti na virodhaḥ | liṭo liṅarthatvasya viśeṣato'nuśiṣṭatva mapyāha -- vidhāvapīti | brahmajñānasya paraśabdanirdiṣṭabrahmaprāpakatayā prākaraṇikanityaniratiśayānandaprāpakatvamabhipretyāha -- brahmavidi ti | brahma prāptasyāpi svargādinyāyāt imān lokānityādibhiśca punarāvṛttyādiśaṅkāṃ parihartumāha -- na puna riti | mṛtyuriha maraṇam, moho mṛtyussaṃmato yaḥ kavīnāmityādyuktaṃ vā | pāpmanāṃ niśśeṣakṣaye mṛtyūpalakṣitaṃ sarvamaniṣṭaṃ na syāt, lokānusaraṇaṃ caicchamiti bhāvaḥ | tadekadarśanamihopāyaḥ, phalaṃ vā | na pretya saṃjñāstīti yidyāprakaraṇa sthavākyena muktasya jñānalopaśaṅkāṃ nivartayan mṛtyutatkāryanivṛtiṃta ca vyanakti -- na paśya iti | muktasya tadātanaparaduḥkhaprāktanasvaduḥkhadarśane'pi tayoḥ svāśritatvavartamānatvābhāvānna taṃ prati pratikūlatvam | evaṃ hi bandhadaśāyāmapi dṛṣṭam | tatra tu paraduḥkhaduḥkhitvaṃ, gatānuśocanaṃ ca karmopādhikameva; na rogaṃ nota duḥkhatāṃ sarvaṃ ha paśyaḥ paśyatītyādinā viśeṣeṇa dṛśyamāneṣvapi svaprātikūlyadarśanaṃ nāstīti hi sthāpyate | paśyo'tra tadekaṃ paśyatīti samānaprakaraṇāt brahmadarśī jīvaḥ | paśyatīti vyutpattyā paramātmanyapi, paśyaḥ paśyati paśyantamityādiprayogadṛṣṭeḥ | brahmātmakatayā sarvasya darśanāttadekadarśanasarvadarśanayoḥ na virodhaḥ | na kevalaṃ nirvyāpārasārvajñyamātram, anyarājānaste kṣayyalokā bhavantītyāmnātakarmamūlānīśvarapāratantryanivṛttyā svacchandavṛttiśca syādityabhipretyāha -- sa svarāḍi ti | ata eveśvarapāratantryasthitāvapi svarāṭ svatantra iti naighaṇṭukoktirna virudhyate | amṛtatvamyopāyāntaraniṣedhaśrutyā karmasādhyāmṛtatvokteranyaparatvaṃ draḍhayati -- tamevami ti | atra ca guṇavibhūtiviśiṣṭamahāpuruṣaparāmarśājjīvasyaiva nirviśeṣasvarūpadhiyā puruṣāntaradhiyā vā muktiḥ syāditi pareṣṭaṃ nirastam | aikyabhedābhedabuddhyoramṛtatvahetutvaṃ śrutyaiva kṣiptamityāha -- pṛthagi ti | tataḥ upāsanarūpāt pṛthaktvamananādityarthaḥ | tena juṣṭaḥ -- prerakeṇa prītiviṣayīkṛtaḥ | anena sthirasya parānugrahasyaiva phaladvāratoktiḥ | dhātuḥ prasādāditi ca śrūyate | nanvatrātmānaṃ preritāraṃ ceti samuccityamananamuktam; ato'nyajñānasyāpi mokṣahetutvaṃ bhāti; satyam, na tāvatā prerakaprādhānyamapahniyate | kaściddhīraḥ pratyagātmānamaikṣat āvṛttacakṣuramṛtatvamicchannityādāvapi paravidyāṅgajīvadarśanaparam | ādiśabdaḥ bhūyasāṃ syādbalīyastvamiti nyāyena vākyāntarairapyuktadṛḍhīkaraṇārthaḥ | nanu ca sāṅgavedādhyayanādeva karmaṇāṃ svargādiphalatvaṃ svargādīnāṃ ca kṣayitvaṃ brahmopāsanasyāmṛtatvaphalatvaṃ ca jñāyata eva | anantaraṃ mumukṣuḥ brahmajijñāsāyāmeva pravartatām | kimarthā dharmavicārāpekṣā | evaṃ tarhi śārīrakamīmāṃsāyāmapi na pravartatām, sāṅgādhyayanādeva kṛtsnasya jñātatvāt | satyam; āpātapratītirvidyata eva, tathā'pi nyāyānugṛhītasya vākyasyārthaniścāyakatvādāpātapratīto'pyarthaḥ saṃśayaviparyayau nātivartate; atastannirṇayāya vedāntavākyavicāraḥ kartavya iti cet, tathaiva dharmavicāro'pi kartavya iti paśyatu bhavān |
